-- Actor arithmetic and turn status rules; no UI or platform globals.
local M = {}
local Events = require("abyss_events")
local Act2Powers = require('abyss_act2_powers')
local PlatedArmor = require('abyss_plated_armor')
local Act3Powers = require('abyss_act3_powers')
local Awakened=require('abyss_awakened_one')
local f32 = require('abyss_sts_random').float32
local Nemesis = require('abyss_nemesis')
local function intangible(actor)
    return (actor.statuses.intangible or 0)>0 or rawget(actor.statuses,'nemesis_intangible')~=nil
end
local Darklings=require('abyss_darklings')

-- Require lazily: card actions use Actor arithmetic, and hooks only enqueue
-- data. Combat owns draining, choices, death interruption and transactionality.
local function enqueue(state,e,source,top)
    assert(not source or source==state.player,'reaction owner must be player')
    require("abyss_card_actions").enqueueReaction(state,e,top)
end
local function reaction(state,e,top)require('abyss_card_actions').enqueueReaction(state,e,top)end
-- Equal-priority original Powers are stably sorted: their hooks retain the
-- order of first application. Legacy raw-status fixtures get an explicit order.
function M.powerSequence(actor,ids)
    local allowed,seen,result={},{},{}
    for _,id in ipairs(ids) do allowed[id]=true end
    for _,id in ipairs(actor.powerOrder or {}) do
        if allowed[id] and (actor.statuses[id] or 0)~=0 and not seen[id] then
            result[#result+1]=id;seen[id]=true
        end
    end
    for _,id in ipairs(ids) do if not seen[id] and (actor.statuses[id] or 0)~=0 then result[#result+1]=id end end
    return result
end
local function removeSpirePower(state,actor,id)
    assert(id=='back_attack'or id=='surrounded','unsupported Spire Power removal')
    local amount=actor.statuses[id]
    require('abyss_power_schedule').remove(state,actor,id)
    actor.statuses[id]=nil
    if amount~=nil then Events.emit(state,'status',{target=actor.id,status=id,amount=-amount})end
end
function M.faceTarget(state,target)
    return require('abyss_spire_pair').faceTarget({isActive=M.isActive,applyPower=M.applyPower,
        removePower=removeSpirePower},state,target)
end
function M.removeSpireDeathPower(state,effect)
    local target=effect.targetId==state.player.id and state.player or nil
    for _,enemy in ipairs(state.enemies)do if enemy.id==effect.targetId then target=enemy;break end end
    assert(target and (target==state.player and effect.status=='surrounded'
        or require('abyss_spire_pair').owns(target)and effect.status=='back_attack'),'invalid Spire death Power owner')
    removeSpirePower(state,target,effect.status)
    return true
end
local function notifyHpLost(state,owner,actor,amount)
    if actor~=state.player or amount<=0 then return end
    -- The 238 notifier owns the single damagedThisCombat increment, actual
    -- Blood for Blood costs and provenance-sensitive Rupture trigger.
    require('abyss_hp_loss').notify(state,owner,actor,amount)
    -- Preserve the upstream 75-card instance ABI as a compatibility mirror.
    -- Combat prefers combatCost/turnCost and must not subtract this a second time.
    for _,pile in ipairs({state.hand,state.draw,state.discard}) do
        for _,card in ipairs(pile) do
            if card.cardId=="blood_for_blood" then card.costReduction=(card.costReduction or 0)+1 end
        end
    end
end
function M.hpLostFromCard(state,actor,amount) notifyHpLost(state,actor,actor,amount) end
function M.hpLostFromDamage(state,actor,amount) notifyHpLost(state,nil,actor,amount) end

function M.isActive(actor) return actor ~= nil and actor.hp > 0 and not actor.escaped and not actor.halfDead and not actor.isDying end

-- A half-dead monster is not targetable, but it has not ended the combat.
function M.isPresent(actor)
    return actor~=nil and not actor.escaped and not actor.isDying and (actor.hp>0 or actor.halfDead or actor.awakenedRebirthPending) or false
end

function M.status(state, actor, id, amount, source, sourceIsMonster)
    local beforeRaw=rawget(actor.statuses,id)
    local powerOrderModule=require('abyss_power_order')
    if powerOrderModule.ids[id] then powerOrderModule.before(state,actor) end
    local before = actor.statuses[id] or 0
    M.addStatus(actor, id, amount)
    Nemesis.applied(actor,id,beforeRaw)
    local zeroMembership=id=='slow' or id=='time_warp' or id=='invincible'
    if zeroMembership and beforeRaw==nil or not zeroMembership and (before==0 or actor.statuses[id]==0) then
        local order={}
        for _,old in ipairs(actor.powerOrder or {}) do if old~=id then order[#order+1]=old end end
        if actor.statuses[id]~=0 or zeroMembership then order[#order+1]=id end
        actor.powerOrder=order
    end
    powerOrderModule.applied(state,actor,id,beforeRaw)
    if before <= 0 and actor.statuses[id] > 0
        and actor.statusDefinitions[id].decay == "round_end_minus_1" then
        local monster = sourceIsMonster
        if monster == nil then monster = source ~= nil and source ~= state.player end
        actor[id .. "JustApplied"] = monster and (id ~= "vulnerable" or state.phase == "enemy") or nil
    end
    local sourceId = (source or actor).id
    if source == nil and sourceIsMonster ~= nil then sourceId = nil end
    Events.emit(state, "status", {source = sourceId, target = actor.id,
        status = id, amount = actor.statuses[id] - before})
end

local stacks = { intensity = true, duration = true, none = true }
local decays = { none = true, turn_end_minus_1 = true, round_end_minus_1 = true,
    turn_start_trigger_then_minus_1 = true, turn_end_trigger_then_minus_1 = true }
local signed = { strength = true, dexterity = true, focus = true }

local function integer(amount)
    return type(amount) == "number" and amount == amount and amount % 1 == 0
        and amount >= -2147483647 and amount <= 2147483647
end

-- Only source-verified ApplyPower categories; raw status mutation stays separate.
local debuffs = { draw_reduction=true, corpse_explosion=true,wraith_form=true,no_block=true, bias=true, weak=true, vulnerable=true, frail=true, poison=true, entangled=true,
    shackled=true,choked=true,block_return=true,mark=true,energy_down=true,hex=true,confusion=true,constricted=true,slow=true }
local function blockDebuff(state, actor, id)
    local before = actor.statuses.artifact or 0
    if before <= 0 then return false end
    actor.statuses.artifact = before - 1
    Events.emit(state, "status", {source=actor.id, target=actor.id, status="artifact",
        amount=-1, blockedStatus=id})
    return true
end

-- Shared Artifact event path for specialized Power lifecycle implementations.
function M.tryBlockDebuff(state, actor, id)
    if not M.isActive(actor) then return false end
    return blockDebuff(state, actor, id)
end

-- Pure prediction for an already validated application. Artifact's gate occurs
-- before stackPower, so a blocked application has no prospective stack overflow.
function M.artifactBlocksPower(actor, id, amount)
    return M.isActive(actor) and (actor.statuses.artifact or 0) > 0
        and (debuffs[id] == true or (signed[id] == true and amount <= 0)) or false
end

-- Invoke at the source ApplyPowerAction construction site, not when a paused
-- action later executes. A scalar zero is an intentional ownership snapshot.
function M.poisonBonus(state, actor, source)
    return source==state.player and actor~=source
        and require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(state,'snake_skull') and 1 or 0
end

function M.applyPower(state, actor, id, amount, source, sourceIsMonster, preparedPoisonBonus)
    if id == "focus" then return require("abyss_focus").apply(state, actor, amount, source) end
    if not M.isActive(actor) then return false end -- ApplyPower cancels for a dead target.
    assert(actor.statusDefinitions and actor.statusDefinitions[id], "unknown status: " .. tostring(id))
    assert(integer(amount) and (signed[id] or id=='wraith_form' or (id=='unawakened'or id=='regrow'or id=='painful_stabs') and amount==-1 or amount >= 0), "invalid status amount")
    -- Explicit queued Poison applications carry their constructor snapshot.
    -- Immediate actions construct/apply together. Both incoming Power and raw
    -- stack amounts get the bonus after the caller's cap, before Artifact.
    if id=='poison' then
        local bonus=preparedPoisonBonus
        if bonus==nil then bonus=M.poisonBonus(state,actor,source) end
        assert(bonus==0 or bonus==1,'invalid prepared poison bonus')
        amount=amount+0.0+bonus
        assert(integer(amount),'poison application overflow')
    end
    -- Strength/Dexterity's incoming Power has DEBUFF type at amount <= 0,
    -- regardless of the target's existing signed total. Zero is not an early exit.
    if M.artifactBlocksPower(actor, id, amount) then blockDebuff(state, actor, id); return false end
    local firstConstricted=id=='constricted' and (actor.statuses.constricted or 0)<=0
    if id=='constricted' then
        assert(actor==state.player and source and source~=actor and source.ai and source.ai.policy=='spire_growth',
            'Constricted requires its real Spire Growth source')
    end
    -- ApplyPowerAction stacks the existing Power, retaining its first source.
    -- Keep the real actor link off player: presentation frames shallow-project
    -- actor fields. Only primitive identity/name fields may enter those frames.
    if firstConstricted then
        state.constrictedSource=source
        actor.constrictedSourceId,actor.constrictedSourceName=source.id,source.name
    end
    M.status(state, actor, id, amount, source, sourceIsMonster)
    require('abyss_colorless_cards').debuffApplied(state,actor,id,amount,source)
    if actor==state.player and (id=='demon_form' or id=='brutality' or id=='devotion' or id=='noxious_fumes') then
        state.postDrawPowerOrder=state.postDrawPowerOrder or {}
        local found=false
        for _,key in ipairs(state.postDrawPowerOrder) do if key==id then found=true end end
        if not found then state.postDrawPowerOrder[#state.postDrawPowerOrder+1]=id end
    end
    return true
end

function M.applyNoDraw(state, actor)
    -- ApplyPowerAction's duplicate NoDraw gate precedes Artifact's generic gate.
    if not M.isActive(actor) or actor.noDraw then return false end
    if blockDebuff(state, actor, "no_draw") then return false end
    actor.noDraw = true
    if not state.originalV4 then
        local order={};for _,id in ipairs(actor.powerOrder or {})do if id~='no_draw'then order[#order+1]=id end end
        order[#order+1]='no_draw';actor.powerOrder=order
    end
    return true
end

function M.bindStatuses(actor, definitions)
    assert(type(definitions) == "table", "missing status definitions")
    for id, definition in pairs(definitions) do
        assert(definition.id == id and stacks[definition.stack] and decays[definition.decay], "invalid status definition")
        if definition.decay:find("trigger", 1, true) then
            assert(id == "poison" or id == "regen", "unknown status trigger")
        end
    end
    actor.statusDefinitions = definitions
end

function M.addStatus(actor, id, amount)
    local definition = assert(actor.statusDefinitions and actor.statusDefinitions[id], "unknown status: " .. tostring(id))
    assert(integer(amount) and (signed[id] or id=='wraith_form' or (id=='unawakened'or id=='regrow'or id=='painful_stabs') and amount==-1 or amount >= 0), "invalid status amount")
    local before = actor.statuses[id] or 0
    local value = before + 0.0 + amount
    assert(integer(value), "status stack overflow") -- reject before mutating
    -- Strength/Dexterity clamp after stacking, for either actor and either sign.
    if signed[id] then value = math.max(-999, math.min(999, value)) end
    if id == 'plated_armor' and before > 0 then value = math.min(999, value) end
    if id=='painful_stabs' and (before==-1 or amount==-1)then value=-1 end
    if definition.stack == "none" and id~="unawakened" and id~="regrow" and id~='painful_stabs' then value = value > 0 and 1 or 0 end
    if id=='painful_stabs' and value>0 then value=1 end
    actor.statuses[id] = (signed[id] or id=='wraith_form' or id=='unawakened'or id=='regrow'or id=='painful_stabs') and value or math.max(0, value)
    if (actor.statuses[id] == 0 or before <= 0) and definition.decay == "round_end_minus_1" then
        actor[id .. "JustApplied"] = nil
    end
    return actor.statuses[id]
end

local temporaryFields = { strength="temporaryStrength", dexterity="temporaryDexterity" }
local function rememberTemporaryOrder(actor, id)
    -- Equal-priority LoseStrength/LoseDexterity retain first insertion order.
    -- Replace the array so detached presentation frames never change later.
    local order = {}
    for _, prior in ipairs(actor.temporaryPowerOrder or {}) do order[#order+1] = prior end
    if not actor.temporaryPowerOrder then
        -- Old/raw Strength bookkeeping predates the second supported loss Power.
        for _, prior in ipairs({"strength", "dexterity"}) do
            if (actor[temporaryFields[prior]] or 0) > 0 then order[#order+1] = prior end
        end
    end
    for _, prior in ipairs(order) do
        if prior == id then actor.temporaryPowerOrder = order; return end
    end
    order[#order+1] = id
    actor.temporaryPowerOrder = order
    local powers = {}
    for _,prior in ipairs(actor.powerOrder or {}) do if prior ~= 'lose_'..id then powers[#powers+1]=prior end end
    powers[#powers+1]='lose_'..id
    actor.powerOrder=powers
end

local function addTemporaryStat(actor, id, amount, state)
    assert(integer(amount) and amount >= 0, "invalid temporary " .. id)
    assert(not state or amount > 0, "zero temporary " .. (id == "strength" and "Strength" or "Dexterity") .. " application unsupported")
    if state and not M.isActive(actor) then return false end
    local field = temporaryFields[id]
    local total = (actor[field] or 0) + 0.0 + amount
    -- Positive Strength/Dexterity cannot spend Artifact. If its loss is blocked,
    -- its old debt is never stacked and must not fail a nonexistent addition.
    local blockedLoss = state and (actor.statuses.artifact or 0) > 0
    if not blockedLoss then assert(integer(total), "temporary " .. id .. " overflow") end
    if state then
        -- Flex/Speed queue the gain then a separate timed-loss DEBUFF. Artifact
        -- can block that latter application while preserving the positive stat.
        M.applyPower(state, actor, id, amount, actor)
        if not blockDebuff(state, actor, "lose_" .. id) then
            rememberTemporaryOrder(actor, id)
            actor[field] = total
            state.events[#state.events].frame = Events.frame(state)
        end
    else
        -- Public two-argument helper is raw setup/bookkeeping, not ApplyPower.
        M.addStatus(actor, id, amount)
        if amount > 0 then rememberTemporaryOrder(actor, id) end
        actor[field] = total
    end
end

function M.addTemporaryStrength(actor, amount, state)
    return addTemporaryStat(actor, "strength", amount, state)
end

function M.addTemporaryDexterity(actor, amount, state)
    return addTemporaryStat(actor, "dexterity", amount, state)
end

-- UI receives values, never references to the combat state or definitions.
function M.statusView(actor)
    local ids, result = {}, {}
    for id, amount in pairs(actor.statuses) do
        -- At exactly zero net stat, the separate timed-loss Power still exists.
        if amount ~= 0 or id == "time_warp" or id == "focus" or id=='slow' or id=='invincible' or temporaryFields[id] and (actor[temporaryFields[id]] or 0) > 0 then
            ids[#ids + 1] = id
        end
    end
    table.sort(ids)
    for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
        local definition = assert(actor.statusDefinitions[id], "unknown active status")
        result[#result + 1] = { id = id, amount = actor.statuses[id], name = definition.name,
            icon=require('abyss_colorless_cards').powerIcon(id),
            kind = id == "focus" and (actor.statuses[id] > 0 and "buff" or "debuff") or definition.kind, stack = definition.stack, decay = definition.decay,
            description = require('abyss_silent_final_cards').powerDescription(actor,id)or require('abyss_colorless_cards').powerDescription(actor,id) or definition.description,
            temporary = temporaryFields[id] and (actor[temporaryFields[id]] or 0) or 0 }
    end
    local function resource(id,name,amount,description,icon,duration,kind)
        result[#result+1]={id='original_v4_'..id,name=name,amount=amount,description=description,icon=icon or 'strength',
            kind=kind or 'buff',stack='intensity',decay='none',temporary=0,originalV4=true,duration=duration or '本场战斗'}
    end
    local v=actor.originalV4
    if v then
        if v.role=='HT' and v.infuse>0 then resource('infuse','蝶引',v.infuse,'剩余结束阶段；本回合已强化重击 '..v.chargedUsed..'/2。','strength','剩余 '..v.infuse..' 个结束阶段')
        elseif v.role=='AR' then resource('bond','生命之契',v.bond,'契量最多8；不随等待减少。','strength')
        elseif v.role=='FR' then
            resource('mode',v.mode=='ousia' and '荒性' or '芒性',1,v.mode=='ousia' and '只有宾客行动，歌者暂停。' or '只有歌者行动，宾客暂停。','regen')
            resource('fan','气氛',v.fan,'本回合已增长 '..v.fanGained..'/4；气氛最多12。','strength')
        elseif v.role=='RD' then
            resource('resolve','愿力',v.resolve,'本回合已增长 '..v.resolveGained..'/2；愿力最多6。','strength')
            if v.eye.uses>0 and v.eye.ends>0 then resource('eye','雷眼',v.eye.uses,'剩余次数；普通主动伤害实际扣血后追击。','thorns','剩余 '..v.eye.ends..' 个结束阶段')end
            if v.musou.uses>0 and v.musou.ends>0 then resource('musou','一心',v.musou.uses,'剩余强化普攻次数；本回合返能 '..v.musouRefunded..'/1。','strength','剩余 '..v.musou.ends..' 个结束阶段')end
        end
        resource('healing','治疗余量',(v.healCap or 12)-v.healUsed,'本战已实际治疗 '..v.healUsed..'/'..(v.healCap or 12)..'；切换和重召不会重置。','regen')
    end
    if actor.v4Bloom then resource('bloom','血梅香',actor.v4Bloom.strength,'每次造成强度×2固定伤害。','poison','剩余 '..actor.v4Bloom.ticks..' 次','debuff')end
    if actor.v4Directive then resource('directive',actor.v4Directive.mature and '成熟勒令' or '勒令',1,
        actor.v4Directive.mature and '吸收获得6契；死亡回收4契。' or '下次己方回合开始成熟；当前吸收获得2契。','vulnerable','被吸收或死亡时清除','debuff')end
    return result
end

-- Death powers join the current damage action's TOP reactions. They must not
-- run inside an area target loop, or survive that action killing the final foe.
local function battleEnding(state)
    if state.phase == "victory" or state.phase == "defeat" then return true end
    for _, enemy in ipairs(state.enemies) do if M.isPresent(enemy) then return false end end
    return true
end

local function queueDeathPower(state, target, before, reactions)
    if before>0 and target.hp<=0 and not target.escaped then
        local function deathReaction(s,effect,top)
            -- Death's TOP actions join the existing reverse TOP damage batch,
            -- above onAttacked Thorns; BOTTOM returns join the owning queue.
            if top then reactions[#reactions+1]={effect=effect}else reaction(s,effect)end
        end
        -- Both source Powers have priority 5: AbstractMonster.die visits them
        -- in stable acquisition order. Their BOTTOM actions must also enter
        -- the same manager when this damage belongs to an advanced play.
        local transition=Awakened.deathStart(state,target,before)
        local darkling=Darklings.deathStart(state,target,before)
        local function visit(actor)
            actor=actor or target
            for _,id in ipairs(M.powerSequence(actor,{'stasis','corpse_explosion'}))do
                if id=='stasis' then Act2Powers.stasisDied(state,actor,deathReaction)
                else require('abyss_silent_final_cards').death(state,actor,before,deathReaction)end
            end
            Act2Powers.died(state,actor,deathReaction)
        end
        visit()
        if darkling then Darklings.deathFinish(state,target,visit,deathReaction)end
        if transition then
            if transition=='final'then Awakened.finalEscapes(state,deathReaction);target.block=0;visit()end
            Awakened.deathFinish(state,target,deathReaction)
        end
        require('abyss_reptomancer').died(state,target,deathReaction)
        require('abyss_spire_pair').died(state,target,function(effect)
            reaction(state,{op='spireDeathRemove',targetId=effect.targetId,status=effect.status})
        end)
    end
    if before > 0 and target.hp <= 0 and not target.escaped and target.ai and target.ai.kind == "looter"
        and not target.stolenGoldRewarded then
        local stolen = target.stolenGold or 0
        local total = (state.stolenGoldReward or 0) + 0.0 + stolen
        assert(integer(stolen) and stolen >= 0 and integer(total), "stolen gold overflow")
        state.stolenGoldReward, target.stolenGoldRewarded = total, true
    end
    local amount = target.statuses.spore_cloud or 0
    if before > 0 and target.hp <= 0 and target ~= state.player and amount > 0 and not battleEnding(state) then
        -- ApplyPower's source is null, independently of Vulnerable's explicit
        -- monster-origin flag used for its first enemy-round decay suppression.
        reactions[#reactions + 1] = {target=state.player, status="vulnerable", amount=amount,
            sourceIsMonster=true}
    end
end

function M.resolveDamageReactions(state, reactions, retaliate)
    for i = #reactions, 1, -1 do
        local hit = reactions[i]
        if hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='awakenedAction'then
            Awakened.resolve(M,state,hit.effect)
        elseif hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='defenseBlock' then
            if M.isActive(state.player) then M.block(state,state.player,hit.effect.value,true) end
        elseif hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='cardTriggerPoison' then
            require('abyss_card_triggers').resolveEnvenom(state,hit.effect)
        elseif hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='reptomancerSuicide'then
            require('abyss_reptomancer').cleanup(M,state,hit.effect)
        elseif hit.effect and Act2Powers.supports(hit.effect.op)then
            Act2Powers.apply(M,state,hit.effect)
        elseif hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='transientShift'then
            Act3Powers.resolveShift(M,state,hit.effect)
          elseif hit.effect and hit.effect.op=='defectStatic'then
              require('abyss_defect_final_cards').static(state,hit.effect.value)
        elseif hit.status then
            if not battleEnding(state) then
                M.applyPower(state, hit.target, hit.status, hit.amount, hit.source, hit.sourceIsMonster)
            end
        else
            -- DAMAGE survives final-kill cleanup; recursive death reactions
            -- belong above the remaining actions in this local batch.
            (retaliate or M.retaliate)(state, hit.source, hit.target, hit.amount)
        end
    end
end

local function directDamage(state, source, target, amount, status, blocked, reactions)
    if intangible(target) then amount=math.min(amount,1) end
    amount=require('abyss_defect_final_cards').incoming(state,target,amount)
    amount=require('abyss_corrupt_heart').capDamage(target,amount)
    Act3Powers.attacked(state,target,amount,reactions)
    if target==state.player then amount=require('abyss_relic_hooks').onLoseHpLast(state,amount)end
    local before = target.hp
    local lost = math.min(target.hp, amount)
    target.hp = target.hp - lost
    local damageOwner=source
    if status=='poison' then damageOwner=nil end
    notifyHpLost(state,damageOwner,target,lost)
    local damageEvent=Events.emit(state, status=='hp_loss'and 'hp_loss'or "status_damage", {
        source = source and source.id, target = target.id, status = status, amount = lost, blocked = blocked or 0 })
    require('abyss_relic_hooks').hpChanged(state,target,before)
    if state.originalV4 then require('abyss_original_v4').enemyDied(state,target,before) end
    queueDeathPower(state, target, before, reactions)
    if target.halfDead or Darklings.owns(target)and target.isDying then damageEvent.frame=Events.frame(state)end
    return lost
end

function M.loseHp(state,target,amount)
    if not M.isActive(target)then return 0 end
    if intangible(target) then amount=math.min(amount,1)end
    local reactions={};local lost=directDamage(state,nil,target,amount,'hp_loss',0,reactions)
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state,reactions)
    return lost
end

-- Judgement's InstantKill sets HP to zero before a null-source HP_LOSS(0).
-- It ignores block and damage modifiers, but still owns the death callback.
function M.instantKill(state,target)
    local before=target.hp
    target.hp=0
    local damageEvent=Events.emit(state,'damage',{target=target.id,amount=0,blocked=0})
    require('abyss_relic_hooks').hpChanged(state,target,before)
    local reactions={};queueDeathPower(state,target,before,reactions)
    if target.halfDead or Darklings.owns(target)and target.isDying then damageEvent.frame=Events.frame(state)end
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state,reactions)
end

function M.suicideReptomancerMinion(state,target)
    local before=target.hp;target.hp,target.gold=0,0
    if before<=0 then return end
    Events.emit(state,'enemy_suicide',{enemy=target.id})
    if state.originalV4 then require('abyss_original_v4').enemyDied(state,target,before)end
    local reactions={};queueDeathPower(state,target,before,reactions)
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state,reactions)
end

function M.sacrificeDagger(state,target,amount)
    assert(target.ai and target.ai.kind=='reptomancer'and target.ai.policy=='dagger','Dagger sacrifice only')
    if not M.isActive(target)then return end
    local reactions={};directDamage(state,target,target,amount,'hp_loss',0,reactions)
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state,reactions)
end

function M.suicideTransient(state,target)
    assert(M.isActive(target)and target.ai and target.ai.kind=='act3'and target.ai.policy=='transient','Transient suicide only')
    local before=target.hp;target.hp,target.gold=0,0
    Events.emit(state,'enemy_suicide',{enemy=target.id})
    local reactions={};queueDeathPower(state,target,before,reactions)
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state,reactions)
end

function M.vulnerablePercent(state,target)
    if target==state.player then
        for _,id in ipairs(state.relics or {})do if id=='odd_mushroom'or id=='Odd Mushroom'then return 125 end end
    end
    return state.rules.combat.vulnerablePercent
end
local function damageStep(trace,kind,value,operand)
    if kind=='vigor' and operand==0 or kind=='stance' and operand==1 then return value end
    if trace then trace[#trace+1]={kind=kind,value=value,operand=operand} end
    return value
end
local function attackFloat(state, source, target, base, fixed,trace)
    -- Force float arithmetic before modifiers: Fengari integers are 32-bit,
    -- while game Lua uses wider integers. Integer multiplication would wrap.
    local amount = base + 0.0
    damageStep(trace,'base',amount)
    local slow=not fixed and target.statuses.slow~=nil
    if slow then amount=damageStep(trace,'binary32',f32(amount)) end
    if not fixed then
        amount = amount + (source.statuses.strength or 0)
        damageStep(trace,'strength',amount,source.statuses.strength or 0)
        if slow then amount=damageStep(trace,'binary32',f32(amount)) end
        amount = amount + (source.statuses.vigor or 0)
        damageStep(trace,'vigor',amount,source.statuses.vigor or 0)
        if slow then amount=damageStep(trace,'binary32',f32(amount)) end
        if (source.statuses.double_damage or 0)>0 then amount=damageStep(trace,'double_damage',amount*2,2) end
        if (source.statuses.pen_nib or 0)>0 then amount=damageStep(trace,'pen_nib',amount*2.0,2) end
        if (source.statuses.weak or 0) > 0 then amount = damageStep(trace,'weak',amount * state.rules.combat.weakPercent / 100,state.rules.combat.weakPercent/100) end
        if slow then amount=damageStep(trace,'binary32',f32(amount)) end
        if (target.statuses.vulnerable or 0) > 0 and target.statuses.slow==nil then
            local percent=M.vulnerablePercent(state,target)
            amount=amount*percent/100
            damageStep(trace,'vulnerable',amount,percent/100)
        end
    end
    if state.player.stance and source then
        local multiplier=require("abyss_stances").damageMultiplier(state, source, target, fixed)
        amount = amount * multiplier
        damageStep(trace,'stance',amount,multiplier)
        if slow then amount=damageStep(trace,'binary32',f32(amount)) end
    end
    if not fixed and target.statuses.slow~=nil then
        amount=require('abyss_giant_head').receive(state,target,amount,trace)
    end
    if not fixed and (target.statuses.flight or 0)>0 then amount=damageStep(trace,'flight',amount/2,.5) end
    return amount
end
function M.attackAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed)
    local amount=attackFloat(state,source,target,base,fixed)
    if intangible(target)then amount=math.min(amount,1)end
    return math.max(0,math.floor(amount))
end
local function intentAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed,trace)
    local amount=attackFloat(state,source,target,base,fixed,trace)
    if not fixed and target==state.player and require('abyss_spire_pair').owns(source)then
        return require('abyss_spire_pair').intentDamage(state,source,amount,
            function(value)
                if intangible(target) then return damageStep(trace,'intangible',math.min(value,1),1) end
                return value
            end,trace)
    elseif intangible(target)then amount=damageStep(trace,'intangible',math.min(amount,1),1) end
    return damageStep(trace,'round',math.max(0,math.floor(amount)))
end
function M.intentAttackAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed)
    return intentAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed)
end
function M.intentAttackPreview(state,source,target,base,fixed)
    local steps={}
    local amount=intentAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed,steps)
    return {amount=amount,steps=steps}
end

-- An area attack collects retaliation until all of its targets are damaged.
-- A dead attacker may still own a queued Thorns hit; dead victims cannot lose HP.
function M.retaliate(state, source, target, amount, status)
    assert(status==nil or status=='sharp_hide','invalid retaliation status')
    if not M.isActive(target) then return 0 end
    if intangible(target) then amount=math.min(amount,1) end
    local blocked = math.min(target.block, amount)
    target.block = target.block - blocked
    local reactions = {}
    local lost = directDamage(state, source, target, amount - blocked, status or "thorns", blocked, reactions)
    M.resolveDamageReactions(state, reactions)
    return lost
end

local function queuePlayerAttackedReactions(state,source,target,amount,fixed)
    if fixed or not source or source==target or target~=state.player then return false end
    -- These onAttacked Powers all have source priority 5. Construct their
    -- TOP actions before wasHPLost, whose later TOP draws must run first.
    for _,id in ipairs(M.powerSequence(target,{'thorns','flame_barrier','block_return','static_discharge'}))do
        local n=target.statuses[id]
        if id=='static_discharge'then
            if amount>0 then require('abyss_defect_final_cards').static(state,n)end
        elseif id=='block_return'then reaction(state,{op='block',value=n,fixed=true},true)
        else reaction(state,{op='staticRetaliation',targetId=source.id,value=n},true)end
    end
    return true
end

function M.damage(state, source, target, base, fixed, retaliation, normalAmount, attackReaction)
    if not M.isActive(target) or source ~= nil and not M.isActive(source) then return 0 end
    local before, reactions = target.hp, retaliation or {}
    -- Owner.onAttack enqueues before the target's onAttacked reactions. Keep
    -- the shared area batch in that order, so reverse TOP draining can
    -- interleave a later target's poison with an earlier target's Thorns.
    if attackReaction then reactions[#reactions+1]=attackReaction end
    local amount
    if normalAmount ~= nil then
        -- Modifier results can exceed the signed32 base/status bounds. Keep
        -- the snapshot exact in binary64 without accepting non-finite values.
        assert(not fixed and type(normalAmount)=='number' and normalAmount==normalAmount
            and normalAmount>=0 and normalAmount<=9007199254740991 and normalAmount%1==0,
            "invalid normal damage snapshot")
        amount = normalAmount
    else
        amount=M.attackAmount(state,source,target,base,fixed)
        if not fixed and target==state.player then amount=require('abyss_spire_pair').actualDamage(state,source,amount)end
    end
    if intangible(target) then amount=math.min(amount,1) end
    local absorbed = math.min(target.block, amount)
    target.block = target.block - absorbed
    local unblocked=amount-absorbed
    if source==state.player and not fixed and unblocked>0 and unblocked<5 then
        for _,id in ipairs(state.relics or {})do if id=='boot' or id=='Boot'then unblocked=5;break end end
    end
      unblocked=require('abyss_defect_final_cards').incoming(state,target,unblocked)
    unblocked=require('abyss_corrupt_heart').capDamage(target,unblocked)
    Act3Powers.attacked(state,target,unblocked,reactions)
    local playerAttackedQueued=queuePlayerAttackedReactions(state,source,target,unblocked,fixed)
    if target==state.player then unblocked=require('abyss_relic_hooks').onLoseHpLast(state,unblocked)end
    local lost = math.min(target.hp, unblocked)
    -- Monster wasHPLost precedes onAttacked; the player uses the opposite
    -- order. In particular Book's onInflictDamage follows player Plated.
    if target~=state.player then PlatedArmor.hpLost(state,source,target,lost,not fixed,reaction)end
    Act2Powers.damaged(state,source,target,lost,fixed,reaction)
    require('abyss_writhing_mass').attacked(state,source,target,unblocked,fixed,reaction)
    target.hp = target.hp - lost
    notifyHpLost(state,source,target,lost)
    local damageEvent=Events.emit(state, "damage", { source = source and source.id, target = target.id, amount = lost, blocked = absorbed })
    if target==state.player then PlatedArmor.hpLost(state,source,target,lost,not fixed,reaction)end
    require('abyss_relic_hooks').hpChanged(state,target,before)
    Act2Powers.inflicted(state,source,lost,fixed,reaction)
    -- Curl Up locks on the first nonlethal NORMAL hit, but its actions go to
    -- the BOTTOM, behind every already-queued hit/effect and card disposal.
    -- Keep this FIFO separate from Angry/Thorns/Spore's reverse TOP reactions.
    local curl = target.statuses.curl_up or 0
    if source and target ~= state.player and not fixed and lost > 0 and target.hp > 0
        and curl > 0 and not target.curlUpTriggered then
        target.curlUpTriggered = true
        reaction(state,{op='resolveCurlUp',targetId=target.id,value=curl})
    end
    -- Angry is a queued positive Strength Power after an unblocked NORMAL hit.
    -- Fixed inventory damage, poison and retaliation use non-NORMAL paths.
    -- For an area action, all targets take damage before top-of-queue reactions.
    local angry = source and not fixed and lost > 0 and (target.statuses.angry or 0) or 0
    if angry > 0 then
        reactions[#reactions + 1] = { source = target, target = target, amount = angry, status = "strength" }
    end
    -- Thorns consumes block, but has no attack modifiers or recursive retaliation.
    -- Being attacked triggers Thorns, even at zero damage, fully blocked or lethal.
    if not fixed and source and source~=target and not playerAttackedQueued then
          for _,id in ipairs(M.powerSequence(target,{'thorns','flame_barrier','block_return'})) do
            -- Each Power adds its own TOP DamageAction. Combining them would
            -- erase two distinct damage callbacks and reverse application order.
            if (target.statuses[id] or 0)>0 then
                  if id=='block_return' then
                    if source~=target then reactions[#reactions+1]={effect={op='defenseBlock',value=target.statuses[id]}} end
                elseif id=='thorns' or source~=target then
                    reactions[#reactions+1]={source=target,target=source,amount=target.statuses[id]}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- onDeath queues after onAttacked, so its TOP Power resolves before Thorns.
    queueDeathPower(state, target, before, reactions)
    if target.halfDead or Darklings.owns(target)and target.isDying then damageEvent.frame=Events.frame(state)end
    if not retaliation then M.resolveDamageReactions(state, reactions) end
    return lost
end

function M.blockFloat(state, actor, amount, fixed)
    if not fixed and (actor.statuses.no_block or 0)>0 then return 0 end
    amount = amount + 0.0
    if not fixed then
        amount = amount + (actor.statuses.dexterity or 0)
        if (actor.statuses.frail or 0) > 0 then amount = amount * state.rules.combat.frailPercent / 100 end
    end
    return math.max(0,amount)
end
function M.blockAmount(state, actor, amount, fixed)
    return math.floor(M.blockFloat(state,actor,amount,fixed))
end

function M.block(state, actor, amount, fixed,callbackAmount)
    local before = actor.block
    -- Cap the final state, not the modifier calculation or its float precision.
    local gained=M.blockAmount(state, actor, amount, fixed)
    actor.block = math.min(999, actor.block + 0.0 + gained)
    if actor==state.player then require('abyss_watcher_final_cards').gainedBlock(state,callbackAmount or M.blockFloat(state,actor,amount,fixed))end
    if state.originalV4 and actor==state.player and actor.block==before then return end
    Events.emit(state, "block", {source = actor.id, target = actor.id, amount = actor.block - before})
    if state.originalV4Preview and actor==state.player and actor.block>before then
        state.originalV4Preview[#state.originalV4Preview+1]={op='block',low=actor.block-before,high=actor.block-before}
    end
    if actor==state.player and gained>0 and (actor.statuses.juggernaut or 0)>0 then
        enqueue(state,{op="damageRandom",value=actor.statuses.juggernaut,fixed=true},actor)
    end
end

function M.resolveCurlUp(state, target, block)
    if state.player.hp <= 0 or not M.isActive(target) then return end
    M.block(state,target,block,true)
    local amount=target.statuses.curl_up or 0
    target.statuses.curl_up=0
    Events.emit(state,"status",{source=target.id,target=target.id,status="curl_up",amount=-amount})
end

-- Only the bounded Curl Up bottom tail. Combat owns the outer action boundary.
function M.flushCurlUp(state)
    local queue = state.curlUpQueue
    state.curlUpQueue = nil
    -- The original death screen stops action-manager updates immediately.
    if not queue or state.player.hp <= 0 then return end
    for _, entry in ipairs(queue) do
        local target = entry.target
        -- GainBlock/RemovePower each reject a dead owner. A later queued hit
        -- may have killed it after the initial nonlethal trigger.
        M.resolveCurlUp(state,target,entry.amount)
    end
end

local function tick(state, actor, phase)
    if not M.isActive(actor) then return end
    local ids = {}
    for id in pairs(actor.statuses) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
    table.sort(ids) -- deterministic event ordering across Lua runtimes
    for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
        local definition = assert(actor.statusDefinitions[id], "unknown active status")
        local amount = actor.statuses[id]
        local decay = definition.decay
        local skip = phase == "round_end" and actor[id .. "JustApplied"]
        if skip then actor[id .. "JustApplied"] = nil end
        if amount > 0 and decay:sub(1, #phase) == phase and not skip then
            local reactions = {}
            local eventCount=#state.events
            if decay:find("trigger", 1, true) then
                if id == "poison" then directDamage(state, actor, actor, amount, "poison", nil, reactions)
                elseif id == "regen" then
                    if state.originalV4 and actor==state.player then require('abyss_original_v4_health').heal(state,actor,amount,nil,'regen')
                    else
                    local before=actor.hp
                    local healed = actor==state.player and require('abyss_potion_health').blocked(state.relics)and 0 or math.min(actor.maxHp - actor.hp, amount)
                    actor.hp = actor.hp + healed
                    Events.emit(state, "heal", { target = actor.id, amount = healed, status = id })
                    require('abyss_relic_hooks').hpChanged(state,actor,before)
                    end
                end
            end
            -- The damage override can remove Poison on first-form death.
            if rawget(actor.statuses,id)~=nil then actor.statuses[id] = amount - 1 end
            if decay:find("trigger", 1, true) then
                -- Trigger and decay are one presentation step, including lethal poison.
                if state.originalV4 and #state.events==eventCount then
                    Events.emit(state,'status',{source=actor.id,target=actor.id,status=id,amount=-1})
                else state.events[#state.events].frame = Events.frame(state)end
            else
                Events.emit(state, "status", {source = actor.id, target = actor.id, status = id, amount = -1})
            end
            M.resolveDamageReactions(state, reactions)
            if not M.isActive(actor) then return end
        end
    end
end

function M.endRound(state, actor)
    require('abyss_giant_head').endRound(state,actor)
    -- Orb Walker receives Growth in pre-battle, before any later round-decay
    -- debuff. Its first round is not suppressed like Cultist Ritual.
    Act3Powers.endRound(M,state,actor)
    tick(state, actor, "round_end")
end

function M.endTurn(state, actor)
    if actor~=state.player and M.isActive(actor) then
        if (actor.statuses.malleable or 0)>0 then actor.statuses.malleable=3 end
    end
    tick(state, actor, "turn_end")
    if not M.isActive(actor) then return end
    -- EntanglePower removes itself only for isPlayer=true, rather than reducing
    -- one stack at the monster round boundary or applying another Power.
    local entangled = actor.statuses.entangled or 0
    if actor == state.player and entangled > 0 then
        actor.statuses.entangled = 0
        Events.emit(state, "status", {source = actor.id, target = actor.id, status = "entangled", amount = -entangled})
    end
    local changed = false
    local endings,seen = {},{}
    for _,id in ipairs(actor.powerOrder or {}) do
        local stat=id:match('^lose_(.+)$')
        if id=='ritual' and actor==state.player and (actor.statuses.ritual or 0)>0 then
            endings[#endings+1]='ritual';seen.ritual=true
        elseif id=='wraith_form'and actor==state.player and (actor.statuses.wraith_form or 0)<0 then

end

        if not binding or owner.potionRun ~= owner.run or owner.potionBattle ~= owner.run.combat
            or owner.run.potions[binding.slot] ~= binding.id then return end
        return binding
    end

        owner.selected = nil
        owner.selectionEpoch = (owner.selectionEpoch or 0) + 1
        dependencies.cancelCardInputs()
        dependencies.cancelActionInputs()
        local battle = owner.run.combat
        local aim = {run=owner.run,battle=battle,turn=battle.turn,inventory=owner.run.potions,
            slot=binding.slot,id=binding.id,actors={},living={}}
        for i, actor in ipairs(battle.enemies) do aim.actors[i],aim.living[i]=actor,Actors.isActive(actor) end
        owner.potionAim = aim
        dependencies.notice(item.name .. (Controller.isController(host.platform.controller)
            and " · 摇杆选择敌人 · 确认使用 · 返回取消"
            or " · 对一名敌人：点击敌人使用；再点药水或空白取消；点说明查看效果。"))
        refresh()
        return true
    end

        if not self.active or self.busy or self.gesture or self.suppressClick or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "combat" then return false end
        local binding = potionBinding(index)
        if not binding then return false end
        local item = Run.potionView(self.run)[binding.slot]
        if not item or not item.canUse then dependencies.notice(reasons[item and item.reason] or "当前无法使用此药水。") return false end

    end

        local aim = owner.potionAim
        return not target or aim and aim.slot == slot and dependencies.aimReady(aim)
    end

        if not potionTargetReady(slot, target) then

        end

        if ok then

        end

        if reason ~= "presentation_unavailable" then refresh() end

    end
    local function potionRewardNotice(ok, reason, claim)

        if reason == "potion_blocked_by_sozu" then return "遗物阻止获得药水。" end

    end
    local function processPotionReward(claim)
        if not owner.active or not owner.run or owner.busy or owner.gesture or owner.suppressClick then return false end
        if owner.rewardScreen ~= "list" then return false end
        local ok,reason=(claim and Run.claimPotionReward or Run.skipPotionReward)(owner.run)

    function owner.skipPotionReward(_) return processPotionReward(false) end

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Events = require("abyss_events")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local RewardOwner = require("abyss_battle_reward_owner")
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
local reasons = { insufficient_energy = "能量不足", invalid_target = "请选择存活的敌人", card_content_unavailable = "此卡牌尚未实装，可选择其他卡牌或跳过。",
    card_not_in_hand = "这张牌已离开手牌", not_player_turn = "敌方行动中",
    normality_limit = "平庸：本回合已打出三张牌",
    advanced_card_not_enabled = "此牌效果尚未接入", not_in_combat = "战斗已经结束",
    empty_potion_slot = "此药水已使用", invalid_potion_slot = "请选择有效药水",
    smoke_not_allowed = '此战斗不能使用烟雾弹',
    effect_overflow = "当前状态已达上限", potion_slots_full = "药水槽已满，请先丢弃旧药水。",
    potion_content_unavailable = "该稀有度药水尚未实装。", potion_blocked_by_sozu = "遗物阻止获得药水。" }
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, _ownership, host, dependencies)
    local R = L.rewardPick
    local function refresh(changed)
        if owner.run and owner.run.phase == "combat" then
            local battle, found = owner.run.combat, false
            if not battle.enemies[owner.target] or not Actors.isActive(battle.enemies[owner.target]) then
                for i, enemy in ipairs(battle.enemies) do if Actors.isActive(enemy) then owner.target = i break end end
            end
            for _, card in ipairs(battle.hand) do if card.uid == owner.selected then found = true break end end
            if not found then owner.selected = nil end
        else owner.selected = nil end
        owner:render()
        if changed and host.options.onChange then host.options.onChange(owner) end
    end
    local function perform(command, origin)
        local battle = owner.run.combat
        local before, first = Events.frame(battle), #battle.events + 1
        owner.busy, owner.feedbackRun, owner.feedbackBattle = true, owner.run, battle
        owner.displayBattle = {catalog = battle.catalog, rules = battle.rules}
        for k, v in pairs(before) do owner.displayBattle[k] = v end
        local shown, failure = pcall(owner.render, owner)
        if not shown then
            owner.busy, owner.displayBattle = false, nil
            print("ABYSS_FEEDBACK prepare_failed " .. tostring(failure))
            pcall(refresh)
            return false, "presentation_unavailable"
        end
        local called, ok, reason = pcall(command)
        if not called or not ok then
            owner.busy, owner.displayBattle = false, nil
            if not called then print("ABYSS_FEEDBACK command_failed " .. tostring(ok)) end
            refresh()
            return false, called and reason or "command_failed"
        end
        -- No core callback is retained by playback. The committed result is immutable to it.
        owner.feedbackLast = #battle.events
        owner.feedback:setFastMode(owner.fastMode==true)
        owner.feedback:begin(before, battle, first, owner.presentation, origin)
        return ok, reason
    end
    function owner:chooseCards(kind, uids, token, generation,battle)
        if self.busy or not self.run or self.run.phase~="combat" then return false, "not_in_combat" end
        local command = kind=="discard" and Run.chooseDiscard or kind=="scry" and Run.chooseScry
            or kind=="hand" and Run.chooseHand or kind=='pile' and Run.choosePile or kind=='potion'and Run.choosePotionStance
        if not command then return false, "invalid_choice_kind" end
        return perform(function() return command(self.run,uids,token,generation,battle) end)
    end
    local function helpContextChanged(help)
        local current = owner.run and owner.run.combat
        local actor = current and (help.spec.index == 0 and current.player or current.enemies[help.spec.index])
        return not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.run ~= help.run or current ~= help.battle
            or current.turn ~= help.turn or actor ~= help.actor or not Actors.isPresent(actor)
            or help.spec.screenSlot and not dependencies.sameEnemySlot(help.spec.screenSlot,actor,current)
            or help.spec.kind=='rewardCard' and not RewardOwner.ready(owner,help.spec)
    end
    local function helpPointerChanged(help)
        return owner.gesture and owner.gesture.moving
            or help.card and (help.card.input.held ~= help.card or not dependencies.cardReady(help.card))
    end
    local function fireHelp(help, dt)
        help.t = help.t + dt
        if help.t + 0.000001 >= L.statusInfo.delay then
            help.fired = true
            if help.held and (help.spec.kind == "card" or help.spec.kind=='rewardCard') then
                owner.gesture = nil
                dependencies.cancelCardInputs()
                owner.suppressClick = true
            end
            owner:openHelp(help.spec, help.source, true)
        end
    end
    local function updateHelp(dt)
        local help = owner.help
        if not help then return end
        if helpContextChanged(help) or helpPointerChanged(help) then owner.help = nil
        elseif help.spec.kind == "potion" and (owner.run.potions ~= help.spec.inventory
            or owner.run.potions[help.spec.slot] ~= help.spec.potionId) then owner.help = nil
        elseif not help.fired then fireHelp(help, dt) end
    end
    local function animateRewardCards(view, dt)
        local k, moving = 1 - math.exp(-R.ease * dt), false
        for i, anim in ipairs(view.cards) do
            local scale, lift = dependencies.rewardTarget(i)
            for key, goal in pairs({scale = scale, lift = lift, rise = 0}) do
                local gap = goal - anim[key]
                if math.abs(gap) > 0.002 then
                    anim[key] = math.abs(gap) < 0.05 and goal or anim[key] + gap * k
                    moving = true
                end
            end
        end
        return moving
    end
    local function updateRewardCards(dt)
        local view = owner.rewardView
        if view and owner.active and not owner.busy and owner.run and owner.run.phase == "reward" and view.rewards == owner.run.rewards then
            if animateRewardCards(view, dt) then owner:render(true) end
        end
    end
    function owner:update(dt)
        if self.gesture then self.gesture.elapsed = (self.gesture.elapsed or 0) + dt end
        if dependencies.updateCarry then dependencies.updateCarry() end
        if self.potionAim and not dependencies.aimReady(self.potionAim) then self:render() end
        updateHelp(dt)
        if self.feedbackRun and (self.feedbackRun ~= self.run or self.feedbackBattle ~= (self.run and self.run.combat)) then
            self.feedback:cancel()
            self.feedbackRun, self.feedbackBattle = nil, nil
            self:render() return
        end
        self.feedback:update(dt)
        updateRewardCards(dt)
        host.cardView.update(dt)
    end
    function owner:setActive(active)
        assert(type(active) == "boolean", "active must be boolean")
        self.active = active
        if not active then self.help=nil;dependencies.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。") end
        host.root:SetVisible(active)
        self:render()
    end
    function owner:start()
        if not self.active or host.options.embedded or self.busy then return false end
        self.run = Run.new(self.data, self.seed)
        self.seed = (self.seed + 1) % 65536
        assert(Run.startCombat(self.run, "cultist_solo"))
        self.target, self.selected = 1, nil
        dependencies.notice("") refresh(true)
        print("ABYSS_UI combat_started")
    end
    function owner:playSelected(target)
        if not self.active or not self.selected or self.busy or self.gesture or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "combat" then return end
        local uid, origin = self.selected, self.cardPositions[self.selected]
        local ok, reason = perform(function() return Run.play(self.run, uid, target) end, origin)
        if ok then self.selected = nil end
        dependencies.notice(ok and "" or reasons[reason] or "当前无法使用这张牌。")
        if reason ~= "presentation_unavailable" then refresh() end
    end
    function owner:chooseCard(token,uid)
        if self.busy or not self.run or self.run.phase~="combat" then return false end
        local ok,reason=perform(function() return Run.chooseCard(self.run,token,uid) end)
        dependencies.notice(ok and "" or reasons[reason] or "这次选牌已失效。")
        refresh()
        return ok,reason
    end
    local function claimCard(index, run)
        if owner.rewardScreen ~= "cards" then return end
        local ok, reason = Run.claimCardReward(run, index)
        if ok then
            -- Adopt the committed rewards object before local feedback; an
            -- unrelated replacement still resets the page on the next render.
            owner.rewardOwner, owner.rewardRun = run.rewards, run
            dependencies.rewardScreen("list")
        end
        dependencies.notice(ok and "卡牌已加入牌组。" or reasons[reason] or "当前无法领取奖励。")
        refresh(ok)
    end
    local function selectCombatCard(index, run)
        dependencies.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。")
        local instance = run.combat.hand[index]
        if not instance then return end
        owner.selectionEpoch = (owner.selectionEpoch or 0) + 1
        if owner.selected == instance.uid then owner.selected = nil dependencies.notice("") refresh() return end
        local ok, reason = Combat.canPlay(run.combat, instance.uid, owner.target)
        if not ok then dependencies.notice(reasons[reason] or "当前无法使用这张牌。") refresh() return end
        owner.selected = instance.uid
        dependencies.notice(Controller.isController(host.platform.controller)
            and (needsTarget(run.combat,instance) and "摇杆选择敌人 · 确认出牌 · 返回取消" or "确认出牌 · 返回取消")
            or (needsTarget(run.combat,instance) and "点选一个敌人；再点原牌取消" or "点击战场出牌区域；再点原牌取消"))
        refresh()
    end
    function owner:playSlot(index)
        local run = self.run
        if not self.active or not run or self.busy or self.gesture or self.suppressClick then return end
        if run.phase == "reward" then return claimCard(index, run)
        elseif run.phase == "combat" then return selectCombatCard(index, run) end
        refresh()
    end
    function owner:endTurn()
        if not self.active or not self.run or self.busy or self.gesture or self.suppressClick or self.run.phase ~= "combat" or self.run.combat.phase ~= "player" then return end
        self.selected = nil
        perform(function() return Run.endTurn(self.run) end)
    end
    local function potionBinding(index)
        local binding = owner.potionSlots and owner.potionSlots[index]
        if not binding or owner.potionRun ~= owner.run or owner.potionBattle ~= owner.run.combat
            or owner.run.potions[binding.slot] ~= binding.id then return end
        return binding
    end
    local function beginPotionAim(binding, item)
        owner.selected = nil
        owner.selectionEpoch = (owner.selectionEpoch or 0) + 1
        dependencies.cancelCardInputs()
        dependencies.cancelActionInputs()
        local battle = owner.run.combat
        local aim = {run=owner.run,battle=battle,turn=battle.turn,inventory=owner.run.potions,
            slot=binding.slot,id=binding.id,actors={},living={}}
        for i, actor in ipairs(battle.enemies) do aim.actors[i],aim.living[i]=actor,Actors.isActive(actor) end
        owner.potionAim = aim
        dependencies.notice(item.name .. (Controller.isController(host.platform.controller)
            and " · 摇杆选择敌人 · 确认使用 · 返回取消"
            or " · 对一名敌人：点击敌人使用；再点药水或空白取消；点说明查看效果。"))
        refresh()
        return true
    end
    function owner:usePotion(index)
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.gesture or self.suppressClick or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "combat" then return false end
        local binding = potionBinding(index)
        if not binding then return false end
        local item = Run.potionView(self.run)[binding.slot]
        if not item or not item.canUse then dependencies.notice(reasons[item and item.reason] or "当前无法使用此药水。") return false end
        local previous = self.potionAim
        dependencies.cancelPotionAim()
        if previous and previous.slot == binding.slot then dependencies.notice("已取消药水瞄准。") refresh() return true end
        if item.targetPolicy == "enemy_one" then return beginPotionAim(binding, item) end
        return self:commitPotion(binding.slot, nil)
    end
    local function potionTargetReady(slot, target)
        local aim = owner.potionAim
        return not target or aim and aim.slot == slot and dependencies.aimReady(aim)
    end
    function owner:commitPotion(slot, target)
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.gesture or self.suppressClick or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "combat" then return false end
        if not potionTargetReady(slot, target) then
            dependencies.cancelPotionAim("药水瞄准已失效，已取消。") refresh() return false
        end
        dependencies.cancelPotionAim()
        local ok, reason = perform(function() return Run.usePotion(self.run, slot, target) end)
        if ok then
            self.potionSlots[slot] = nil
        end
        dependencies.notice(ok and "药水已生效。" or reasons[reason] or "当前无法使用此药水。")
        if reason ~= "presentation_unavailable" then refresh() end
        return ok, reason
    end
    local function potionRewardNotice(ok, reason, claim)
        if not ok then return reasons[reason] or "当前无法处理药水。" end
        if reason == "potion_blocked_by_sozu" then return "遗物阻止获得药水。" end
        return claim and "药水已放入背包。" or "已放弃药水。"
    end
    local function processPotionReward(claim)
        if not owner.active or not owner.run or owner.busy or owner.gesture or owner.suppressClick then return false end
        if owner.rewardScreen ~= "list" then return false end
        local ok,reason=(claim and Run.claimPotionReward or Run.skipPotionReward)(owner.run)
        dependencies.notice(potionRewardNotice(ok, reason, claim))
        refresh(ok)
        return ok,reason
    end
    function owner.claimPotionReward(_) return processPotionReward(true) end
    function owner.skipPotionReward(_) return processPotionReward(false) end
    return {
        refresh=refresh, perform=perform, helpContextChanged=helpContextChanged, helpPointerChanged=helpPointerChanged, fireHelp=fireHelp,
        updateHelp=updateHelp, animateRewardCards=animateRewardCards, updateRewardCards=updateRewardCards, claimCard=claimCard, selectCombatCard=selectCombatCard,

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local CardInput = require("abyss_card_input")
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    local updateCarry
    local function point(event)
        if not event or type(event.GetUIPos) ~= "function" then return end
        local x,y = event:GetUIPos()
        -- Keep unavailable coordinates compatible, but let field taps reject explicit bad numbers.
        if type(x) == "number" and (x ~= x or math.abs(x) == math.huge)
            or type(y) == "number" and (y ~= y or math.abs(y) == math.huge) then return nil,nil,true end
        if type(x) ~= "number" or type(y) ~= "number" then return end
        local width,height = owner.canvasWidth or Theme.canvas.base[1],owner.canvasHeight or Theme.canvas.base[2]
        local k = math.min(width/Theme.canvas.base[1],height/Theme.canvas.base[2])
        return (x-width/2)/k,(y-height/2)/k
    end
    local function retireInterruptedPress(event)
        local g = owner.gesture
        if not g or g.touch ~= (event and event.touchId) then return false end
        -- Another Down from the same pointer starts a new physical sequence.
        -- Its previous Up may have been lost outside the native hit surface.
        -- A different touch must never steal a live drag.
        g.input.held, g.input.released = nil, nil
        owner.gesture, owner.carry, owner.selected = nil, nil, nil
        owner.hover, owner.handHover, owner.help = nil, nil, nil
        owner.suppressClick = true
        if g.moving then host.cardView.renderDrag() end
        return true
    end
    local function down(event)
        retireInterruptedPress(event)
        ownership.pointerObserved = true
        owner.help=nil
        if owner.active and not owner.busy and not owner.gesture and event and event.touchId == ownership.releasedDragTouch then
            ownership.releasedDragTouch = nil -- a new physical sequence owns this touch again
        end
        if not owner.gesture then owner.suppressClick = false end
        owner.swallow = nil
        if owner.gesture or not dependencies.closeInfo() then return false end
        owner.swallow = {touch = event and event.touchId}
        owner:render()
        return true
    end
    local function swallowed(event)
        local swallow = owner.swallow
        if swallow and swallow.touch == (event and event.touchId) then owner.swallow = nil return true end
        if not dependencies.closeInfo() then return false end -- click-only hosts dismiss on the click itself
        owner:render()
        return true
    end
    local function move(event, input)
        local g = owner.gesture
        if not g or not event or event.touchId ~= g.touch then return end
        -- A reused touch ID does not transfer ownership between card controls.
        -- The overlay may continue only the current held gesture and card UID.
        if input and input ~= g.input or g.input.held ~= g or not dependencies.cardReady(g) then return end
        local x,y = point(event)
        if not x then return end
        g.x,g.y = x,y
        if (x-g.sx)^2+(y-g.sy)^2 >= L.cardDrag.threshold^2 then g.moving = true end
        if g.moving then
            owner.suppressClick,owner.selected = true,g.uid
            local valid, target, aiming = dependencies.dragTarget(g)
            if g.cancelled then
                g.input.held, g.input.released = nil, nil
                ownership.releasedDragTouch = g.touch

                owner:render(); return
            end
            if g.drawnValid ~= valid or g.drawnTarget ~= target or g.drawnAiming ~= aiming then
                owner:render()
            else
                host.cardView.renderDrag(valid, target, aiming, true)
            end
        end
    end
    updateCarry = function()
        local g = owner.carry
        if not g then return end
        if not dependencies.cardReady(g) or owner.selected ~= g.uid then owner:render(); return end
        if not host.platform.cursorPosition or g.touchScreen then return end
        local x,y = point({GetUIPos=host.platform.cursorPosition})
        if not x or x == g.x and y == g.y then return end
        g.x,g.y = x,y
        local valid,target,aiming = dependencies.dragTarget(g)
        if g.cancelled then
            owner.carry,owner.selected,owner.hover,owner.handHover = nil,nil,nil,nil
            owner:render()
        elseif g.drawnValid ~= valid or g.drawnTarget ~= target or g.drawnAiming ~= aiming then
            owner:render()
        else host.cardView.renderDrag(valid,target,aiming,true) end
    end
    local function releaseCardTap(event, input, ended)
        local touch = event and event.touchId
        -- Missing/invalid coordinates disable dragging, not ordinary C-mode.
        local held = input and input.held
        if held and held.touch == touch then
            if owner.help and owner.help.card == held then owner.help = nil end
            input.held = nil
            input.released = not ended and dependencies.cardReady(held) and held or nil
        elseif ended and input and input.released and input.released.touch == touch then
            input.released = nil
        end
    end
    local function finishCardRelease(g, event, ended)
        local x = point(event)
        local valid,target = false,nil
        if x and g.moving then valid,target = dependencies.dragTarget(g) end
        owner.gesture = nil -- consume before invoking the command or any rendering callback
        if not g.moving then
            g.input.released = not ended and g or nil
            return
        end

        -- Keep unavailable coordinates compatible, but let field taps reject explicit bad numbers.
        if type(x) == "number" and (x ~= x or math.abs(x) == math.huge)
            or type(y) == "number" and (y ~= y or math.abs(y) == math.huge) then return nil,nil,true end
        if type(x) ~= "number" or type(y) ~= "number" then return end
        local width,height = owner.canvasWidth or Theme.canvas.base[1],owner.canvasHeight or Theme.canvas.base[2]
        local k = math.min(width/Theme.canvas.base[1],height/Theme.canvas.base[2])
        return (x-width/2)/k,(y-height/2)/k
    end

        end

        if not g or g.touch ~= (event and event.touchId) then return false end

        -- Its previous Up may have been lost outside the native hit surface.
        -- A different touch must never steal a live drag.
        g.input.held, g.input.released = nil, nil
        owner.gesture, owner.carry, owner.selected = nil, nil, nil
        owner.hover, owner.handHover, owner.help = nil, nil, nil
        owner.suppressClick = true
        if g.moving then host.cardView.renderDrag() end

        owner.swallow = {touch = event and event.touchId}

        return true

            g.input.released = nil

-- Card faces, placement and drag trajectory only. The host owns input validity
-- and commands; the core supplies costs, previews and playability.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local CardSkin = require('abyss_card_skin')
local CardDisplay = require("abyss_card_display")
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local C, L = Theme.color, Theme.layout
local D = L.cardDrag
local typeNames = { attack = "攻击", skill = "技能", power = "能力", status = "状态", curse = "诅咒" }
local M = {}

local function lerpSnap(value, target, dt, rate, threshold)
    local nextValue=value+(target-value)*math.min(1,dt*rate)
    return math.abs(nextValue-target)<threshold and target or nextValue
end

local function handTarget(count, index, hot, point)
    local restAngle=-(index-(count-1)/2)*L.hand.arcDegrees
    return {x=point[1],y=point[2],scale=hot and Theme.motion.hoverScale or 1,
        angle=hot and 0 or restAngle,restAngle=restAngle,
        baseY=point[2]-(hot and Theme.motion.hoverLift or 0)}
end

local function placeHandHit(box, pose, target)
    local w,h=L.card.size[1],L.card.size[2]
    local r=target.restAngle*math.pi/180
    local c,s=math.abs(math.cos(r)),math.abs(math.sin(r))
    local restH,restW=(h*c+w*s)/2,(w*c+h*s)/2
    local hotH=h*Theme.motion.hoverScale/2
    local low=math.min(target.baseY-restH,target.baseY+Theme.motion.hoverLift-hotH)
    local high=math.max(target.baseY+restH,target.baseY+Theme.motion.hoverLift+hotH)
    local dy,a=(low+high)/2-pose.y,pose.angle*math.pi/180
    local hit=box:GetChild('hit')
    hit:SetAnchoredPosition(math.sin(a)*dy/pose.scale,math.cos(a)*dy/pose.scale)
    hit:SetSizeDelta(math.max(restW*2,w*Theme.motion.hoverScale)/pose.scale,(high-low)/pose.scale)
    hit:SetLocalScale(1,1,1);hit.localRotationZ=-pose.angle
end

local function applyHandPose(entry)
    local box,pose=entry.box,entry.current
    box:SetAnchoredPosition(pose.x,pose.y)
    box:SetLocalScale(pose.scale,pose.scale,1)
    box.localRotationZ=pose.angle
    placeHandHit(box,pose,entry.target)
end

local function advancePose(entry, dt, fast)
    local pose,target=entry.current,entry.target
    for _=1,fast and 2 or 1 do
        pose.x=lerpSnap(pose.x,target.x,dt,6,Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920)
        pose.y=lerpSnap(pose.y,target.y,dt,6,Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920)
    end
    pose.scale=lerpSnap(pose.scale,target.scale,dt,7.5,0.003)
    pose.angle=lerpSnap(pose.angle,target.angle,dt,12,0.003)
end

local function pileMembership(battle)
    local result={}
    for _,name in ipairs({"draw","discard","exhaust"}) do
        for _,card in ipairs(battle and battle[name] or {}) do result[card.uid]=true end
    end
    return result
end

local function cardDefinition(data, battle, instance, id)
    local definition = instance and Combat.cardDefinition(battle, instance)
    if definition then return definition end
    for _, card in ipairs(data.cards.cards) do
        if card.id == id then return card end
    end
end

local function repeatCount(definition, instance)
    return instance and definition.repeatable and (instance.upgrades or 1) or nil
end

local function costText(definition)
    if definition.cost == -2 then return "" end
    if definition.costMode == "all_energy" then return "X" end
    return number(definition.cost)
end

local function missingFace(data,id)
    local metadata=(data.cards.sourcePools and data.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata or {})[id] or {}
    local text='此卡牌尚未实装，无法领取。可选择其他卡牌或跳过。'
    return {type=metadata.type or 'status',rarity=metadata.rarity},
        {name=metadata.sourceId or id,text=text,upgradeText=text}
end

local function rewardFace(context,definition,display,id,slot)
    local missing=not definition or not display
    local upgraded=context.run.rewards.cardUpgrades and context.run.rewards.cardUpgrades[slot]
    if missing then definition,display=missingFace(context.data,id)
    elseif upgraded then
        definition=Combat.copy(definition)
        for key,value in pairs(definition.upgrade or {})do definition[key]=Combat.copy(value)end
    end
    return definition,display,missing,upgraded
end

function M.new(view, controls)
    local child, show = controls.child, controls.show
    local ink, tint, picture = controls.ink, controls.tint, controls.picture
    local placeCard, placeReward = controls.placeCard, controls.placeReward
    local dragTarget, dragPose, enemyPosition = controls.dragTarget, controls.dragPose, controls.enemyPosition
    local handBattle,handPoses,previousPiles=nil,{},{}
    local handWidth,handHeight
    local function syncHandViewport(current)
        if current~=handBattle or view.canvasWidth~=handWidth or view.canvasHeight~=handHeight then
            -- Resizing invalidates a captured drag. Its old display coordinates
            -- cannot survive after the capture layer has been removed.
            handBattle,handPoses,previousPiles=current,{},{}
            handWidth,handHeight=view.canvasWidth,view.canvasHeight
        end
    end
    local function handPose(box,instance,count,index,hot)
        local point=placeCard(box,count,index,hot)
        local target=handTarget(count,index,hot,point)
        local entry=handPoses[instance.uid]
        if not entry then
            entry={current={x=target.x,y=target.y,scale=target.scale,angle=target.angle}}
            if previousPiles[instance.uid] then
                -- AbstractPlayer.draw/CardGroup.moveToHand start at the draw pile,
                -- at .12 against the source's ordinary .75 hand scale.
                entry.current={x=L.drawPile.position[1],y=L.drawPile.position[2],scale=0.12/0.75,angle=0}
            end
            handPoses[instance.uid]=entry
        end
        entry.box,entry.target,entry.visible=box,target,true
        applyHandPose(entry)
        return {entry.current.x,entry.current.y}
    end
    local function currentAim()
        local held = view.gesture or view.carry
        if held and held.moving then
            local _, target = dragTarget(held)
            return held.uid, target
        end
    end

    local function bodyText(card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local instance, definition, display = card.instance, card.definition, card.display
        if instance and definition.originalV4 and view.busy then return "效果结算中" end
        if not instance then
            if card.missing then return display.text end
            return CardDisplay.permanentText(display,definition,{upgraded=card.upgraded==true})
        end
        -- The core previews upgrade, growth and every current modifier;
        -- a card being aimed shows the value for that target.
        local target = instance.uid == aimUid and aimTarget or nil
        local preview = Combat.cardPreview(battle, instance, target)
        return CardDisplay.combatText(display, definition, instance, preview)
    end

    local function writeName(box, card)
        local instance = card.instance
        CardDisplay.writeTitle(box:GetChild("name"), card.display.name, card.upgraded,
            repeatCount(card.definition, instance),box:GetChild("type"),
            typeNames[card.definition.type] or card.definition.type)
        ink(box:GetChild("name"), Theme.cardSkin.text.title)
    end

    local function writeDetails(box, card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local definition, enabled = card.definition, card.enabled
        local text = bodyText(card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        CardDisplay.writeBody(box:GetChild("label"), text)
        ink(box:GetChild("label"), C.text)
        box:GetChild("cost").text = card.missing and '—' or costText(definition)
        ink(box:GetChild("cost"), enabled and C.energy or C.danger)
        tint(box:GetChild("costDisc"), enabled and C.energy or C.energyEmpty)
    end

    local function writeFrame(box, card, hovered)
        local definition, enabled = card.definition, card.enabled
        tint(box:GetChild("border"), (card.selected or hovered) and C.goldBright
            or enabled and (C.rarity[definition.rarity] or C.line) or C.line)
        -- The title banner and its rule carry rarity, as on the original cards.
        tint(box:GetChild("nameBand"), C.rarityBand[definition.rarity] or C.rarityBand.basic)
        tint(box:GetChild("nameRule"), C.rarity[definition.rarity] or C.line)
        tint(box:GetChild("artPlate"), enabled and (C.cardType[definition.type] or C.panelRaised) or C.panelSunken)

    end

    local function place(box, card, context, i)

            pose = placeReward(box, #context.rewards, i, view.rewardView.cards[i], view.hover == i)
        else
            local count = context.fighting and #context.battle.hand or #context.rewards
            local hot=card.selected==true or context.active and view.hover==i
            pose=card.instance and handPose(box,card.instance,count,i-1,hot) or placeCard(box,count,i-1,hot)

    end

    local function slotCard(context, instance, id, slot)
        local definition=cardDefinition(context.data, context.battle, instance, id)
        local display=context.presentation[id]
        local missing,upgraded
        if context.reward then definition,display,missing,upgraded=rewardFace(context,definition,display,id,slot)
        else assert(display,'missing card presentation '..id);upgraded=instance and instance.upgraded end
        local enabled,reason=not missing and context.reward,nil
        if not missing and not context.reward then
            enabled,reason=Combat.canPlay(context.battle,instance.uid,view.target)
            enabled=context.active and enabled
        end
        return {
            instance = instance,
            definition = definition,display = display,missing=missing,upgraded=upgraded,
            enabled = enabled,blockReason=reason,
            selected = instance and instance.uid == view.selected,
        }
    end

    local function writeSkin(box,card,context,hovered)
        local base=card.instance and context.battle.catalog.cards[card.instance.cardId] or card.definition
        local printed=card.upgraded and base.upgrade and base.upgrade.cost or base.cost
        CardSkin.apply(box,card.definition,controls.platform,{dim=not card.enabled,selected=card.selected or hovered,
            cost=card.definition.cost,baseCost=printed,blockReason=card.blockReason})
    end

    local function renderSlot(context, i, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local box = child("card" .. i)
        local instance = context.fighting and context.battle.hand[i]
        local id = instance and instance.cardId or context.rewards[i]
        box:SetVisible(id ~= nil and id ~= false)
        if not id then CardDisplay.clearNativeArt(box);return end
        local card = slotCard(context, instance, id, i)
        writeName(box, card)
        writeDetails(box, card, context.battle, aimUid, aimTarget)

    local function renderCards(data, presentation, battle, fighting, active, reward, picking)

        for i = 1, 10 do
            local card, hotBox = renderSlot(context, i, aimUid, aimTarget)
            if card then playable = playable or card.enabled end

    end

    local function placeDraggedCard(box, g, aiming)
        local x, y = dragPose(g)

        box:SetLocalScale(D.scale, D.scale, 1)

        local entry=handPoses[g.uid]
        if entry then entry.current={x=x,y=y,scale=D.scale,angle=0} end
        return x, y, h
    end

    local function aimEndpoint(g, target, enemy)
        if enemy then
            local tx, _, portrait, _, ty = enemyPosition(g.battle, target)
            return tx, ty or L.enemyRow.y, portrait + D.reticlePad
        end
        return g.x, g.y, D.aimDot[2] * 2
    end

    local function renderReticle(layer, aiming, ex, ey, ring, enemy)
        local reticle = layer:GetChild("reticle")
        reticle:SetVisible(aiming == true)
        reticle:SetAnchoredPosition(ex, ey)
        reticle:SetSizeDelta(ring, ring)
        tint(reticle, enemy and C.danger or C.textDim)
    end

    local function renderArc(layer, aiming, sx, sy, ex, fy, enemy)

            local dot, t = layer:GetChild("aim" .. i), i/D.aimDots
            dot:SetVisible(aiming == true)
            if aiming then

                -- Quadratic Bezier with its control point at (start x, end y): rises, then bends over.
