-- Card faces, placement and drag trajectory only. The host owns input validity
-- and commands; the core supplies costs, previews and playability.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local CardSkin = require('abyss_card_skin')
local CardDisplay = require("abyss_card_display")
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local C, L = Theme.color, Theme.layout
local D = L.cardDrag
local typeNames = { attack = "攻击", skill = "技能", power = "能力", status = "状态", curse = "诅咒" }
local M = {}

local function lerpSnap(value, target, dt, rate, threshold)
    local nextValue=value+(target-value)*math.min(1,dt*rate)
    return math.abs(nextValue-target)<threshold and target or nextValue
end

local function handTarget(count, index, hot, point)
    local restAngle=-(index-(count-1)/2)*L.hand.arcDegrees
    return {x=point[1],y=point[2],scale=hot and Theme.motion.hoverScale or 1,
        angle=hot and 0 or restAngle,restAngle=restAngle,
        baseY=point[2]-(hot and Theme.motion.hoverLift or 0)}
end

local function placeHandHit(box, pose, target)
    local w,h=L.card.size[1],L.card.size[2]
    local r=target.restAngle*math.pi/180
    local c,s=math.abs(math.cos(r)),math.abs(math.sin(r))
    local restH,restW=(h*c+w*s)/2,(w*c+h*s)/2
    local hotH=h*Theme.motion.hoverScale/2
    local low=math.min(target.baseY-restH,target.baseY+Theme.motion.hoverLift-hotH)
    local high=math.max(target.baseY+restH,target.baseY+Theme.motion.hoverLift+hotH)
    local dy,a=(low+high)/2-pose.y,pose.angle*math.pi/180
    local hit=box:GetChild('hit')
    hit:SetAnchoredPosition(math.sin(a)*dy/pose.scale,math.cos(a)*dy/pose.scale)
    hit:SetSizeDelta(math.max(restW*2,w*Theme.motion.hoverScale)/pose.scale,(high-low)/pose.scale)
    hit:SetLocalScale(1,1,1);hit.localRotationZ=-pose.angle
end

local function applyHandPose(entry)
    local box,pose=entry.box,entry.current
    box:SetAnchoredPosition(pose.x,pose.y)
    box:SetLocalScale(pose.scale,pose.scale,1)
    box.localRotationZ=pose.angle
    placeHandHit(box,pose,entry.target)
end

local function advancePose(entry, dt, fast)
    local pose,target=entry.current,entry.target
    for _=1,fast and 2 or 1 do
        pose.x=lerpSnap(pose.x,target.x,dt,6,Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920)
        pose.y=lerpSnap(pose.y,target.y,dt,6,Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920)
    end
    pose.scale=lerpSnap(pose.scale,target.scale,dt,7.5,0.003)
    pose.angle=lerpSnap(pose.angle,target.angle,dt,12,0.003)
end

local function pileMembership(battle)
    local result={}
    for _,name in ipairs({"draw","discard","exhaust"}) do
        for _,card in ipairs(battle and battle[name] or {}) do result[card.uid]=true end
    end
    return result
end

local function cardDefinition(data, battle, instance, id)
    local definition = instance and Combat.cardDefinition(battle, instance)
    if definition then return definition end
    for _, card in ipairs(data.cards.cards) do
        if card.id == id then return card end
    end
end

local function repeatCount(definition, instance)
    return instance and definition.repeatable and (instance.upgrades or 1) or nil
end

local function costText(definition)
    if definition.cost == -2 then return "" end
    if definition.costMode == "all_energy" then return "X" end
    return number(definition.cost)
end

local function missingFace(data,id)
    local metadata=(data.cards.sourcePools and data.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata or {})[id] or {}
    local text='此卡牌尚未实装，无法领取。可选择其他卡牌或跳过。'
    return {type=metadata.type or 'status',rarity=metadata.rarity},
        {name=metadata.sourceId or id,text=text,upgradeText=text}
end

local function rewardFace(context,definition,display,id,slot)
    local missing=not definition or not display
    local upgraded=context.run.rewards.cardUpgrades and context.run.rewards.cardUpgrades[slot]
    if missing then definition,display=missingFace(context.data,id)
    elseif upgraded then
        definition=Combat.copy(definition)
        for key,value in pairs(definition.upgrade or {})do definition[key]=Combat.copy(value)end
    end
    return definition,display,missing,upgraded
end

function M.new(view, controls)
    local child, show = controls.child, controls.show
    local ink, tint, picture = controls.ink, controls.tint, controls.picture
    local placeCard, placeReward = controls.placeCard, controls.placeReward
    local dragTarget, dragPose, enemyPosition = controls.dragTarget, controls.dragPose, controls.enemyPosition
    local handBattle,handPoses,previousPiles=nil,{},{}
    local handWidth,handHeight
    local function syncHandViewport(current)
        if current~=handBattle or view.canvasWidth~=handWidth or view.canvasHeight~=handHeight then
            -- Resizing invalidates a captured drag. Its old display coordinates
            -- cannot survive after the capture layer has been removed.
            handBattle,handPoses,previousPiles=current,{},{}
            handWidth,handHeight=view.canvasWidth,view.canvasHeight

    local function handPose(box,instance,count,index,hot)
        local point=placeCard(box,count,index,hot)
        local target=handTarget(count,index,hot,point)
        local entry=handPoses[instance.uid]
        if not entry then
            entry={current={x=target.x,y=target.y,scale=target.scale,angle=target.angle}}
            if previousPiles[instance.uid] then
                -- AbstractPlayer.draw/CardGroup.moveToHand start at the draw pile,
                -- at .12 against the source's ordinary .75 hand scale.
                entry.current={x=L.drawPile.position[1],y=L.drawPile.position[2],scale=0.12/0.75,angle=0}
            end
            handPoses[instance.uid]=entry
        end
        entry.box,entry.target,entry.visible=box,target,true
        applyHandPose(entry)
        return {entry.current.x,entry.current.y}
    end
    local function currentAim()
        local held = view.gesture or view.carry
        if held and held.moving then
            local _, target = dragTarget(held)
            return held.uid, target
        end
    end

    local function bodyText(card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local instance, definition, display = card.instance, card.definition, card.display
        if instance and definition.originalV4 and view.busy then return "效果结算中" end
        if not instance then
            if card.missing then return display.text end
            return CardDisplay.permanentText(display,definition,{upgraded=card.upgraded==true})
        end
        -- The core previews upgrade, growth and every current modifier;
        -- a card being aimed shows the value for that target.
        local target = instance.uid == aimUid and aimTarget or nil
        local preview = Combat.cardPreview(battle, instance, target)
        return CardDisplay.combatText(display, definition, instance, preview,battle,target)
    end

    local function writeName(box, card)
        local instance = card.instance
        CardDisplay.writeTitle(box:GetChild("name"), card.display.name, card.upgraded,
            repeatCount(card.definition, instance),box:GetChild("type"),
            typeNames[card.definition.type] or card.definition.type)
        ink(box:GetChild("name"), Theme.cardSkin.text.title)
    end

    local function writeDetails(box, card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local definition, enabled = card.definition, card.enabled
        local text = bodyText(card, battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        CardDisplay.writeBody(box:GetChild("label"), text,box)
        ink(box:GetChild("label"), C.text)
        box:GetChild("cost").text = card.missing and '—' or costText(definition)
        ink(box:GetChild("cost"), enabled and C.energy or C.danger)
        tint(box:GetChild("costDisc"), enabled and C.energy or C.energyEmpty)
    end

    local function writeFrame(box, card, hovered)
        local definition, enabled = card.definition, card.enabled
        tint(box:GetChild("border"), (card.selected or hovered) and C.goldBright
            or enabled and (C.rarity[definition.rarity] or C.line) or C.line)
        -- The title banner and its rule carry rarity, as on the original cards.
        tint(box:GetChild("nameBand"), C.rarityBand[definition.rarity] or C.rarityBand.basic)
        tint(box:GetChild("nameRule"), C.rarity[definition.rarity] or C.line)

        CardDisplay.writeArt(box:GetChild("art"), definition, picture)
        CardDisplay.writeNativeArt(box,definition,card.display.nativeArt,controls.platform,box:GetChild('art'))
    end

    local function place(box, card, context, i)
        local pose

            pose = placeReward(box, #context.rewards, i, view.rewardView.cards[i], view.hover == i)
        else

            local hot=card.selected==true or context.active and view.hover==i
            pose=card.instance and handPose(box,card.instance,count,i-1,hot) or placeCard(box,count,i-1,hot)
        end
        if card.instance then view.cardPositions[card.instance.uid] = pose end
    end

    local function slotCard(context, instance, id, slot)
        local definition=cardDefinition(context.data, context.battle, instance, id)
        local display=context.presentation[id]
        local missing,upgraded
        if context.reward then definition,display,missing,upgraded=rewardFace(context,definition,display,id,slot)
        else assert(display,'missing card presentation '..id);upgraded=instance and instance.upgraded end
        local enabled,reason=not missing and context.reward,nil
        if not missing and not context.reward then
            enabled,reason=Combat.canPlay(context.battle,instance.uid,view.target)
            enabled=context.active and enabled
        end
        return {
            instance = instance,
            definition = definition,display = display,missing=missing,upgraded=upgraded,
            enabled = enabled,blockReason=reason,
            selected = instance and instance.uid == view.selected,
        }
    end

    local function writeSkin(box,card,context,hovered)
        local base=card.instance and context.battle.catalog.cards[card.instance.cardId] or card.definition
        local printed=card.upgraded and base.upgrade and base.upgrade.cost or base.cost
        CardSkin.apply(box,card.definition,controls.platform,{dim=not card.enabled,selected=card.selected or hovered,
            cost=card.definition.cost,baseCost=printed,blockReason=card.blockReason})
    end

    local function renderSlot(context, i, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local box = child("card" .. i)
        local instance = context.fighting and context.battle.hand[i]
        local id = instance and instance.cardId or context.rewards[i]
        box:SetVisible(id ~= nil and id ~= false)
        if not id then CardDisplay.clearNativeArt(box);return end
        local card = slotCard(context, instance, id, i)
        writeName(box, card)
        writeDetails(box, card, context.battle, aimUid, aimTarget)
        local hovered = view.hover == i and (context.reward or context.active)
        writeFrame(box, card, hovered)
        writeSkin(box,card,context,hovered)
        place(box, card, context, i)
        return card, (card.selected or hovered) and box or nil
    end

    local function renderCards(data, presentation, battle, fighting, active, reward, picking)
        local context = { data = data, presentation = presentation, battle = battle, fighting = fighting,run=view.run,
            active = active, reward = reward, rewards = picking and Run.rewardOptions(view.run) or {} }
        local aimUid, aimTarget = currentAim()
        local current=fighting and view.run and view.run.combat
        syncHandViewport(current)
        for _,entry in pairs(handPoses) do entry.visible=false end

        for i = 1, 10 do
            local card, hotBox = renderSlot(context, i, aimUid, aimTarget)
            if card then playable = playable or card.enabled end
            selectedBox = hotBox or selectedBox
        end
        for uid,entry in pairs(handPoses) do if not entry.visible then handPoses[uid]=nil end end
        previousPiles=pileMembership(fighting and battle)
        if selectedBox then selectedBox:SetAsLastSibling() end
        return playable
    end

    local function placeDraggedCard(box, g, aiming)
        local x, y = dragPose(g)
        local h = L.card.size[2] * D.scale
        -- An aiming card parks under the line so it never hides the enemy row.
        if aiming then
            local floor = -Theme.canvas.base[2]/2 + Theme.canvas.safe.y + h/2
            -- Preserve the grabbed column; centring here looks like the held
            -- card has snapped onto an unrelated card in the middle of the hand.
            x, y = g.origin[1], math.max(floor,(g.touchScreen and 260 or 126)*g.sourceScale-Theme.canvas.base[2]/2)

        local entry=handPoses[g.uid]
        if entry then entry.current={x=x,y=y,scale=D.scale,angle=0} end
        return x, y, h
    end

            local tx, _, portrait, _, ty = enemyPosition(g.battle, target)
            return tx, ty or L.enemyRow.y, portrait + D.reticlePad
        end
        return g.x, g.y, D.aimDot[2] * 2
    end

        local reticle = layer:GetChild("reticle")
        reticle:SetVisible(aiming == true)
        reticle:SetAnchoredPosition(ex, ey)
        reticle:SetSizeDelta(ring, ring)
        tint(reticle, enemy and C.danger or C.textDim)
    end

    local function renderArc(layer, aiming, sx, sy, ex, fy, enemy)
        for i = 1, D.aimDots do
            local dot, t = layer:GetChild("aim" .. i), i/D.aimDots
            dot:SetVisible(aiming == true)

                local u, size = 1-t, D.aimDot[1] + (D.aimDot[2] - D.aimDot[1])*t
                -- Quadratic Bezier with its control point at (start x, end y): rises, then bends over.
                dot:SetAnchoredPosition(u*u*sx + 2*u*t*sx + t*t*ex, u*u*sy + 2*u*t*fy + t*t*fy)
                dot:SetSizeDelta(size, size)
                -- Gold trail; once an enemy is locked the last 40% turns red so the lock reads at a glance.

        local _,target,aiming=controls.potionTarget(potion)

    end

        local potion=not g and view.potionAim
        if potion and potion.moving then renderPotionDrag(potion);return true end

    end

            layer:SetAsLastSibling()

  local after=isolated.combat.enemies[i]
  if after and after.id==enemy.id then result[i]={hp=after.hp,loss=math.max(0,enemy.hp-after.hp)}end
 end
 return result
end

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, _ownership, host, dependencies)
    local function statusActorAt(slot)
        local battle=owner.run and owner.run.combat
        if not battle then return end
        if slot==0 then return battle,0,battle.player end
        local entry=dependencies.enemyAt(slot,battle)
        if entry then return battle,entry.index,entry.actor end
    end
    local function bindDetailControls()
        -- Enemy portraits keep targeting; the hero portrait and every status row only open
        -- details, so a status tap never plays a card or moves the potion target.
        dependencies.listen(dependencies.child("hero"):GetChild("hit"), function() owner:showStatus(0) end)
        for i, name in ipairs({"hero", "enemy1", "enemy2", "enemy3", "enemy4", "enemy5"}) do
            local screenSlot = i - 1
            dependencies.listen(dependencies.child(name):GetChild("statusRow"):GetChild("hit"), function()
                local entry=screenSlot>0 and dependencies.enemyAt(screenSlot)
                if screenSlot==0 or entry then owner:showStatus(entry and entry.index or 0) end
            end)
        end
        local info = dependencies.child("statusInfo")
        info.disableCursorEventPassthrough = true
        dependencies.listen(info:GetChild("hit"), function() if dependencies.closeInfo() then owner:render() end end)
        -- A tap on the card itself turns to the next page; a single page closes like any tap.
        -- Not routed through listen(): that dismisses the open card before any handler runs.
        local function infoPage()
            local open = owner.info
            if not open then return end
            owner.swallow = nil
            if (open.pages or 1) > 1 then open.page = open.page % open.pages + 1 owner:render()
            elseif dependencies.closeInfo() then owner:render() end
        end
        info:GetChild("page"):AddCursorEventListener(host.clickEvent,function()
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(host.controller)then return false end
            return infoPage()
        end)

-- Read-only intent projection. Core preview APIs retain all combat arithmetic.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Events = require("abyss_events")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local StatusView = require("abyss_battle_status_view")
local EndingIntent = require('abyss_battle_ending_intent')
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local M = {}
local C = Theme.color
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local intentLabels = { defend = "防御", buff = "强化", debuff = "削弱", charge = "蓄能", sleep = "沉睡",
    unknown = "未知", stunned = "苏醒", split = "分裂", escape = "逃跑" }
local effectKinds = { damage = "attack", block = "defend", gainStatus = "buff",
    applyStatus = "debuff", makeTempCardInDiscard = "debuff", enemyVampireDamage = "attack",
    enemyHealAll = "buff", enemyStrengthAll = "buff", enemyCleanse = "buff",
    heartStatusDraw='debuff',spireBashDebuff='debuff',heartPainfulStabs='buff',
    enemyRally = 'buff', enemyEncourage = 'buff', enemyTorchSpawn = 'buff', enemyTorchRevive = 'buff',
    enemyBronzeSpawn = 'buff', enemyStasis = 'debuff', writhingParasite='debuff', enemyBurnBoth='debuff', enemyDazedDraw='debuff',awakenedVoid='debuff' }

-- Mixed moves show the first other effect kind in the original icon priority.
function M.intentBadge(intent)
    for _, kind in ipairs({ "debuff", "defend", "buff", "attack" }) do
        if kind ~= intent.kind then
            for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects or {}) do
                if effectKinds[effect.op] == kind then return kind end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Compact icons share the detail projection; numeric detail glyphs are not intents.
-- Stable threat priority is independent of effect execution order in the core.
function M.icons(face)
    local found, result = {}, {}
    if face.kind then found[face.kind] = true end
    for _, row in ipairs(face.rows or {}) do
        if type(row.icon) == 'string' and Theme.icon.intent[row.icon] then found[row.icon] = true end
    end
    for _, kind in ipairs({'attack','defend','buff','debuff','charge','sleep','stunned','split','escape','unknown'}) do
        if found[kind] and #result < 3 then result[#result + 1] = kind end
    end
    if #result == 0 then result[1] = 'unknown' end
    return result
end

local function special(kind, icon, text, note)
    return { value = "", kind = icon, label = intentLabels[kind], text = text,
        rows = {{ icon = icon, colour = C.textDim, name = intentLabels[kind], text = text, note = note }} }
end

local specialIntents = {
    unknown = function(_,enemy)
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='darkling'then
            local view=special('unknown','unknown','再生：本次行动不攻击，随后准备复生；全部共生暗影同时休眠才会被击败。')
            view.label,view.rows[1].name='再生','再生';return view
        end
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='awakened_one'then
            return special('unknown','unknown','重生：本次行动恢复至300点生命，随后进入第二形态。')
        end
        return special('unknown','unknown','下一步行动未知。')
    end,
    escape = function()
        return special("escape", "unknown", "逃离战场，不返还已窃取的金币。")
    end,
    charge = function()
        return special("charge", "unknown", "本回合不攻击，正在蓄能。", "蓄满后发动攻击")
    end,
    sleep = function()
        return special("sleep", "sleep", "沉睡中，本回合不行动。", "损失生命就会惊醒")
    end,
    stunned = function(_, enemy)
        if enemy.definitionId ~= 'lagavulin' then
            return {value='',kind='unknown',label='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。',
                rows={{icon='unknown',colour=C.textDim,name='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。'}}}
        end
        return special("stunned", "unknown", "刚被惊醒，本回合不行动。")
    end,
    split = function(state, enemy)
        local children=enemy.ai.splitEnemies
        local child = state.catalog.enemies[children and children[1] or enemy.ai.splitEnemy]
        local names=children and (child.name .. '和' .. state.catalog.enemies[children[2]].name) or ('两只' .. child.name)
        return special("split", "unknown", "分裂为" .. names .. "，各自生命等于分裂时的当前生命。")
    end,
}

local function goneView(state, index)
    local gone = state.enemies[index] and state.enemies[index].escaped and "已逃跑" or "已击败"
    return { value = "", kind = "unknown", label = gone, text = gone, rows = {} }
end

local function newPreview(state, index, intent)
    local preview = Events.frame(state)
    preview.rules,preview.catalog=state.rules,state.catalog
    preview.events = {}
    local soften = state.originalV4 and require("abyss_original_v4").intentReduction(state, index) or 0
    return { state = state, enemy = state.enemies[index], intent = intent, preview = preview,
        copy = preview.enemies[index], player = preview.player, soften = soften, result = {}, rows = {} }
end

local function theft(v)
    local ai = v.enemy.ai
    if not ai or ai.kind ~= "looter" or (v.intent.id ~= ai.mugIntent and v.intent.id ~= ai.lungeIntent) then return end
    local gold = number(ai.stealAmount)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = "先窃取最多 " .. gold .. " 金币（完全格挡仍会失金）"
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = Theme.icon.gold.id, colour = C.debuff, name = "窃金 " .. gold,
        text = "先窃取你最多 " .. gold .. " 金币", note = "完全格挡仍会失金" }
end

local function attackHits(v, effect)
    local amount = Combat.intentAttackAmount(v.preview, v.copy, v.player, effect.value)
    local times = effect.times or 1
    local hits, total, unequal = {}, 0, false
    for hit = 1, times do
        local cut = math.min(amount, v.soften)
        v.soften = v.soften - cut
        hits[hit] = amount - cut
        total = total + hits[hit]
        if hit > 1 and hits[hit] ~= hits[1] then unequal = true end
    end
    return hits, total, unequal, times
end

local function attackFace(hits, times, unequal)
    if unequal then
        local values = {}
        for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do values[#values + 1] = number(hit) end
        return table.concat(values, "+")
    end
    return number(hits[1]) .. (times > 1 and "×" .. times or "")
end

local function attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, singlePrefix)
    if unequal then return "依次攻击 " .. face .. " 点伤害" end
    if times > 1 then return "攻击 " .. times .. " 次，每次 " .. each .. " 点伤害" end
    return singlePrefix .. each .. " 点伤害"
end

local function attackEffect(v, effect)
    local hits, total, unequal, times = attackHits(v, effect)
    local amount, each = hits[1], number(hits[1])
    local face = attackFace(hits, times, unequal)
    v.attack = v.attack or face
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, "攻击造成 ")
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "attack", colour = C.danger, name = "攻击 " .. face,
        tag = times > 1 and "共 " .. number(total) or nil,
        text = attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, "造成 "),
        note = amount ~= effect.value and "基础 " .. number(effect.value) .. "，已计入双方力量、虚弱与易伤" or nil }
end

local function blockEffect(v, effect)
    local master = effect.target == 'automaton'
    local amount = number(Combat.blockAmount(v.state, v.copy, effect.value, effect.fixed or master or effect.target == "random_ally"))
    local ally = effect.target == "random_ally"
    local text = effect.target=='all_allies' and '敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..amount..' 点格挡'
        or master and '使青铜机枢获得 '..amount..' 点格挡'
        or ally and "让一名随机队友获得 " .. amount .. " 点格挡（没有队友时给自己）" or "获得 " .. amount .. " 点格挡"
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = text
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "defend", colour = C.block, name = "格挡 " .. amount,
        text = text,
        note = ally and "没有队友时给自己" or nil }
end

local function statusSentence(gain, effect, status, size)
    return (gain and "自身" or "使你") .. (effect.value < 0 and "失去 " or "获得 ")
        .. size .. (status.stack == "duration" and " 回合" or " 层") .. status.name
end

local function statusRow(v, effect, gain, status, size, sentence)
    local entry = { id = effect.status, amount = effect.value, temporary = 0, kind = status.kind,
        description = status.description, stack = status.stack }
    local kind = gain and StatusView.statusKind(entry) == "buff" and "buff" or "debuff"
    return { icon = kind, colour = intentColors[kind],
        name = status.name .. " " .. (effect.value < 0 and StatusView.signed(effect.value) or size),
        tag = status.stack == "duration" and "持续 " .. size .. " 回合" or nil,
        text = sentence, note = (StatusView.statusDetail(entry, v.state.rules, v.enemy)) }
end

local function statusEffect(v, effect)
    local gain = effect.op == "gainStatus"
    -- Each copied status passes ApplyPower before later effects read it. Artifact
    -- is spent in order and can reject a status before its addition overflows.
    Actors.applyPower(v.preview, gain and v.copy or v.player, effect.status, effect.value, v.copy)
    local status = assert(v.state.catalog.statuses[effect.status])
    local size = number(math.abs(effect.value))
    local sentence = statusSentence(gain, effect, status, size)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = sentence
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = statusRow(v, effect, gain, status, size, sentence)
end

local function discardEffect(v, effect)
    local value = number(effect.value)
    local name = assert(v.state.catalog.cards[effect.card]).name
    if effect.upgraded or effect.card=='burn' and v.enemy.hexBurnUpgraded then name=name..'+'end
    local text = "将 " .. value .. " 张「" .. name .. "」放入你的弃牌堆"
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = text
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "debuff", colour = C.debuff, name = "塞入「" .. name .. "」×" .. value, text = text }
end

local function unknownEffect(v)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = "未知"
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "unknown", colour = C.textDim, name = "未知", text = "下一步行动未知" }
end

local function burnBothEffect(v)
    local name=assert(v.state.catalog.cards.burn).name
    local text='将 1 张「'..name..'」放入你的抽牌堆，另 1 张放入弃牌堆'
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='debuff',colour=C.debuff,name='塞入「'..name..'」×2',text=text}
end

local function dazedDrawEffect(v)
    local name=assert(v.state.catalog.cards.dazed).name
    local text='将 2 张「'..name..'」随机放入你的抽牌堆'
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='debuff',colour=C.debuff,name='塞入「'..name..'」×2',text=text}
end

local function act2Row(v, name, text, kind, note)
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon=kind,colour=intentColors[kind],name=name,text=text,note=note}
end
local function vampireEffect(v,effect)
    attackEffect(v,effect)
    act2Row(v,'吸血','按你实际损失的生命回复自身生命','buff','格挡部分不产生治疗')
end
local function stasisEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'扣押卡牌','扣押抽牌堆中的一张牌；抽牌堆为空时从弃牌堆选择。击败此浮核后归还，满手时放入弃牌堆',
        'debuff','优先稀有，其次罕见、普通；同稀有度随机选择')
end
local function summonEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.op=='enemyEncourage' then
        name,text='鼓舞','敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..number(effect.value)..' 层力量，其他队友各获得 6 点格挡'
    elseif effect.op=='reptomancerSummon'then name,text='召唤','召唤 1 把浮游蛇刃，补充空位（最多 4 把）'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyRally' then name,text='召唤','召唤最多 2 名随从，补充空位'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyTorchSpawn' then name,text='召唤','召唤 2 名燃炬随从'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyBronzeSpawn' then name,text='召唤','召唤 2 名青铜浮核'
    else name,text='复活','复活已倒下的燃炬随从，存活随从保持原状态' end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function groupEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.op=='enemyHealAll' then
        name,text='群体治疗 '..number(effect.value),'敌方全体存活单位各回复最多 '..number(effect.value)..' 点生命'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyStrengthAll' then
        name,text='群体力量 '..number(effect.value),'敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..number(effect.value)..' 层力量'
    else name,text='净化','移除自身全部负面状态及暂时失去力量的状态' end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function parasiteEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'寄生','永久获得一张寄生诅咒；本场战斗的牌堆不加入此牌','debuff','整场战斗只施放一次；御守可阻止获得')
end
local function awakenedVoidEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'虚空','将1张虚空放入抽牌堆的随机位置','debuff','抽到时失去1点能量；虚无')
end
local function timeEaterEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.kind=='cleanse'then name,text='净化','移除自身所有减益（保留正力量）'
    elseif effect.kind=='removeShackled'then name,text='解除力量恢复','移除暂时失去力量的恢复状态'
    else name,text='加速治疗','回复至 '..number(math.floor(v.enemy.maxHp/2))..' 点生命（行动时确定治疗量）'end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function daggerSacrificeEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'自毁','自毁：攻击后失去等于行动开始时生命的生命值（无视格挡）','debuff')
end

    enemyBurnBoth=burnBothEffect,enemyDazedDraw=dazedDrawEffect,
    enemyVampireDamage=vampireEffect,enemyStasis=stasisEffect,
    enemyRally=summonEffect,enemyTorchSpawn=summonEffect,enemyTorchRevive=summonEffect,
    enemyEncourage=summonEffect,enemyBronzeSpawn=summonEffect,
    enemyHealAll=groupEffect,enemyStrengthAll=groupEffect,enemyCleanse=groupEffect,
    gainStatus = statusEffect, applyStatus = statusEffect, makeTempCardInDiscard = discardEffect }

local function joinedView(v)
    local intent = v.intent
    return { value = v.attack or (intent.kind == "attack" and "?" or ""), kind = intent.kind, badge = M.intentBadge(intent),
        label = intent.kind ~= "attack" and intentLabels[intent.kind] or nil,
        text = #v.result > 0 and table.concat(v.result, "；") or "下一步行动未知。", rows = v.rows }
end

-- One ordered preview supplies the compact face, joined text and detail rows.
function M.intentView(state, index)
    local intent = Combat.intent(state, index)
    if not intent then return goneView(state, index) end
    intent=EndingIntent.project(state,state.enemies[index],intent)
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='darkling'and intent.id=='reincarnate'then
        local hp=number(math.floor(state.enemies[index].maxHp/2))
        return {value='',kind='buff',label='复生',text='本次行动回复 '..hp..' 点生命，恢复共生，随后重新选招。',
            rows={{icon='buff',colour=C.buff,name='复生',text='回复 '..hp..' 点生命并恢复共生。'}}}
    end
    local describeSpecial = specialIntents[intent.kind]
    -- Summon retains the source unknown face, but its bounded definition has
    -- a useful Chinese detail row. Do not suppress Awakened/Darkling unknowns.
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='reptomancer'and intent.id=='summon'then
        describeSpecial=nil
    end
    if describeSpecial then return describeSpecial(state, state.enemies[index]) end
    local view = newPreview(state, index, intent)
    theft(view)
    for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects) do
        local describe = effects[effect.op]
        if describe then describe(view,effect)
        elseif not EndingIntent.describe(view,effect)then unknownEffect(view)end
    end
    if view.enemy.ai and view.enemy.ai.kind=='act1_boss' and intent.id=='inferno'then
        act2Row(view,'灼伤强化','升级抽牌堆和弃牌堆中的灼伤，并向弃牌堆加入3张灼伤+','debuff')
    end
    return joinedView(view)
end

return M

-- Read-only intent projection. Core preview APIs retain all combat arithmetic.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Events = require("abyss_events")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local StatusView = require("abyss_battle_status_view")
local EndingIntent = require('abyss_battle_ending_intent')
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local M = {}
local C = Theme.color
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local intentLabels = { defend = "防御", buff = "强化", debuff = "削弱", charge = "蓄能", sleep = "沉睡",
    unknown = "未知", stunned = "苏醒", split = "分裂", escape = "逃跑" }
local effectKinds = { damage = "attack", block = "defend", gainStatus = "buff",
    applyStatus = "debuff", makeTempCardInDiscard = "debuff", enemyVampireDamage = "attack",
    enemyHealAll = "buff", enemyStrengthAll = "buff", enemyCleanse = "buff",
    heartStatusDraw='debuff',spireBashDebuff='debuff',heartPainfulStabs='buff',
    enemyRally = 'buff', enemyEncourage = 'buff', enemyTorchSpawn = 'buff', enemyTorchRevive = 'buff',
    enemyBronzeSpawn = 'buff', enemyStasis = 'debuff', writhingParasite='debuff', enemyBurnBoth='debuff', enemyDazedDraw='debuff',awakenedVoid='debuff' }

-- Mixed moves show the first other effect kind in the original icon priority.
function M.intentBadge(intent)
    for _, kind in ipairs({ "debuff", "defend", "buff", "attack" }) do
        if kind ~= intent.kind then
            for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects or {}) do
                if effectKinds[effect.op] == kind then return kind end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Compact icons share the detail projection; numeric detail glyphs are not intents.
-- Stable threat priority is independent of effect execution order in the core.
function M.icons(face)
    local found, result = {}, {}
    if face.kind then found[face.kind] = true end
    for _, row in ipairs(face.rows or {}) do
        if type(row.icon) == 'string' and Theme.icon.intent[row.icon] then found[row.icon] = true end
    end
    for _, kind in ipairs({'attack','defend','buff','debuff','charge','sleep','stunned','split','escape','unknown'}) do
        if found[kind] and #result < 3 then result[#result + 1] = kind end
    end
    if #result == 0 then result[1] = 'unknown' end
    return result
end

local function special(kind, icon, text, note)
    return { value = "", kind = icon, label = intentLabels[kind], text = text,
        rows = {{ icon = icon, colour = C.textDim, name = intentLabels[kind], text = text, note = note }} }
end

local specialIntents = {
    unknown = function(_,enemy)
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='darkling'then
            local view=special('unknown','unknown','再生：本次行动不攻击，随后准备复生；全部共生暗影同时休眠才会被击败。')
            view.label,view.rows[1].name='再生','再生';return view
        end
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='awakened_one'then
            return special('unknown','unknown','重生：本次行动恢复至300点生命，随后进入第二形态。')
        end
        return special('unknown','unknown','下一步行动未知。')
    end,
    escape = function()
        return special("escape", "unknown", "逃离战场，不返还已窃取的金币。")
    end,
    charge = function()
        return special("charge", "unknown", "本回合不攻击，正在蓄能。", "蓄满后发动攻击")
    end,
    sleep = function()
        return special("sleep", "sleep", "沉睡中，本回合不行动。", "损失生命就会惊醒")
    end,
    stunned = function(_, enemy)
        if enemy.definitionId ~= 'lagavulin' then
            return {value='',kind='unknown',label='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。',
                rows={{icon='unknown',colour=C.textDim,name='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。'}}}
        end
        return special("stunned", "unknown", "刚被惊醒，本回合不行动。")
    end,
    split = function(state, enemy)
        local children=enemy.ai.splitEnemies
        local child = state.catalog.enemies[children and children[1] or enemy.ai.splitEnemy]
        local names=children and (child.name .. '和' .. state.catalog.enemies[children[2]].name) or ('两只' .. child.name)
        return special("split", "unknown", "分裂为" .. names .. "，各自生命等于分裂时的当前生命。")
    end,
}

local function goneView(state, index)
    local gone = state.enemies[index] and state.enemies[index].escaped and "已逃跑" or "已击败"
    return { value = "", kind = "unknown", label = gone, text = gone, rows = {} }
end

local function newPreview(state, index, intent)
    local preview = Events.frame(state)
    preview.rules,preview.catalog=state.rules,state.catalog
    preview.events = {}
    local soften = state.originalV4 and require("abyss_original_v4").intentReduction(state, index) or 0
    return { state = state, enemy = state.enemies[index], intent = intent, preview = preview,
        copy = preview.enemies[index], player = preview.player, soften = soften, result = {}, rows = {} }
end

local function theft(v)
    local ai = v.enemy.ai
    if not ai or ai.kind ~= "looter" or (v.intent.id ~= ai.mugIntent and v.intent.id ~= ai.lungeIntent) then return end
    local gold = number(ai.stealAmount)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = "先窃取最多 " .. gold .. " 金币（完全格挡仍会失金）"
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = Theme.icon.gold.id, colour = C.debuff, name = "窃金 " .. gold,
        text = "先窃取你最多 " .. gold .. " 金币", note = "完全格挡仍会失金" }
end

local function attackHits(v, effect)
    local calculation = Combat.intentAttackPreview(v.preview, v.copy, v.player, effect.value)
    local amount = calculation.amount
    local times = effect.times or 1
    local hits, cuts, total, unequal = {}, {}, 0, false
    for hit = 1, times do
        local cut = math.min(amount, v.soften)
        cuts[hit]=cut
        v.soften = v.soften - cut
        hits[hit] = amount - cut
        total = total + hits[hit]
        if hit > 1 and hits[hit] ~= hits[1] then unequal = true end
    end
    return hits, total, unequal, times, calculation, cuts
end

local formulaNames={vigor='活力',double_damage='双倍伤害',pen_nib='钢笔尖',weak='虚弱',
    vulnerable='易伤',stance='姿态',flight='飞行',slow='迟缓',back_attack='背击',truncate='向零取整',binary32='单精度'}
local function decimal(value)return string.format('%.9g',value) end
local function formulaStep(step)
    local value=decimal(step.value)
    if step.kind=='base' then return '基础 '..value end
    if step.kind=='strength' or step.kind=='vigor' then
        return (step.kind=='strength' and '力量' or '活力')..' '..(step.operand>=0 and '+' or '')..decimal(step.operand)..' = '..value
    end
    if step.kind=='round' then return '向下取整且不低于0 = '..value end
    if step.kind=='intangible' then return '无实体 min(当前值, 1) = '..value end
    local operator=step.operand and (' ×'..decimal(step.operand)..' = ') or ' = '
    return (formulaNames[step.kind] or step.kind)..operator..value
end
local function attackFormula(calculation,hits,cuts,times)
    local parts,chunks={},{}
    for _,step in ipairs(calculation.steps)do
        parts[#parts+1]=formulaStep(step)
        if #parts==5 then chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(parts,' → ');parts={} end
    end
    if #parts>0 then chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(parts,' → ') end
    if times>1 then chunks[1]='每段：'..chunks[1] end
    for i,cut in ipairs(cuts)do if cut>0 then
        chunks[#chunks+1]='第'..i..'段削减：'..number(calculation.amount)..' − '..number(cut)..' = '..number(hits[i])
    end end
    return chunks
end

local function attackFace(hits, times, unequal)
    if unequal then
        local values = {}
        for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do values[#values + 1] = number(hit) end
        return table.concat(values, "+")
    end

end

local function attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, singlePrefix)

    for i=2,#formula do v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='attack',colour=C.danger,name='伤害算式（续）',text=formula[i]} end

local function statusSentence(gain, effect, status, size)

end
local effects = { daggerSacrifice=daggerSacrificeEffect,reptomancerSummon=summonEffect,timeEater=timeEaterEffect, writhingParasite=parasiteEffect,awakenedVoid=awakenedVoidEffect,damage = attackEffect, damageAll = attackEffect, block = blockEffect,
    enemyBurnBoth=burnBothEffect,enemyDazedDraw=dazedDrawEffect,
    enemyVampireDamage=vampireEffect,enemyStasis=stasisEffect,
    enemyRally=summonEffect,enemyTorchSpawn=summonEffect,enemyTorchRevive=summonEffect,
    enemyEncourage=summonEffect,enemyBronzeSpawn=summonEffect,
    enemyHealAll=groupEffect,enemyStrengthAll=groupEffect,enemyCleanse=groupEffect,

local function joinedView(v)
    local intent = v.intent
    return { value = v.attack or (intent.kind == "attack" and "?" or ""), kind = intent.kind, badge = M.intentBadge(intent),
        label = intent.kind ~= "attack" and intentLabels[intent.kind] or nil,
        text = #v.result > 0 and table.concat(v.result, "；") or "下一步行动未知。", rows = v.rows }
end

-- One ordered preview supplies the compact face, joined text and detail rows.
function M.intentView(state, index)
    local intent = Combat.intent(state, index)
    if not intent then return goneView(state, index) end
    intent=EndingIntent.project(state,state.enemies[index],intent)
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='darkling'and intent.id=='reincarnate'then
        local hp=number(math.floor(state.enemies[index].maxHp/2))
        return {value='',kind='buff',label='复生',text='本次行动回复 '..hp..' 点生命，恢复共生，随后重新选招。',
            rows={{icon='buff',colour=C.buff,name='复生',text='回复 '..hp..' 点生命并恢复共生。'}}}
    end
    local describeSpecial = specialIntents[intent.kind]
    -- Summon retains the source unknown face, but its bounded definition has
    -- a useful Chinese detail row. Do not suppress Awakened/Darkling unknowns.
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='reptomancer'and intent.id=='summon'then
        describeSpecial=nil
    end
    if describeSpecial then return describeSpecial(state, state.enemies[index]) end
    local view = newPreview(state, index, intent)
    theft(view)
    for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects) do
        local describe = effects[effect.op]
        if describe then describe(view,effect)
        elseif not EndingIntent.describe(view,effect)then unknownEffect(view)end
    end
    if view.enemy.ai and view.enemy.ai.kind=='act1_boss' and intent.id=='inferno'then
        act2Row(view,'灼伤强化','升级抽牌堆和弃牌堆中的灼伤，并向弃牌堆加入3张灼伤+','debuff')
    end
    return joinedView(view)
end

return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
local D = L.cardDrag
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    function owner.openPotionMenu(_,slot)
        if not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or owner.suppressClick or not owner.run
            or owner.run.phase~="combat" or owner.run.combat.phase~="player" then return false end
        if not dependencies.potionBinding(slot)then return false end
        dependencies.cancelPotionAim();dependencies.cancelCardInputs();dependencies.cancelActionInputs()
        owner.selected,owner.carry,owner.help,owner.info=nil,nil,nil,nil
        local opened=host.potionPopup:open(slot)
        if opened then host.stage:GetChild('potionHelp'):SetAsLastSibling();dependencies.refresh()end
        return opened
    end
    local function potionMotionOwner(event,input)
        local held
        if input then held=input.held
        elseif owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.input then held=owner.potionAim.input.held end
        if not held or held.helpOnly or held.touch~=(event and event.touchId) or input and input~=held.input then return end
        return held
    end
    local function potionMotionPoint(held,event)
        local x,y=dependencies.point(event);if not x or not held.sx then return end
        if not held.aim and owner.help and owner.help.fired then return end
        if not held.aim and (x-held.sx)^2+(y-held.sy)^2<D.threshold^2 then return end
        return x,y
    end
    local function prepareMovingPotion(held)
        local item=Run.potionView(owner.run)[held.slot]
        if not item or not item.canUse or item.targetPolicy~='enemy_one' then return false end
        if not held.aim then
            owner.help,owner.info=nil,nil
            dependencies.beginPotionAim({slot=held.slot,id=held.id},item)
            held.aim=owner.potionAim
            held.aim.moving,held.aim.touch,held.aim.input=true,held.touch,held.input
            held.aim.origin=held.origin
        end
        return owner.potionAim==held.aim
    end
    local function movePotion(event,input)
        local held=potionMotionOwner(event,input)
        if not held then return end
        if not dependencies.potionReady(held) then dependencies.cancelPotionAim();held.input.held=nil;owner:render();return end
        local x,y=potionMotionPoint(held,event)
        if not x or not prepareMovingPotion(held) then return end
        held.aim.x,held.aim.y=x,y
        owner.suppressClick=true;owner:render()
    end
    local function releasePotionDrag(event,input)
        local aim=owner.potionAim
        if not aim or not aim.moving or aim.touch~=(event and event.touchId) or input and input~=aim.input then return end
        movePotion(event,input)
        if owner.potionAim~=aim then return end
        local valid,target=dependencies.potionDragTarget(aim)
        -- A drag release must itself carry a valid point. Missing/NaN input
        -- must not reuse an earlier valid enemy position and spend a bottle.
        local x=dependencies.point(event);valid=valid and x~=nil
        aim.input.released=nil;aim.input.consumed={touch=aim.touch}
        if valid then owner.suppressClick=false;return owner:commitPotion(aim.slot,target) end
        dependencies.cancelPotionAim('已取消药水瞄准。');owner.suppressClick=true;dependencies.refresh();return false
    end
    local function potionPressToken(slot,input,event,helpOnly)
        local binding=dependencies.potionBinding(slot)
        if not binding then return end
        local run=owner.run
        local g={slot=binding.slot,id=binding.id,inventory=run.potions,
            run=run,battle=run.combat,turn=run.combat and run.combat.turn,
            touch=event and event.touchId,input=input,helpOnly=helpOnly}
        g.sx,g.sy=dependencies.point(event)
        local offset=helpOnly and L.battlePotions.helpOffset or {0,0}
        g.origin={L.battlePotions.origin[1]+L.battlePotions.step[1]*(slot-1)+offset[1],
            L.battlePotions.origin[2]+L.battlePotions.step[2]*(slot-1)+offset[2]}
        return g
    end
    local function beginPotionPress(slot,control,input,event,helpOnly)
        if owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving and owner.potionAim.touch~=(event and event.touchId) then return end
        ownership.potionPointerObserved=true
        local dismissed=dependencies.down(event)
        input.held,input.released,input.consumed=nil,nil,nil
        if dismissed or owner.gesture or not owner.run then return end
        local g=potionPressToken(slot,input,event,helpOnly)
        if g and dependencies.potionReady(g) then
            input.held=g
            owner:queueHelp(owner:potionHelpSpec(slot),control,true,g.touch)
        end
    end
    local function releasePotionHelp(control,input,touch)
        if not owner.help or owner.help.source~=control then return end
        if owner.help.fired then
            input.released=nil
            input.consumed={touch=touch}
            if owner.info then owner.info.transient=false;owner:render() end
        end
        owner.help=nil
    end
    local function bindPotionControls()
        for i = 1, L.battlePotions.count do
          for _,helpOnly in ipairs({false,true})do
            local slot, control, input = i, dependencies.child((helpOnly and 'potionHelp' or 'potion') .. i), {}
            ownership.potionInputs[#ownership.potionInputs+1] = input
            Controller.bind(host.controller,control,"battle",function()
                if helpOnly then return owner:openHelp(owner:potionHelpSpec(slot),control,false) end
                owner.suppressClick=false;return owner:openPotionMenu(slot)
            end,dependencies.controllerReady,30+slot,"potions")
            control:AddCursorEventListener(host.clickEvent, function(event)
                if Controller.pointerBlocked(host.controller)then return false end
                if input.consumed and input.consumed.touch == (event and event.touchId) then input.consumed=nil return end
                if dependencies.swallowed(event) then return end
                if ownership.potionPointerObserved then
                    local released = input.released
                    if not released or released.touch ~= (event and event.touchId) then return end
                    input.released = nil
                    if not dependencies.potionReady(released) then return end
                end
                if not owner.suppressClick and not owner.gesture then
                    if helpOnly then return owner:openHelp(owner:potionHelpSpec(slot),control,false) end
                    return owner:openPotionMenu(slot)
                end
            end)
            if owner.dragEnabled then
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorDown, function(event)
                    beginPotionPress(slot,control,input,event,helpOnly)
                end)
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorDrag,function(event)
                    if not helpOnly then return movePotion(event,input) end
                end)
                local function releasePotion(event, ended)
                    if owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving then return releasePotionDrag(event,input) end
                    local touch, held = event and event.touchId, input.held
                    if held and held.touch == touch then
                        input.held = nil
                        input.released = not ended and dependencies.potionReady(held) and held or nil
                        releasePotionHelp(control,input,touch)
                    elseif ended and input.released and input.released.touch == touch then
                        input.released = nil
                    end
                end
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorUp, releasePotion)
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorEndDrag, function(event) releasePotion(event, true) end)
            end
          end
        end
    end
    return {
        bindPotionControls=bindPotionControls,movePotion=movePotion,releasePotionDrag=releasePotionDrag
    }

-- Main's small effect/use/discard card. Inventory and effects remain in Run.
local Theme=require('abyss_theme')
local Controller=require('abyss_controller')
local M={}
local P,L=Theme.layout.potionPopup,Theme.layout
local function wrap(text,width)
    local out,line,used={},'',0
    for _,code in utf8.codes(text)do
        local glyph=utf8.char(code)
        local weight=code<128 and .55 or 1
        if code==10 or used+weight>width then
            out[#out+1]=line;line,used='',0
        end
        if code~=10 then line=line..glyph;used=used+weight end
    end
    out[#out+1]=line
    return table.concat(out,'\n'),#out
end
function M.new(root,owner,platform,clickEvent,actions)
    local popup={generation=0}
    local function child(name)return assert(root:GetChild(name),'missing potion popup '..name)end
    local function valid(token)
        local run=owner.run
        return token and owner.active and not owner.busy and not owner.gesture
            and run==token.run and run.phase=='combat' and run.combat==token.battle
            and run.combat.phase=='player' and run.combat.turn==token.turn
            and run.potions==token.inventory and run.potions[token.slot]==token.id
    end

        if not owner.potionMenu then return false end
        owner.potionMenu=nil;popup.generation=popup.generation+1
        root:SetVisible(false);return true
    end
    local function size(name,x,y,w,h)
        local part=child(name);part:SetAnchoredPosition(x,y);part:SetSizeDelta(w,h)
    end
    local function enabled(name,value)
        local part=child(name);part.interactable=value==true;part.raycastTarget=value==true
    end
    function popup.render(_)
        local token=owner.potionMenu
        if not valid(token)then popup:close();root:SetVisible(false);return end
        local item=actions.item(token.slot)
        if not item then popup:close();return end
        local effect,lines=wrap(actions.text(item,token.battle),math.floor((P.width-P.padding*2)/P.font))
        local effectHeight=lines*P.line
        local h=math.max(P.minimumHeight,P.padding*2+P.header+effectHeight+P.gap+P.actionHeight)
        local x=L.battlePotions.origin[1]+(token.slot-1)*L.battlePotions.step[1]
        local y=P.top-h/2
        root:SetAnchoredPosition(x,y);root:SetSizeDelta(P.width,h)
        size('dismiss',-x,-y,Theme.canvas.base[1],Theme.canvas.base[2])
        for _,name in ipairs({'border','plate','hit'})do
            local inset=name=='plate' and 2 or 0
            size(name,0,0,P.width-inset,h-inset)
        end
        local top=h/2-P.padding
        size('title',-P.targetWidth/2,top-P.header/2,P.width-P.padding*2-P.targetWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        size('target',(P.width-P.padding*2-P.targetWidth)/2,top-P.header/2,P.targetWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        size('effect',0,top-P.header-effectHeight/2,P.width-P.padding*2,math.max(L.nativeText.lineHeight,effectHeight))
        child('title').text=item.name
        child('target').text=item.targetPolicy=='enemy_one' and '对一个敌人' or item.targetPolicy=='enemy_all' and '对所有敌人' or '对自己'
        child('effect').text=effect
        local actionY=-h/2+P.padding+P.actionHeight/2
        size('use',-P.width/6,actionY,P.width/2,P.actionHeight)
        size('discard',P.width/3-P.padding/2,actionY,P.width/3-P.padding,P.actionHeight)
        enabled('use',item.canUse);enabled('discard',item.canDiscard~=false)
        root:SetVisible(true);root:SetAsLastSibling()
    end
    function popup.open(_,slot)
        local run=owner.run
        local token=run and {run=run,battle=run.combat,turn=run.combat and run.combat.turn,
            inventory=run.potions,slot=slot,id=run.potions[slot]}
        if not token or not token.id or not valid(token)then return false end
        if owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot then return popup:close() end
        popup.generation=popup.generation+1;owner.potionMenu=token;popup:render();return true
    end
    local function act(name)
        local token=owner.potionMenu
        if not valid(token)then popup:close();return false end
        local item=actions.item(token.slot)
        if name=='use' and not item.canUse or name=='discard' and item.canDiscard==false then return false end
        popup:close()

        return actions[name](token.slot)

                and (not token or token.selection==owner.potionMenu and token.generation==popup.generation)

                if held and held.touch==(event and event.touchId)then

                local touch=event and event.touchId

-- Main's small effect/use/discard card. Inventory and effects remain in Run.
local Theme=require('abyss_theme')
local Controller=require('abyss_controller')
local M={}
local P,L=Theme.layout.potionPopup,Theme.layout
local function wrap(text,width)
    local out,line,used={},'',0
    for _,code in utf8.codes(text)do
        local glyph=utf8.char(code)
        local weight=code<128 and .55 or 1
        if code==10 or used+weight>width then
            out[#out+1]=line;line,used='',0
        end
        if code~=10 then line=line..glyph;used=used+weight end
    end
    out[#out+1]=line
    return table.concat(out,'\n'),#out
end
function M.new(root,owner,platform,clickEvent,actions)
    local popup={generation=0}
    local function child(name)return assert(root:GetChild(name),'missing potion popup '..name)end
    local function valid(token)
        local run=owner.run
        return token and owner.active and not owner.busy and not owner.gesture
            and run==token.run and run.phase=='combat' and run.combat==token.battle
            and run.combat.phase=='player' and run.combat.turn==token.turn
            and run.potions==token.inventory and run.potions[token.slot]==token.id
    end
    function popup.close(_)
        if not owner.potionMenu then return false end
        owner.potionMenu=nil;popup.generation=popup.generation+1
        root:SetVisible(false);return true
    end
    local function size(name,x,y,w,h)
        local part=child(name);part:SetAnchoredPosition(x,y);part:SetSizeDelta(w,h)
    end
    local function enabled(name,value)
        local part=child(name);part.interactable=value==true;part.raycastTarget=value==true
    end
    function popup.render(_)
        local token=owner.potionMenu
        if not valid(token)then popup:close();root:SetVisible(false);return end
        local item=actions.item(token.slot)
        if not item then popup:close();return end
        local effect,lines=wrap(actions.text(item,token.battle),math.floor((P.width-P.padding*2)/P.font))
        local effectHeight=lines*P.line
        local h=math.max(P.minimumHeight,P.padding*2+P.header+effectHeight+P.gap+P.actionHeight)
        local x=L.battlePotions.origin[1]+(token.slot-1)*L.battlePotions.step[1]
        local y=P.top-h/2
        root:SetAnchoredPosition(x,y);root:SetSizeDelta(P.width,h)
        size('dismiss',-x,-y,Theme.canvas.base[1],Theme.canvas.base[2])
        for _,name in ipairs({'border','plate','hit'})do
            local inset=name=='plate' and 2 or 0
            size(name,0,0,P.width-inset,h-inset)
        end
        local top=h/2-P.padding
        size('title',-P.targetWidth/2,top-P.header/2,P.width-P.padding*2-P.targetWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        size('target',(P.width-P.padding*2-P.targetWidth)/2,top-P.header/2,P.targetWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        size('effect',0,top-P.header-effectHeight/2,P.width-P.padding*2,math.max(L.nativeText.lineHeight,effectHeight))
        child('title').text=item.name
        child('target').text=item.targetPolicy=='enemy_one' and '对一个敌人' or item.targetPolicy=='enemy_all' and '对所有敌人' or '对自己'
        child('effect').text=effect
        local actionY=-h/2+P.padding+P.actionHeight/2
        size('use',-P.width/6,actionY,P.width/2,P.actionHeight)
        size('discard',P.width/3-P.padding/2,actionY,P.width/3-P.padding,P.actionHeight)
        enabled('use',item.canUse);enabled('discard',item.canDiscard~=false)
        root:SetVisible(true);root:SetAsLastSibling()
    end
    function popup.open(_,slot)
        local run=owner.run
        local token=run and {run=run,battle=run.combat,turn=run.combat and run.combat.turn,
            inventory=run.potions,slot=slot,id=run.potions[slot]}
        if not token or not token.id or not valid(token)then return false end
        if owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot then return popup:close() end
        popup.generation=popup.generation+1;owner.potionMenu=token;popup:render();return true
    end
    local function act(name)
        local token=owner.potionMenu
        if not valid(token)then popup:close();return false end
        local item=actions.item(token.slot)
        if name=='use' and not item.canUse or name=='discard' and item.canDiscard==false then return false end
        popup:close()
        if name=='dismiss'then actions.changed();return true end
        return actions[name](token.slot)
    end
    local function bind(name)
        local control=child(name)
        local held,released,observed
        local function ready(token)
            return valid(owner.potionMenu) and (name=='dismiss' or control.interactable)
                and (not token or token.selection==owner.potionMenu and token.generation==popup.generation)
        end
        Controller.bind(platform.controller,control,'battlePotion',function()return act(name)end,function()return ready()end)
        local cursor=platform.cursorEvents or {}
        if cursor.CursorDown and cursor.CursorUp then
            control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorDown,function(event)
                observed=true
                local touch=event and event.touchId
                if held and held.touch~=touch and ready(held) or released and released.touch~=touch and ready(released) then return end
                held,released=nil,nil
                if ready()then held={selection=owner.potionMenu,generation=popup.generation,touch=event and event.touchId}end
            end)
            control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorUp,function(event)
                if held and held.touch==(event and event.touchId)then
                    released=ready(held) and held or nil;held=nil
                end
            end)
            if cursor.CursorEndDrag then control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorEndDrag,function(event)
                local touch=event and event.touchId
                if held and held.touch==touch then held=nil end
                if released and released.touch==touch then released=nil end
            end)end
        end
        control:AddCursorEventListener(clickEvent,function(event)
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(platform.controller)then return false end
            if observed then
                local token=released
                if not token or token.touch~=(event and event.touchId)then return false end
                released=nil
                if not ready(token)then return false end
            elseif not ready()then return false end
            return act(name)
        end)
    end
    for _,name in ipairs({'use','discard','dismiss'})do bind(name)end
    child('hit'):AddCursorEventListener(clickEvent,function()return true end)
    root.disableCursorEventPassthrough=true
    root:SetVisible(false)
    return popup
end
return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local DamageView = require('abyss_battle_damage_view')
local PotionView = require("abyss_battle_potion_view")
local IntentView = require("abyss_battle_intent_view")
local M = {}
local C, L, S = Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local potionText = PotionView.potionText
local intentView = IntentView.intentView
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    local function pendingCardTarget(frame)
        if not frame.fighting or not owner.selected then return false end
        for _, instance in ipairs(frame.battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == owner.selected then return needsTarget(frame.battle, instance) end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local targetable = frame.active and pendingTarget and Combat.canPlay(frame.battle, owner.selected, index)
        if owner.gesture and owner.gesture.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.dragTarget(owner.gesture)
            targetable = valid and hovered == index
        end
        local potionTarget = owner.potionAim ~= nil and not pendingTarget and Actors.isActive(enemy)
        return targetable == true or potionTarget or owner.acting == enemy.id
    end
    local function enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, index)
        local shown = ownership.playbackIntents and ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id]
        local face = shown and Actors.isActive(enemy) and shown or intentView(frame.battle, index)
        local event = frame.enemyPlayback and owner.feedback.current
        -- Cache the historical starting face, not an already-applied later frame.
        if event and event.kind == "intent" and event.detail.enemy == enemy.id then
            ownership.playbackIntents = ownership.playbackIntents or {}
            ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id] = face
        elseif not Actors.isActive(enemy) and ownership.playbackIntents then
            ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id] = nil
        end
        return face
    end
    local function renderEnemyIntent(box, face, portrait)
        local icons = IntentView.icons(face)
        local size = L.intent.size
        local iconY = portrait / 2 + L.intent.portraitGap + size / 2
        local pitch = size * 1.5
        for i, name in ipairs({'intentIcon','intentBadge','intentExtra'}) do
            local control, kind = box:GetChild(name), icons[i]
            control:SetVisible(kind ~= nil)
            control:SetSizeDelta(size, size)
            control:SetAnchoredPosition((i - (#icons + 1) / 2) * pitch, iconY)
            if kind then
                dependencies.picture(control, Theme.icon.intent[kind] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
                dependencies.tint(control, intentColors[kind] or C.goldDim)
            end
        end
        local attackLabel = box:GetChild('intent')
        attackLabel.text = face.value or ''
        local attack=icons[1]=='attack' and attackLabel.text~=''
        attackLabel:SetVisible(attack)
        local glyphWidth=utf8.len(attackLabel.text)*L.intent.numberSize
        local textWidth=math.max(L.intent.valueWidth,glyphWidth)
        local left=(1-(#icons+1)/2)*pitch-size/2-S.xs
        local valueY=iconY-size/2+L.intent.numberSize/2-L.statusIcon.gap
        attackLabel:SetAnchoredPosition(left+textWidth/2,valueY)
        attackLabel:SetSizeDelta(textWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        dependencies.ink(attackLabel, C.text)
        box:GetChild('intentLabel'):SetVisible(false)
        local span=#icons*pitch-size/2
        local x0,x1=-span/2,span/2
        local y0,y1=iconY-size/2,iconY+size/2
        if attack then
            x0,x1=math.min(x0,left),math.max(x1,left+glyphWidth)
            y0=math.min(y0,valueY-L.intent.numberSize/2)
        end
        local width,height=math.max(L.statusIcon.minimumTouch,x1-x0),math.max(L.statusIcon.minimumTouch,y1-y0)
        box:GetChild('intentHit'):SetAnchoredPosition((x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2)
        box:GetChild('intentHit'):SetSizeDelta(width,height)
    end
    local function enemyAimProjection(frame)
        local aimed = owner.gesture or owner.carry
        local projection = { pendingTarget = pendingCardTarget(frame) }
        if aimed and aimed.moving then projection.valid, projection.target = dependencies.dragTarget(aimed) end
        if projection.valid then projection.losses = DamageView.preview(frame.battle, aimed.uid, projection.target) end
        return projection
    end
    local function renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        local preview = box:GetChild('damagePreview')
        preview:SetVisible(loss ~= nil and loss.loss > 0)
        preview:SetAnchoredPosition(0, -portrait / 2 - S.xxl + L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview:SetSizeDelta(width, L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview.text = loss and loss.loss > 0 and (loss.hp <= 0 and '击杀' or '−' .. number(loss.loss)) or ''
        if loss and loss.loss > 0 then box:GetChild('hpFill').fillAmount = math.max(0, loss.hp / enemy.maxHp) end
    end
    local function enemyPortraitIcon(enemy)
        return Theme.icon.enemy[enemy.definitionId] or Theme.icon.node[enemy.tier == 'normal' and 'combat' or enemy.tier]
    end
    local function renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, slot, count, aim)
        local enemy = entry.actor
        local x, width, portrait, step, y = dependencies.enemySlot(count, slot, enemy)
        box:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        local selected = enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, entry.index, aim.pendingTarget)
        local loss = aim.losses and aim.losses[entry.index]
        if aim.valid and not aim.target and loss and loss.loss > 0 then selected = true end
        host.unit(box, enemy, portrait, enemyPortraitIcon(enemy), width, selected,step)
        local dim = (aim.pendingTarget or owner.potionAim ~= nil) and not selected
        local portraitTone = C.text
        dependencies.tint(box:GetChild('portrait'), { r = portraitTone.r, g = portraitTone.g, b = portraitTone.b, a = dim and 102 or 255 })
        renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        renderEnemyIntent(box, enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, entry.index), portrait)
    end
    local function renderEnemies(frame)
        local rows = frame.fighting and EnemyView.slots(frame.battle, owner.busy and owner.feedback or nil) or {}
        owner.feedback.enemyRows = rows
        local aim = enemyAimProjection(frame)
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local box, entry = dependencies.child('enemy' .. i), rows[i]
            owner.feedback.bindEnemySlot(i, entry and entry.id)
            box:SetVisible(entry ~= nil)
            if entry then renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, i, #rows, aim) end
        end
    end
    local function renderDetails(frame)
        if owner.info and (not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or not frame.fighting
            or owner.info.battle ~= frame.run.combat) then owner.info = nil end
        host.renderInfo(frame.battle)
    end
    local function renderRewardActions(frame)
        local run, stolen = frame.run, frame.stolen
        dependencies.button("skip", owner.active and frame.picking == true and not run.rewards.cardResolved and not owner.busy, false, "跳过")
        dependencies.button("stolenGold", owner.active and stolen and not stolen.claimed and not owner.busy, false,
            stolen and (stolen.claimed and "已取回失金 " or "取回失金 ") .. number(stolen.amount) or "取回失金")
    end
    local function renderContinue(frame)
        local run = frame.run
        dependencies.button("continue", owner.active and run and (frame.manual or run.phase == "map") and not owner.busy, true,
            frame.manual and "前往地图" or "再战一场")
    end
    local function bindPotionSlots(frame)
        if frame.fighting and not owner.busy then
            owner.potionBattle, owner.potionRun, owner.potionSlots = frame.battle, frame.run, {}
            for slot = 1, frame.potionCapacity do
                local id = frame.run.potions[slot]
                if id then owner.potionSlots[slot] = {slot = slot, id = id} end
            end
        end
    end
    local function boundPotion(frame, index)
        local binding = owner.potionSlots and owner.potionSlots[index]
        local item = binding and frame.potions[binding.slot]
        if item and item.id ~= binding.id then return nil end
        return item
    end
    local function potionSelected(slot)
        return owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot
            or owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.slot==slot
    end
    local function paintPotionShell(slot,item)
