-- Host for the same-run map, node and battle controllers. Only commands change rules.
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Map = require("abyss_map")
local Nodes = require("abyss_nodes")
local BattleUI = require("abyss_battle_ui")
local MapUI = require("abyss_map_ui")
local NodeUI = require("abyss_node_ui")
local DeckUI = require("abyss_deck_ui")
local PotionDiscardUI = require("abyss_potion_discard_ui")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Narrative = require("abyss_narrative")
local Bgm = require("abyss_bgm")
local CharacterSelect = require("abyss_character_select")
local CharacterView = require("abyss_character_select_view")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local M = {}
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local RunSeed = require("abyss_run_seed")
local NeowHistory=require('abyss_neow_history')
local EndingHistory=require('abyss_ending_history')
local Acts=require('abyss_acts')

function M.new(root, data, presentation, clickEvent, platform)
    -- A seed is an explicit replay/test override. Normal runs sample at Start,
    -- never while constructing the title screen or refreshing the UI.
    local self = { root = root, data = data, seed = platform.seed, mode = "menu" }
    local neowHistory=NeowHistory.new(platform.readNeowHistory)
    local endingHistory=EndingHistory.new({read=platform.readEndingHistory,write=platform.writeEndingHistory})
    local controller = Controller.new(platform.controllerApi,root)
    self.controller = controller
    platform.controller = controller
    local newSeed = platform.newSeed or function() return require("abyss_new_run_seed").next() end
    local bgm = Bgm.new(platform.music)
    local function child(name) return assert(root:GetChild(name), "missing game panel " .. name) end
    local menu = child("menuPanel")
    local exitPanel, exitEntry = child("exitPanel"), child("exitEntry")
    local runMenu = child("runMenu")
    local exitGeneration, menuGeneration = 0, 0
    local codeVersion = assert(menu:GetChild('codeVersion'), 'missing game menu codeVersion')
    codeVersion.text = Narrative.codeVersion or '未知'
    local characterPanel = child("characterPanel")
    self.characterSelection=CharacterSelect.new(data,presentation,platform.characterProfile)
    self.fastMode=false
    self.setFastMode=function(_,enabled)
        if type(enabled)~='boolean' or self.disabled or self.battleUI and self.battleUI.busy then return false end
        if self.mode~='menu' or self.characterOpen or self.exitOpen
            or (self.deckUI and self.deckUI.visible)
            or (self.potionUI and self.potionUI.visible) or (self.choiceUI and self.choiceUI.visible)
            or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false end
        self.fastMode=enabled
        if self.battleUI then self.battleUI.fastMode=enabled;self.battleUI.feedback:setFastMode(enabled)end
        return true
    end
    local menuRun, menuMode
    local requestSettlement
    local ready = false
    local function openingCovered()return self.prologue and self.prologue:covering() or false end
    local function canViewRoute()
        return self.run~=nil and self.map~=nil and not self.characterOpen and not openingCovered()
            and not self.disabled and not self.settlementRequested and not self.settlementBusy
    end
    local function changed(_, reason)
        if not ready then return end
        if self.run and self.run.phase == 'act_transition' and (reason == 'continue' or reason == 'complete') then
            return self:advanceAct()
        end
        self:refresh()
    end
    self.battleUI = BattleUI.new(child("battlePanel"), data, presentation, clickEvent,
        platform, { embedded = true, onChange = changed, onPile=function(kind)return self:openDeck(kind)end })
    self.mapUI = MapUI.new(child("mapPanel"), nil, function(node)
        if self.disabled or not self.run or self.mode ~= "map" or self.deckUI and self.deckUI.visible then return false, "not_on_map" end
        local ok, reason = Nodes.enter(self.run, self.map, node.id)
        if ok then changed() end
        return ok, reason
    end, clickEvent, { embedded = true, color = platform.color, imageSource = platform.imageSource,
        cursor = platform.cursorEvents, controller = controller })
    self.nodeUI = NodeUI.new(child("nodePanel"), nil, nil,
        presentation, clickEvent, changed, { color = platform.color, imageSource = platform.imageSource,
            imageTypes = platform.imageTypes,
            cursorEvents = platform.cursorEvents, sound = platform.sound, controller = controller, touchScreen = platform.touchScreen,
            enhancedRooms=true,
            onInspectCard=function(definition,upgraded)
                if not self.run or self.disabled or self.mode~='node' or self.exitOpen
                    or self.deckUI.visible or self.potionUI.visible or self.settlementRequested then return false end
                if not self.deckUI:inspect(self.run,definition,upgraded) then return false end
                self:refresh();return true
            end })
    self.deckUI = DeckUI.new(child("deckPanel"), presentation, clickEvent, platform, function() return self:closeDeck() end)
    do
        self.choiceUI = require("abyss_choice_ui").new(child("choicePanel"),presentation,clickEvent,platform,
            function(kind,uids,token,generation,battle)
                return self.battleUI:chooseCards(kind,uids,token,generation,battle)
            end)
    end
    local function inCombat()
        return self.mode=="battle" and self.run~=nil and self.run.phase=="combat"
    end
    local function canManagePotions(run)
        return not openingCovered() and not self.disabled and run~=nil and self.run==run and not self.exitOpen and not self.deckUI.visible
            and not (self.choiceUI and self.choiceUI.visible)
            and not self.battleUI.busy and not self.settlementBusy and not self.settlementRequested
            and (self.mode=="map" or self.mode=="battle" or self.mode=="node")
            and (run.phase=="map" or run.phase=="node" or run.phase=="reward" or run.phase=="combat")

    self.potionUI=PotionDiscardUI.new(child("potionPanel"),clickEvent,platform,canManagePotions,changed,
        function()return self:closePotions()end)

        self.battleUI.selected=nil;self:refresh();return true
    end
    self.closePotions = function(_)
        if not self.potionUI:close()then return false end
        self.battleUI.suppressClick=false;self:refresh();return true

            sound=platform.sound,controller=controller,

            onPhase=function()self:refresh()end})
    elseif prologuePanel then prologuePanel:SetVisible(false) end

    self.openExit = function(_)
        if self.disabled or self.characterOpen or self.exitOpen or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false end
        exitGeneration = exitGeneration + 1
        self.potionUI:close()

        self.battleUI.selected = nil
        self:refresh()
        return true
    end
    self.openMenu = function(_)
        if self.disabled or self.exitOpen or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false end
        exitGeneration = exitGeneration + 1
        self.exitOpen, self.menuOpen, self.exitError = true, true, nil
        self:refresh()
        return true
    end
    self.closeExit = function(_)
        if not self.exitOpen or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false end
        exitGeneration = exitGeneration + 1
        if self.routeOpen then
            self.routeOpen = false
            self:refresh()
            return true
        end
        if self.controlsOpen then
            self.controlsOpen = false

        end

        if self.controlsOpen or self.menuOpen or self.routeOpen then return false,"menu_open" end
        if not self.exitOpen then return false, "exit_not_open" end

        -- fakes a defeated Run. An already-earned victory keeps its outcome.
        return requestSettlement(self.mode == "victory")
    end

    self.openDeck = function(_,pileKind)
        if openingCovered() or self.disabled or self.characterOpen or self.choiceUI and self.choiceUI.visible or self.exitOpen or self.potionUI.visible or not self.run or self.battleUI.busy or self.settlementBusy or self.settlementRequested
            or (self.mode ~= "map" and self.mode ~= "battle" and self.mode ~= "node") then return false end
        if pileKind then
            if self.mode~='battle' or not self.deckUI:openPile(self.run,pileKind)then return false end

        self:refresh()
        return true
    end
    self.openRelics = function(_)

                ..(description~='' and description or '效果说明待补充。')
        end
        self.deckUI:inspectText(self.run,'持有遗物 · '..#self.run.relics..' 件',
            #parts>0 and table.concat(parts,'\n\n') or '本局尚未获得遗物。')
        self:refresh();return true
    end
    self.closeDeck = function(_)
        if self.exitOpen or self.settlementRequested then return false end
        if self.deckUI.choiceToken then return false,"card_choice_pending" end
        if not self.deckUI:close() then return false end
        -- Resume click-only hosts; pointer-capable card input still requires its
        -- own fresh Down/Up identity. Closing an overlay cannot revive old clicks.
        self.battleUI.suppressClick = false

    end

    -- Menu/result presentation reads stats the run already records. Motion only moves and
    -- scales controls; it never hides them or gates input.
    local L, C, T = Theme.layout.nativeMenu, Theme.color, Theme.motion
    local R = L.reveal
    local result = menu:GetChild("result")
    local emblem, start, settlement = menu:GetChild("emblem"), menu:GetChild("start"), menu:GetChild("settle")
    local vista = menu:GetChild("vista")
    local risers = { { menu:GetChild("title"), L.title }, { menu:GetChild("tagline"), L.tagline },
        { result:GetChild("subtitle"), L.subtitle } }
    local cards = {}
    for i, key in ipairs({ "floor", "victories", "time", "deck" }) do cards[i] = result:GetChild("stat_" .. key) end
    local function colour(c) return platform.color(c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a) end
    local function clamp(value) return math.max(0, math.min(1, value)) end
    local function easeOut(p) return 1 - (1 - p) ^ 3 end

        emblem:GetChild("glow"):SetLocalScale(breathe, breathe, 1)

        vista:GetChild("seal"):GetChild("heart").imageColor = colour(defeat and C.danger or C.goldBright)

        local title = menu:GetChild("title")

        title.fontColor = colour(victory and C.goldBright or defeat and C.text or C.gold)
        menu:GetChild("tagline"):SetVisible(not outcome)
        menu:GetChild("summary"):SetVisible(false)
        result:SetVisible(outcome)
        local startFrame = outcome and L.resultRestart or L.start
        start:SetAnchoredPosition(startFrame[1], startFrame[2])
        start:SetVisible(not self.settlementRequested and not self.settlementBusy)
        start:GetChild("label").text = run and "重新启程" or "启程"
        settlement:SetVisible(outcome)
        local available = type(platform.settle) == "function"

        settlement:GetChild("normal"):SetVisible(enabled == true)

        label.fontColor = colour(enabled and C.gold or C.textDim)
        -- With the request sent, restart is gone and the remaining button settles to centre.
        local targetX = self.settlementRequested and 0 or L.settle[1]
        if targetX ~= m.settleX then m.slide, m.settleX = { from = m.settleX, to = targetX, t = 0 }, targetX end
        if not outcome then

            result:GetChild("subtitle").text = victory and run.ending=='two_act_complete'

                and '腐化之心已击败。真结局已达成。' or Narrative.flow[mode].full
            local finalFloor=Acts.isCompetition(run) and Acts.get(2).last or victory and run.ending=='true_victory' and (self.map.terminalFloor or rules.floors) or rules.floors
            local values = { floor .. " / " .. finalFloor, tostring(run.victories), clock(run.elapsedSeconds), tostring(#run.deck) }
            for i, name in ipairs({ "抵达层数", "战斗胜场", "用时", "卡组张数" }) do
                cards[i]:GetChild("label").text, cards[i]:GetChild("value").text = name, values[i]
            end

            local hp = run.phase == "defeat" and 0 or run.hp
            result:GetChild("detail").text = "生命 " .. number(hp) .. " / " .. number(run.maxHp) .. " · 金币 " .. number(run.gold)
                .. " · 遗物 " .. #run.relics .. " 件"
            local status, ink = "「结束并结算」提交本局结果并进入平台结算；「重新启程」不会提交", C.textMuted
            if self.settlementRequested then status, ink = "结算请求已发送，等待平台结算界面", C.positive
            elseif self.settlementError then status, ink = "结算请求失败，请重试", C.danger
            elseif not available then status = "平台结算暂不可用，可重新启程" end

    self.animate = function(_, dt)
        local m = self.motion
        if not m.mode then return end
        m.t = m.t + dt
        if m.slide then m.slide.t = m.slide.t + dt; if m.slide.t >= T.base then m.slide = nil end end
        if m.shake then m.shake = m.shake + dt; if m.shake >= T.shake then m.shake = nil end end
        pose()
    end

    function self.syncController(_)
        if not controller then return end
        local scope=self.mode
        if self.disabled or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then scope='blocked'
        elseif self.exitOpen then scope='exit'
        elseif self.characterOpen then scope='characters'
        elseif openingCovered() then scope='prologue'
        elseif self.choiceUI and self.choiceUI.visible then scope='choice'
        elseif self.deckUI.visible then scope='deck'
        elseif self.potionUI.visible then scope='potions'
        elseif self.mode=='battle' and self.battleUI.potionMenu then scope='battlePotion'
        elseif self.mode=='battle' and self.battleUI.info then scope='battleInfo'
        elseif self.mode=='battle' and (self.battleUI.selected or self.battleUI.potionAim) then scope='aim' end
        controller:sync(scope,function()
            if scope=='exit' then return self:closeExit()
            elseif scope=='characters' then return self:closeCharacters()
            elseif scope=='prologue' then return self.prologue:skip()
            elseif scope=='deck' then
                if self.deckUI.choiceToken then return false end
                return self.deckUI:back()
            elseif scope=='choice' then return false -- mandatory core selections cannot be dismissed
            elseif scope=='potions' then return self:closePotions()
            elseif scope=='battlePotion' or scope=='battleInfo' or scope=='aim' then return self.battleUI:controllerBack()
            elseif scope=='node' and self.nodeUI.mode=='picker' then return self.nodeUI:press('back')
            elseif scope=='battle' and self.run and self.run.phase=='reward' and self.battleUI.rewardScreen=='cards' then
                return self.battleUI:controllerBack()
            elseif scope~='blocked' then return self:openMenu() end
            return false
        end)
    end
    local function finishRunFlow(run)
        if run and (run.phase=='victory' or run.phase=='defeat')then NeowHistory.finish(neowHistory,run,run.phase)end
        if run and EndingHistory.finish(endingHistory,run,self.map)then run.endingHistoryResult=EndingHistory.read(endingHistory)end
        if not self.exitOpen and not self.settlementRequested and run and run.phase == "map" and run.nodeFlow and not run.nodeFlow.complete then
            Nodes.completeCombat(run, self.map)
        end
    end
    local function selectMode(run)
        if self.battleUI.busy then self.mode = "battle"
        elseif not run then self.mode = "menu"
        elseif run.phase == "defeat" then self.mode = "defeat"
        elseif run.phase == "victory" then self.mode = "victory"
        elseif run.phase == "combat" or run.phase == "reward" then self.mode = "battle"
        elseif run.phase == "node" or run.phase == 'act_transition' or run.phase=='ending_proceed' then self.mode = "node"
        -- Camp/event results stay on screen until the player presses 继续.
        elseif self.nodeUI.run == run and self.nodeUI:holding() then self.mode = "node"
        else self.mode = "map" end

    local function exitDialogOwnsForeground()

            exitPanel:GetChild("whyText").text = why and "存档功能需作者达到创作者 4 级后开放，喜欢的话欢迎点赞支持。" or ""
            exitPanel:GetChild("status").text = self.settlementRequested and "结算请求已发送，等待平台结算界面。"

    local function overlaysBlocked()

    local function syncOpening(run)
        if self.prologue and (self.settlementRequested or run and (run.phase=='defeat' or run.phase=='victory')) then self.prologue:cancel() end
        return openingCovered()
    end
    local function openingForeground(covering)
        if self.prologue and self.prologue:opaque() then
            child('mapPanel'):SetVisible(false);child('nodePanel'):SetVisible(false)
        end
        if not covering then return end
        prologuePanel:SetAsLastSibling();child('exitEntry'):SetAsLastSibling()

    self.refresh = function(_)
        if self.disabled then return false,"ui_disabled" end
        local run = self.run
        finishRunFlow(run)
        local covering = syncOpening(run)
        selectMode(run)
        local inMenu = self.mode == "menu" or self.mode == "defeat" or self.mode == "victory"
        syncMenuContext(run,inMenu)
        syncCardChoice(run)
        closeStaleDeck(run,inMenu)
        openCardChoice(run)
        local deckOpen = self.deckUI.visible
        if self.potionUI.visible and not canManagePotions(self.potionUI.run)then self.potionUI:close()end
        local potionOpen=self.potionUI.visible
        local blocked=overlaysBlocked() or covering
        local returnAvailable=syncRewardReturn(run,deckOpen,potionOpen,blocked,covering)
        refreshUtilities(run,inMenu,deckOpen,potionOpen,blocked,covering,returnAvailable)
        refreshPageVisibility(run,inMenu,deckOpen,potionOpen,blocked)
        renderCurrentPage(run,deckOpen,potionOpen,blocked,covering)
        bgm:update(self.settlementRequested and "stop" or Bgm.scene(self.mode, run, self.battleUI.busy, bgm.cue))
        present()
        refreshForeground()
        openingForeground(covering)
        self:syncController()
    end
    local function selectionChanged()
        exitGeneration=exitGeneration+1;menuGeneration=menuGeneration+1
        self:refresh()
    end
    self.closeCharacters = function(_)
        if not self.characterOpen or self.starting then return false end
        self.characterOpen=false;self.characterSelection:clear()
        selectionChanged();return true
    end
    self.selectCharacter = function(_,id)
        if not self.characterOpen or self.starting or self.disabled then return false end
        local ok,reason=self.characterSelection:select(id)
        if ok then selectionChanged()end
        return ok,reason
    end
    self.selectElement = function(_,id)
        if not self.characterOpen or self.starting or self.disabled then return false end
        local ok,reason=self.characterSelection:selectElement(id)
        if ok then selectionChanged()end
        return ok,reason
    end
    self.start = function(_,character)
        if self.disabled or self.starting then return false,"ui_disabled" end
        if self.exitOpen or self.deckUI.visible or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false end
        if self.mode~='menu' and self.mode~='defeat' and self.mode~='victory' then return false end
        if self.characterOpen then return false,'character_choice_open' end
        self.characterOpen=true;self.characterSelection:clear()
        selectionChanged()
        if character then
            for _,id in ipairs(CharacterSelect.elements)do if id==character then
                self:selectCharacter('traveler');return self:selectElement(id)
            end end
            return self:selectCharacter(character)
        end
        return true,'character_choice'
    end
    local function beginRun(character)
        if not self.characterSelection:allows(character) then return false,'character_unavailable' end
        local explicitSeed = self.seed ~= nil
        local seed = explicitSeed and self.seed or newSeed()
        local rawSeed=RunSeed.normalize(seed)
        local selection=CharacterSelect.options(character)
        -- Native entry selects the competition profile; explicit full-source
        -- hosts retain future chapters without changing same-run ownership.
        if platform.campaign == true then
            selection = selection or {}
            selection.experimental, selection.campaign = true, true
            selection.campaignProfile=platform.campaignProfile
        end
        local run = Run.new(data,rawSeed,selection)
        local runPresentation = (selection and selection.character or run.data.colorlessCards) and require("abyss_character_presentation").prepare(presentation,run.data) or presentation
        local ending=EndingHistory.begin(endingHistory,run,{seedSet=explicitSeed,
            isDailyRun=platform.isDailyRun or false,isTrial=platform.isTrial or false})
        run.endingUnlocked,run.endingHistory=ending.unlocked,ending
        local context,contextReason=Run.freezeMapContext(run)
        if not context then return false,contextReason end
        local map = Map.generate(run.data,rawSeed,run.act or 1,context)
        local history,historyReason
        history,historyReason=NeowHistory.read(neowHistory,run.character,Acts.isCompetition(run))
        if not history and Acts.isCompetition(run) then history={bossCount=0,source='fresh-start'} end
        if history then
            local ok,why=Nodes.beginNeow(run,map,history);if not ok then return false,why end
            run.neowHistorySource=history.source
        else
            run.neowStatus=Acts.isCompetition(run) and 'disabled' or 'unavailable'
            run.neowUnavailableReason=historyReason
        end
        self.characterOpen=false;exitGeneration=exitGeneration+1;menuGeneration=menuGeneration+1
        self.battleUI:setData(run.data,runPresentation)
        self.nodeUI.presentation=runPresentation
        self.deckUI:setPresentation(runPresentation)
        if self.choiceUI then self.choiceUI:close();self.choiceUI:setPresentation(runPresentation) end
        self.run, self.map, self.runSeed = run, map, rawSeed
        self.settlementRequested, self.settlementBusy, self.settlementError = false, false, nil
        if explicitSeed then self.seed = type(seed)=='number' and (seed + 1) % 65536 or RunSeed.increment(rawSeed) end
        print("ABYSS_RUN seed=" .. rawSeed
            .. " source=" .. (explicitSeed and "explicit" or "clock"))
        self.battleUI.run, self.battleUI.target = self.run, 1
        self.mapUI.map = self.map
        self.nodeUI.run, self.nodeUI.map = self.run, self.map
        self.nodeUI:render()
        if self.prologue and not self.prologuePlayed then
            self.prologuePlayed=true;self.prologue:play()
        end
        self:refresh()
        return true
    end
    self.confirmCharacter = function(_)
        if not self.characterOpen or self.starting or self.disabled or self.exitOpen
            or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false,'character_choice_unavailable' end
        local info=self.characterSelection.info
        if not info then return false,'character_required' end
        self.starting=true
        -- Latch before seed generation and Run.new; a native duplicate cannot re-enter.
        local ok,accepted,reason=pcall(beginRun,info.id)
        self.starting=false
        if not ok then error(accepted)end
        return accepted,reason
    end
    self.advanceAct = function()
        if self.disabled or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= 'act_transition' then return false,'act_transition_unavailable' end
        if self.exitOpen or self.deckUI.visible or self.potionUI.visible or self.battleUI.busy
            or self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false,'ui_busy' end
        local ok, reason = Nodes.advanceAct(self.run, self.map)
        if ok then
            self.nodeUI.result, self.nodeUI.notice = nil, ''
            self.battleUI.selected, self.battleUI.target = nil, 1
            self.presentedBattle = nil
            if self.choiceUI then self.choiceUI:close() end
        else
            self.nodeUI.notice = '暂时无法前往下一幕，请重试。'
        end
        self:refresh()
        return ok, reason
    end
    self.settle = function(_)
        if self.disabled then return false,"ui_disabled" end
        if self.characterOpen then return false, "character_choice_open" end
        if self.exitOpen then return false, "exit_open" end
        if self.deckUI.visible then return false, "deck_open" end
        if self.mode ~= "victory" and self.mode ~= "defeat" then return false, "not_result" end
        return requestSettlement(self.mode == "victory")
    end
    requestSettlement = function(victory)
        if self.disabled then return false,"ui_disabled" end
        if self.settlementRequested or self.settlementBusy then return false, "settlement_already_requested" end
        if type(platform.settle) ~= "function" then
            self.exitError = self.exitOpen == true
            self:refresh()
            return false, "settlement_unavailable"
        end
        self.settlementBusy = true
        local called, accepted = pcall(platform.settle, victory)
        self.settlementBusy = false
        if not called or accepted == false then
            self.settlementError, self.motion.shake = true, 0
            self.exitError = self.exitOpen == true
            self:refresh()
            return false, "settlement_request_failed"
        end
        self.settlementRequested, self.settlementError, self.exitError = true, nil, nil

-- Inventory effects use combat actors and data, with fixed potion/relic damage and block.
-- Callers execute on an uncommitted battle: a refusal may discard this candidate safely.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local RelicHooks = require('abyss_relic_hooks')
local M = {}
local supported = { classPotion=true, silentGhost=true, silentShivs=true, generatePotions=true, discover=true, channelOrb=true, makeMiracle=true, damage = true, damageAll = true, upgradeHand = true, healPercent = true, increaseMaxHp = true, block = true, draw = true, energy = true,
    exhaustMany=true,discardRedraw=true,discardToHand=true,randomizeHandCost=true,escape=true,playTopCards=true,
    gainStatus = true, applyStatus = true, gainTemporaryStrength = true, gainTemporaryDexterity = true }
local maximum = 2147483647
local bossRelics = { black_blood = true, slavers_collar = true, sozu = true }

function M.bossEligible(relic, owned)
    if relic.rarity ~= "boss" or not bossRelics[relic.id] then return false end
    local prerequisite = relic.replaces == nil
    for _, id in ipairs(owned) do
        if id == relic.id then return false end
        if id == relic.replaces then prerequisite = true end
    end
    return prerequisite
end

-- These two relics modify the prepared energy master, not a queued opening
-- energy action (Lantern). Give Combat its own adjusted rules copy per battle.
function M.energyBonus(definitions, owned, tier)
    local bonus = 0
    for _, id in ipairs(owned) do
        local relic
        for _, entry in ipairs(definitions) do if entry.id == id then relic = entry; break end end
        if not relic then return nil, "unknown_relic" end
        if relic.trigger == "turn_start" then
            if id ~= "sozu" and id ~= "slavers_collar" then return nil, "unsupported_turn_relic:" .. id end
            local eligible = not relic.encounterTiers
            for _, allowed in ipairs(relic.encounterTiers or {}) do if tier == allowed then eligible = true end end
            if eligible then
                for _, effect in ipairs(relic.effects) do
                    if effect.op ~= "energy" or type(effect.value) ~= "number" or effect.value < 0
                        or effect.value % 1 ~= 0 or bonus + 0.0 + effect.value > maximum then
                        return nil, "invalid_relic_energy"
                    end
                    bonus = bonus + effect.value
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bonus
end

-- Source-defined hook/queue positions, not effect values. New relics need their
-- own ordering evidence before entering this supported opening set.
local openingPosition = { ring_of_the_snake="battle_bottom", cracked_core="pre_battle", pure_water="pre_draw", lantern = "turn_top", vajra = "battle_top",
    oddly_smooth_stone = "battle_top", bronze_scales = "battle_top",
    anchor = "battle_bottom", bag_of_preparation = "battle_bottom" }

function M.opening(definitions, owned, persistentCounters, context)
    local turnTop, battleTop, bottom, preBattle, preDraw = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    for _, id in ipairs(owned) do
        local relic
        for _, entry in ipairs(definitions) do if entry.id == id then relic = entry; break end end
        if not relic then return nil, "unknown_relic" end
        if id=='blood_vial' or id=='akabeko' or id=='data_disk' then
            table.insert(battleTop,1,{{op='relic_hook',id=id}})
        elseif id=='bag_of_marbles' or id=='pen_nib' or id=='red_skull' or id=='red_mask' then
            bottom[#bottom+1]={{op='relic_hook',id=id}}
        elseif relic.trigger == "combat_start" then
            local position = openingPosition[id]
            if not position then return nil, "unsupported_opening_relic:" .. tostring(id) end
            if position == "pre_battle" then preBattle[#preBattle + 1] = relic.effects
            elseif position == "pre_draw" then preDraw[#preDraw + 1] = relic.effects
            elseif position == "turn_top" then table.insert(turnTop, 1, relic.effects)
            elseif position == "battle_top" then table.insert(battleTop, 1, relic.effects)
            else bottom[#bottom + 1] = relic.effects end
        end
    end

-- TheLibrary at fixed STS319009d5. Nodes owns the enclosing transaction.
-- This is NOT getRewardCards: duplicate attempts reroll rarity AND identity;
-- pity never changes and no random upgrade/card-count/reward relic roll runs.
local Run=require('abyss_run')
local R=require('abyss_sts_random')
local CardRandom=require('abyss_card_random')
local Capability=require('abyss_card_capability')
local Hooks=require('abyss_relic_hooks')
local M={}
local colors={ironclad='red',silent='green',defect='blue',watcher='purple'}
local sizes={ironclad={common=20,uncommon=36,rare=16},silent={common=19,uncommon=33,rare=19},
 defect={common=18,uncommon=36,rare=17},watcher={common=19,uncommon=35,rare=17}}
local function definition(run,id)
 for _,d in ipairs(run.data.cards.cards)do if d.id==id then return d end end
end
local function available(run)
 -- The historical prepared and original-V4 components do not declare a full
 -- source class catalogue. This is an implementation boundary, not a source rule.
 return run.data.runCardCatalog==true and sizes[run.data.runCardCharacter]~=nil
end
local function dependencies(run)
 if not available(run)then return false,'library_source_catalog_unavailable'end
 -- These preview/obtain hooks have not been implemented by their shared owner.
 -- Never silently show base cards or insert a manually upgraded preview instead.
 for _,id in ipairs(run.relics or {})do
  if id=='frozen_egg' or id=='Frozen Egg 2' then
   return false,'event_obtain_content_unavailable'
  end
 end
 return true
end
local function row(choice,title,description,enabled)
 return {choice=choice,title=title,description=description,enabled=enabled~=false}
end
function M.prepare(run,event)
 assert(type(run.maxHp)=='number' and run.maxHp%1==0 and run.maxHp>=1 and run.maxHp<=2147483647,'invalid Library health')
 event.startMaxHp=run.maxHp
 -- Positive signed32 HP * .33f stays below MathUtils.round's int-cast limit.
 -- The operand and product are binary32; MathUtils adds its double .5 offset.
 event.healAmount=math.floor(R.float32(R.float32(run.maxHp)*R.float32(.33))+.5)
 event.stage,event.body='intro','书架之间一片寂静。你可以阅读一本书，也可以睡一会儿。'
end
function M.options(run,event)
 if event.stage=='intro'then
  local ready=dependencies(run)

-- Read Map.view/available, issue a synchronous choice command to the coordinator.
-- The coordinator owns Map.choose / Nodes.enter and resolving the chosen node.
-- No camp/shop/event/combat/run rules live in this module.
local Map = require("abyss_map")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Layout = require("abyss_map_layout")
local Acts = require("abyss_acts")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local M = {}
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function clamp(n, low, high) return math.max(low, math.min(high, n)) end
local function child(control, name) return assert(control:GetChild(name), "missing map UI control " .. name) end
-- Chapter metadata is presentation context, not permission to enter new content.
-- Legacy Act 1 intentionally has no act/firstFloor/terminalFloor fields.
local function chapterFor(map)
    if type(map) ~= "table" then return end
    local ok, chapter = pcall(Acts.get, map.act or 1)
    if not ok or not finite(map.floor) or map.floor % 1 ~= 0
        or map.floor < chapter.first - 1 or map.floor > chapter.last
        or type(map.sourceSignature) ~= "string" or map.sourceSignature == "" then return end
    if chapter.act == 1 then
        if map.version ~= 3 or map.act ~= nil or map.firstFloor ~= nil or map.terminalFloor ~= nil
            or map.sourceSignature:sub(1,7) ~= "map-v3:" then return end
    else
        local prefix = "map-v4:sts-a0-319009d5:" .. chapter.id .. ":"
        if map.version ~= 4 or map.firstFloor ~= chapter.first or map.terminalFloor ~= chapter.last
            or map.sourceSignature:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return end
    end
    if type(map.nodes) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, node in ipairs(map.nodes) do
        if type(node) ~= "table" or not finite(node.floor) or node.floor % 1 ~= 0 or node.floor < chapter.first or node.floor > chapter.last
            or node.localFloor ~= nil and node.localFloor ~= node.floor - chapter.first + 1 then return end
    end
    return chapter
end
local function sameContext(a, b)
    for _, key in ipairs({"act", "version", "firstFloor", "terminalFloor", "sourceSignature", "seed", "runSeed", "mapSeed"}) do
        if a[key] ~= b[key] then return false end
    end
    return true
end
local function localFloor(map, floor) return floor - (map.firstFloor or 1) + 1 end
local function atStart(map) return map.floor == (map.firstFloor or 1) - 1 end

-- Standalone root holds mapBackdrop + stage/mapPanel from mapLayout(). With
-- options.embedded, root is the host's mapPanel and the host alone scales stage.
-- options may supply color(r,g,b,a) and imageSource; client defaults otherwise.
-- options.cursor (the platform cursor event enum) enables drag-to-scroll.
-- Host OnStart calls resize(game.GetUICanvasSize()), OnUpdate calls update(dt).
-- Host wheel deltas may call scrollBy(baseCanvasPixels).
function M.new(root, map, onChoose, clickEvent, options)
    assert(type(onChoose) == "function", "map UI requires onChoose callback")
    options = options or {}
    local colour = options.color or Color
    local imageSource = options.imageSource or (Enum and Enum.ImageSource.StaticReference)
    -- Platform Color has static methods and can be a callable table/userdata.
    -- Requiring a plain Lua function aborts the entire host before input binds.
    assert(colour ~= nil and imageSource ~= nil, "map UI needs client Color and imageSource")
    local embedded = options.embedded == true
    local stage, backdrop, panel
    if embedded then stage, panel = root, root
    else
        stage, backdrop = child(root, "stage"), child(root, "mapBackdrop")
        panel = child(stage, "mapPanel")
    end
    -- The title host binds real owners only after Start succeeds.
    if map ~= nil then assert(chapterFor(map), "invalid map chapter context") end
    local view = map and Map.view(map)
    local self = { root = root, map = map, visible = map ~= nil, navigationEnabled = view and atStart(view) or false,
        scroll = 0, slots = {}, time = 0, breathing = {}, stage = stage, panel = panel,
        embedded = embedded, scale = 1, observedMap = map, observedContext = view,
        observedNodeId = view and view.currentNodeId, observedFloor = view and view.floor }
    local drag, released, pointerObserved, scrollAnimation
    local buttonHover, buttonPress
    local function cancelSelection()
        if drag then drag.selection = nil end
        released = nil
    end
    local function cancelDrag()
        if drag then self.dragged = true end
        cancelSelection()
        drag = nil
        scrollAnimation, buttonHover, buttonPress = nil, nil, nil
    end
    local controlCache = {}
    local function at(name)
        if controlCache[name] then return controlCache[name] end
        local i = 1
        while true do
            local group = panel:GetChild("mapGroup" .. i)
            if not group then break end
            local found = group:GetChild(name)
            if found then controlCache[name] = found return found end
            i = i + 1
        end
        error("missing map UI control " .. name)
    end
    local function tint(control, c) control.imageColor = colour(c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a) end
    local function pathColour(ink, opacity)
        return colour(ink.r, ink.g, ink.b, math.floor(ink.a * opacity))
    end
    local visual = Theme.layout.map.presentation
    local pathColours = {
        taken = pathColour(Theme.color.node.pathTaken, visual.takenOpacity),
        next = pathColour(Theme.color.node.path, visual.nextOpacity),
        future = pathColour(Theme.color.node.path, visual.futureOpacity),
    }
    local function controllerContextReady()
        return chapterFor(self.map) ~= nil and self.map == self.observedMap
            and sameContext(self.map,self.observedContext)
            and self.map.floor == self.observedFloor and self.map.currentNodeId == self.observedNodeId
    end
    local function bind(name, fn)
        local hit=child(at(name),"hit")
        hit:AddCursorEventListener(clickEvent,function(event)
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(options.controller)then return false end
            return fn(event)
        end)
        Controller.bind(options.controller,hit,"map",function()
            local slot=tonumber(name:match("^node(%d+)$"))
            if slot then
                if scrollAnimation then return false,"map_scrolling" end
                cancelDrag()
                return self.slots[slot] and self:choose(self.slots[slot])
            end
            return fn()
        end,controllerContextReady,name:match("^node") and tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or 100)
    end
    local function buttonEnabled(name)
        return self.visible and chapterFor(self.map) ~= nil and (name == "focus" or name == "previous" and self.scroll > 0
            or name == "next" and self.scroll < Layout.maxScroll)
    end
    local function paintButton(name)
        local box, enabled = at(name), buttonEnabled(name)
        local pressed = enabled and buttonPress and buttonPress.name == name
        local hover = enabled and buttonHover == name and not pressed
        -- Pointer users pan the route directly. Compact hints only appear while
        -- a controller is active, retaining native focus access to the whole map.
        box:SetVisible(Controller.isController(options.controller))
        child(box,"hit"):SetVisible(enabled)
        child(box,"hit").canControllerFocus = enabled
        tint(child(box,"frame"), not enabled and Theme.color.line
            or (pressed or hover) and Theme.color.goldBright or Theme.color.goldDim)
        tint(child(box,"body"), pressed and Theme.color.goldDim
            or hover and Theme.color.buttonHover or Theme.color.panel)
        local ink = not enabled and Theme.color.textMuted
            or pressed and Theme.color.buttonPressedText or Theme.color.text
        child(box,"label").fontColor = colour(ink.r,ink.g,ink.b,ink.a)
        local scale = pressed and Theme.layout.nativeNode.buttonStates.pressedScale
            or Theme.layout.nativeNode.buttonStates.normalScale
        box:SetLocalScale(scale,scale,1)
    end
    local function position(node)
        return (node.lane - (Layout.lanes + 1) / 2) * Theme.layout.map.columnGap,
            Layout.firstY + (localFloor(self.map, node.floor) - 1) * Theme.layout.map.floorGap - self.scroll
    end
    local function observeMap(current)
        if self.map == self.observedMap and sameContext(current,self.observedContext) then return false end
        cancelDrag()
        -- A restarted run can share floor/node ids with the previous run. Identity
        -- resets its presentation and default gate before the host grants access.
        self.observedMap, self.observedContext = self.map, current
        self.entryError=nil
        self.observedNodeId, self.observedFloor = current.currentNodeId, current.floor
        self.navigationEnabled, self.time = atStart(current), 0
        self.scroll = clamp(Layout.firstY + (math.max(1, localFloor(current, current.floor)) - 1) *
            Theme.layout.map.floorGap - Layout.focusY, 0, Layout.maxScroll)
        return true
    end
    local function line(control, source, target, taken, reachable)
        local x1, y1 = position(source)
        local x2, y2 = position(target)
        -- Clip real graph segments to viewport, with half-stroke padding.
        local low, high = Layout.viewport.bottom + Layout.lineWidth / 2, Layout.viewport.top - Layout.lineWidth / 2
        if y2 < low or y1 > high then control:SetVisible(false) return end
        local a, b = clamp((low - y1) / (y2 - y1), 0, 1), clamp((high - y1) / (y2 - y1), 0, 1)
        local ax, ay = x1 + (x2 - x1) * a, y1 + (y2 - y1) * a
        local bx, by = x1 + (x2 - x1) * b, y1 + (y2 - y1) * b
        local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
        if dy <= 0 then control:SetVisible(false) return end
        control:SetVisible(true)
        control:SetAnchoredPosition((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
        control:SetSizeDelta(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), Layout.lineWidth)
        control.localRotationZ = math.atan(dy, dx) * 180 / math.pi
        control.imageColor = taken and pathColours.taken or reachable and pathColours.next or pathColours.future
    end
    function self.render(_)
        if not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        local context = chapterFor(self.map)
        if not context then
            cancelDrag()
            self.navigationEnabled, self.slots, self.breathing = false, {}, {}
            at("title").text, at("notice").text = "", "地图章节信息无效 · 请重新启程"
            at("notice"):SetVisible(true)
            for i = 1, Layout.maxNodes do at("node" .. i):SetVisible(false) end
            for i = 1, Layout.maxEdges do at("edge" .. i):SetVisible(false) end
            for _, name in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do paintButton(name) end
            return
        end
        local current, nodes, taken = Map.view(self.map), {}, {}
        observeMap(current)
        if current.currentNodeId ~= self.observedNodeId or current.floor ~= self.observedFloor then
            cancelDrag()
            self.navigationEnabled = false
        end
        self.observedNodeId, self.observedFloor = current.currentNodeId, current.floor
        for _, node in ipairs(current.nodes) do nodes[node.id] = node end
        for i = 1, #current.path - 1 do taken[current.path[i] .. ":" .. current.path[i + 1]] = true end
        self.slots, self.breathing = {}, {}
        local chapter = Acts.get(current.act or 1)

-- Read Map.view/available, issue a synchronous choice command to the coordinator.
-- The coordinator owns Map.choose / Nodes.enter and resolving the chosen node.
-- No camp/shop/event/combat/run rules live in this module.
local Map = require("abyss_map")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Layout = require("abyss_map_layout")

local M = {}
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function clamp(n, low, high) return math.max(low, math.min(high, n)) end
local function child(control, name) return assert(control:GetChild(name), "missing map UI control " .. name) end
-- Chapter metadata is presentation context, not permission to enter new content.
-- Legacy Act 1 intentionally has no act/firstFloor/terminalFloor fields.
local function chapterFor(map)
    if type(map) ~= "table" then return end
    local ok, chapter = pcall(Acts.get, map.act or 1)
    if not ok or not finite(map.floor) or map.floor % 1 ~= 0
        or map.floor < chapter.first - 1 or map.floor > chapter.last
        or type(map.sourceSignature) ~= "string" or map.sourceSignature == "" then return end
    if chapter.act == 1 then
        if map.version ~= 3 or map.act ~= nil or map.firstFloor ~= nil or map.terminalFloor ~= nil
            or map.sourceSignature:sub(1,7) ~= "map-v3:" then return end
    else
        local prefix = "map-v4:sts-a0-319009d5:" .. chapter.id .. ":"
        if map.version ~= 4 or map.firstFloor ~= chapter.first or map.terminalFloor ~= chapter.last
            or map.sourceSignature:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return end
    end
    if type(map.nodes) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, node in ipairs(map.nodes) do
        if type(node) ~= "table" or not finite(node.floor) or node.floor % 1 ~= 0 or node.floor < chapter.first or node.floor > chapter.last
            or node.localFloor ~= nil and node.localFloor ~= node.floor - chapter.first + 1 then return end
    end
    return chapter

        child(box,"hit").canControllerFocus = enabled
        tint(child(box,"frame"), not enabled and Theme.color.line
            or (pressed or hover) and Theme.color.goldBright or Theme.color.goldDim)
        tint(child(box,"body"), pressed and Theme.color.goldDim
            or hover and Theme.color.buttonHover or Theme.color.panel)
        local ink = not enabled and Theme.color.textMuted
            or pressed and Theme.color.buttonPressedText or Theme.color.text
        child(box,"label").fontColor = colour(ink.r,ink.g,ink.b,ink.a)
        local scale = pressed and Theme.layout.nativeNode.buttonStates.pressedScale
            or Theme.layout.nativeNode.buttonStates.normalScale
        box:SetLocalScale(scale,scale,1)
    end
    local function position(node)
        return (node.lane - (Layout.lanes + 1) / 2) * Theme.layout.map.columnGap,
            Layout.firstY + (localFloor(self.map, node.floor) - 1) * Theme.layout.map.floorGap - self.scroll
    end
    local function observeMap(current)
        if self.map == self.observedMap and sameContext(current,self.observedContext) then return false end
        cancelDrag()
        -- A restarted run can share floor/node ids with the previous run. Identity
        -- resets its presentation and default gate before the host grants access.
        self.observedMap, self.observedContext = self.map, current
        self.entryError=nil
        self.observedNodeId, self.observedFloor = current.currentNodeId, current.floor
        self.navigationEnabled, self.time = atStart(current), 0
        self.scroll = clamp(Layout.firstY + (math.max(1, localFloor(current, current.floor)) - 1) *
            Theme.layout.map.floorGap - Layout.focusY, 0, Layout.maxScroll)
        return true
    end
    local function line(control, source, target, taken, reachable)
        local x1, y1 = position(source)
        local x2, y2 = position(target)
        -- Clip real graph segments to viewport, with half-stroke padding.
        local low, high = Layout.viewport.bottom + Layout.lineWidth / 2, Layout.viewport.top - Layout.lineWidth / 2
        if y2 < low or y1 > high then control:SetVisible(false) return end
        local a, b = clamp((low - y1) / (y2 - y1), 0, 1), clamp((high - y1) / (y2 - y1), 0, 1)
        local ax, ay = x1 + (x2 - x1) * a, y1 + (y2 - y1) * a
        local bx, by = x1 + (x2 - x1) * b, y1 + (y2 - y1) * b
        local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
        if dy <= 0 then control:SetVisible(false) return end
        control:SetVisible(true)
        control:SetAnchoredPosition((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
        control:SetSizeDelta(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), Layout.lineWidth)
        control.localRotationZ = math.atan(dy, dx) * 180 / math.pi
        control.imageColor = taken and pathColours.taken or reachable and pathColours.next or pathColours.future
    end
    function self.render(_)
        if not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        local context = chapterFor(self.map)
        if not context then
            cancelDrag()
            self.navigationEnabled, self.slots, self.breathing = false, {}, {}
            at("title").text, at("notice").text = "", "地图章节信息无效 · 请重新启程"
            at("notice"):SetVisible(true)
            for i = 1, Layout.maxNodes do at("node" .. i):SetVisible(false) end
            for i = 1, Layout.maxEdges do at("edge" .. i):SetVisible(false) end
            for _, name in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do paintButton(name) end
            return
        end
        local current, nodes, taken = Map.view(self.map), {}, {}
        observeMap(current)
        if current.currentNodeId ~= self.observedNodeId or current.floor ~= self.observedFloor then
            cancelDrag()
            self.navigationEnabled = false
        end
        self.observedNodeId, self.observedFloor = current.currentNodeId, current.floor
        for _, node in ipairs(current.nodes) do nodes[node.id] = node end
        for i = 1, #current.path - 1 do taken[current.path[i] .. ":" .. current.path[i + 1]] = true end
        self.slots, self.breathing = {}, {}
        local chapter = Acts.get(current.act or 1)
        local terminal = chapter.terminal == 'boss_treasure' and "已抵达首领宝箱 · 请完成当前房间"
            or current.act == 4 and "已抵达终幕首领 · 请完成最终战斗与结算"
            or "已抵达终点 · 请完成当前房间"
        at("title").text = chapter.name .. " · 第 " .. current.floor .. " 层"
        at("notice").text = self.entryError or (current.complete and terminal or
            (current.floor == chapter.boss and (self.navigationEnabled
                and (chapter.terminal == 'boss_treasure' and "首领奖励已处理 · 请选择首领宝箱" or "首领奖励已处理 · 请前往终点")
                or "已抵达首领 · 请完成首领战斗与奖励") or
            (self.navigationEnabled and "" or "请先完成当前节点")
            ))
        local notice=current.emeraldSelection and Theme.layout.map.emeraldNotice or Theme.layout.map.notice
        at('notice'):SetAnchoredPosition(notice[1],notice[2]);at('notice'):SetSizeDelta(notice[3],Theme.layout.map.presentation.noticeHeight)
        if current.emeraldSelection then
            local prefix=at('notice').text~='' and at('notice').text..' · ' or ''
            at('notice').text=prefix..'绿字节点为燃烧精英，胜利可另领绿钥匙'
        end
        at('notice'):SetVisible(at('notice').text~='')
        buttonHover, buttonPress = nil, nil
        for _, name in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do paintButton(name) end
        local edge = 0
        for _, node in ipairs(current.nodes) do for _, id in ipairs(node.nextIds) do
            edge = edge + 1
            assert(edge <= Layout.maxEdges, "map UI edge capacity exceeded")
            local target = assert(nodes[id], "map UI dangling route")
            line(at("edge" .. edge), node, target, taken[node.id .. ":" .. id], node.id == current.currentNodeId and target.available)
        end end
        for i = edge + 1, Layout.maxEdges do at("edge" .. i):SetVisible(false) end
        assert(#current.nodes <= Layout.maxNodes, "map UI node capacity exceeded")
        for i = 1, Layout.maxNodes do
            local box, node = at("node" .. i), current.nodes[i]
            local visible = false
            if node then
                local size = node.type == "boss" and Theme.layout.map.bossNode or Theme.layout.map.node
                local x, y = position(node)
                -- Native container clipping is not established. Cull whole targets,
                -- including glow/breath extent, so no offscreen hit area can leak.
                local radius = (size + Layout.glowPadding) * Layout.breathScale / 2
                if node.hasEmeraldKey then radius=math.max(radius,math.abs(Theme.layout.map.emeraldLabel[2])+Theme.layout.map.emeraldLabel[4]/2)end
                visible = y - radius >= Layout.viewport.bottom and y + radius <= Layout.viewport.top
                -- Hidden rows have no slots or focus targets. Avoid rewriting
                -- every child of all 17 floors during each pan animation frame.
                if visible then
                box:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
                box:SetSizeDelta(size, size)
                box.localScaleX, box.localScaleY = 1, 1
                local state = node.id == current.currentNodeId and "current" or
                    (node.visited and "visited" or (node.available and "available" or "locked"))
                local token = child(box, "positionToken")
                token:SetVisible(state == "current")
                local icon = child(box, "icon")
                icon:SetSizeDelta(size * .6, size * .6)
                local iconId = assert(Theme.icon.node[node.type], "missing node icon")
                icon:SetImage(imageSource, iconId)
                local palette = Theme.color.mapCanvas
                tint(icon, state == 'locked' and palette.far or state == 'visited' and palette.visited or palette.kind[node.type])
                icon:SetAnchoredPosition(0,node.hasEmeraldKey and Theme.layout.map.emeraldIconY or 0)
                if node.hasEmeraldKey then tint(icon,Theme.color.positive)end
                child(box,'emeraldLabel'):SetVisible(node.hasEmeraldKey==true)
                local hit = child(box, "hit")
                hit:SetSizeDelta(size, size)
                local clickable = visible and state == "available" and self.navigationEnabled
                    and not self.choosing and not scrollAnimation
                hit:SetVisible(clickable)
                hit.canControllerFocus = clickable
                if visible then self.slots[i] = node.id end
                if clickable then self.breathing[#self.breathing + 1] = box end
                else
                    child(box, 'hit'):SetVisible(false)
                    child(box, 'hit').canControllerFocus = false
                end
            end
            box:SetVisible(visible)
        end
        self:update(0)
    end
    function self.resize(_, width, height)
        if not finite(width) or not finite(height) or width <= 0 or height <= 0 then return false, "invalid_canvas" end
        cancelDrag()
        for _, name in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do paintButton(name) end
        self.canvasWidth, self.canvasHeight = width, height
        if embedded then self.scale = 1 return true end
        local scale = math.min(width / Theme.canvas.base[1], height / Theme.canvas.base[2])
        stage.localScaleX, stage.localScaleY = scale, scale
        backdrop:SetSizeDelta(width, height)
        self.scale = scale
        return true
    end
    function self.update(_, dt)
        if not finite(dt) or dt < 0 then return false, "invalid_delta" end
        if not self.visible then return true end
        local usingController = Controller.isController(options.controller)
        if self.usingController ~= usingController then
            self.usingController = usingController
            for _, name in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do paintButton(name) end
        end
        if not chapterFor(self.map) or self.map ~= self.observedMap or not sameContext(self.map,self.observedContext) then
            self:render()
            return true
        end
        self.time = (self.time + dt) % Layout.breathSeconds
        if scrollAnimation and dt > 0 then
            -- A coordinator may replace/advance the map before the next render.
            if self.map ~= self.observedMap or self.map.floor ~= self.observedFloor
                or self.map.currentNodeId ~= self.observedNodeId then
                cancelDrag()
            else
                scrollAnimation.elapsed = scrollAnimation.elapsed + dt
                local t = clamp(scrollAnimation.elapsed / Layout.scrollSeconds,0,1)
                local from, target = scrollAnimation.from, scrollAnimation.target
                self.scroll = clamp(from + (target - from) * (1 - (1 - t)^3),0,Layout.maxScroll)
                if t == 1 then self.scroll, scrollAnimation = target, nil end
            end
            -- render's update(0) only paints breathing; it cannot advance/recurse.
            self:render()
            return true
        end
        local scale = self.reducedMotion and 1 or 1 + (Layout.breathScale - 1) *
            (1 - math.cos(self.time * 2 * math.pi / Layout.breathSeconds)) / 2
        for _, box in ipairs(self.breathing) do box.localScaleX, box.localScaleY = scale, scale end
        return true
    end
    function self.setReducedMotion(_, value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "reduced motion must be boolean")
        self.reducedMotion = value
        if value and scrollAnimation then return self:setScroll(scrollAnimation.target) end
        self:update(0)
    end
    function self.setScroll(_, value)
        if not finite(value) then return false, "invalid_scroll" end
        value = clamp(value, 0, Layout.maxScroll)
        if value ~= self.scroll or scrollAnimation then cancelSelection() end
        scrollAnimation = nil
        self.scroll = value self:render() return true
    end
    local function animateScrollTo(value)
        if not self.visible then return false,"map_hidden" end
        value = clamp(value,0,Layout.maxScroll)
        if scrollAnimation and scrollAnimation.target == value then return true end
        cancelDrag()
        if value == self.scroll or self.reducedMotion then return self:setScroll(value) end
        scrollAnimation = {from=self.scroll,target=value,elapsed=0}
        self:render()
        return true
    end
    function self.scrollBy(_, delta)
        if not self.visible then return false, "map_hidden" end
        if not finite(delta) then return false, "invalid_scroll" end
        return self:setScroll(self.scroll + delta)
    end
    function self.focusCurrent(_, animated)
        if not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        if not chapterFor(self.map) then self:render() return false,"invalid_map_context" end
        local current = Map.view(self.map)
        observeMap(current)
        local target = Layout.firstY + (math.max(1,localFloor(current,current.floor)) - 1) * Theme.layout.map.floorGap - Layout.focusY
        if animated then return animateScrollTo(target) end
        return self:setScroll(target)
    end
    function self.setNavigationEnabled(_, enabled)
        if not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        assert(type(enabled) == "boolean", "navigation enabled must be boolean")
        if not enabled then cancelDrag() end
        -- An explicit coordinator grant acknowledges any external map advance.
        if not chapterFor(self.map) then self:render() return false,"invalid_map_context" end
        local current = Map.view(self.map)
        observeMap(current)
        self.observedNodeId, self.observedFloor = current.currentNodeId, current.floor
        self.navigationEnabled = enabled self:render()
    end
    function self.setVisible(_, visible)
        assert(type(visible) == "boolean", "map visibility must be boolean")
        if visible and not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        if not visible then cancelDrag() end
        self.visible = visible root:SetVisible(visible)
        if visible then self:focusCurrent() end
    end
    function self.choose(_, nodeId)
        if not self.map then return false, "map_unbound" end
        if not chapterFor(self.map) then self:render() return false,"invalid_map_context" end
        local beforeMap = self.map
        local before = Map.view(beforeMap)
        if observeMap(before) then self:render() end
        if not self.visible or not self.navigationEnabled or self.choosing then return false, "navigation_disabled" end
        if before.complete then return false, "map_complete" end
        if type(nodeId) ~= "string" then return false, "invalid_node" end
        local selected
        for _, node in ipairs(Map.available(self.map)) do if node.id == nodeId then selected = node break end end
        if not selected then
            for _, node in ipairs(before.nodes) do if node.id == nodeId then return false, "node_unavailable" end end
            return false, "invalid_node"
        end
        local expectedFloor = selected.floor
        self.choosing = true
        local called, accepted, reason = pcall(onChoose, selected)
        self.choosing = false
        if not chapterFor(self.map) then self:render() return false,"invalid_map_context" end
        local after = Map.view(self.map)
        observeMap(after)
        local changed = self.map ~= beforeMap or not sameContext(after,before)
            or after.floor ~= before.floor or after.currentNodeId ~= before.currentNodeId
        if changed then self.navigationEnabled = false self:focusCurrent() end
        if not called or accepted~=true then
            local messages={event_pool_exhausted='受限事件池已用尽，或剩余事件条件不足；请选择其他路线或重新启程。',
                event_not_implemented='此事件尚未实现；请选择其他路线。',combat_unavailable='此层没有可用遭遇；请选择其他路线。'}
            local failure=called and (reason or 'choice_rejected') or 'choice_callback_error'
            self.entryError=messages[failure] or '暂时无法进入，请完成当前操作后重试。'
            self:render()
            return false,failure
        end
        self.entryError=nil
        if self.map ~= beforeMap or not sameContext(after,before) or after.currentNodeId ~= nodeId or after.floor ~= expectedFloor then return false, "selection_not_committed" end
        self.navigationEnabled = false self:focusCurrent() return true
    end
    -- Dragging the route scrolls it with the finger. A press that moved past the
    -- threshold is a scroll, never a node choice, even if it ends on a node.
    local cursor = options.cursor
    local pointerInput = cursor and cursor.CursorDown and cursor.CursorUp
    local function touch(event) return event and event.touchId end
    local function selectionFor(slot, event)
        if not slot or not self.visible or not self.navigationEnabled then return end
        local nodeId = self.slots[slot]
        for _, node in ipairs(Map.available(self.map)) do
            if node.id == nodeId then
                return {slot=slot, nodeId=nodeId, map=self.map, floor=self.map.floor,
                    currentNodeId=self.map.currentNodeId, context=self.observedContext, touch=touch(event)}
            end
        end
    end
    local function validSelection(selection, slot)
        return selection and chapterFor(self.map) ~= nil and selection.slot == slot and selection.map == self.map
            and sameContext(selection.context,self.map)
            and selection.floor == self.map.floor and selection.currentNodeId == self.map.currentNodeId
            and selection.nodeId == self.slots[slot] and self.visible and self.navigationEnabled
    end
    local function pointY(event)
        if not event or type(event.GetUIPos) ~= "function" then return end
        local _, y = event:GetUIPos()
        if type(y) ~= "number" or not finite(y) then return end
        local width, height = self.canvasWidth or Theme.canvas.base[1], self.canvasHeight or Theme.canvas.base[2]
        return y / math.min(width / Theme.canvas.base[1], height / Theme.canvas.base[2])
    end
    local function press(event, slot)
        pointerObserved = true
        -- Down is idempotent until the owner releases or is cancelled. A repeated
        -- callback cannot rearm a selection that already exited or began scrolling.
        if not self.visible or not self.map then return end
        if not chapterFor(self.map) then self:render() return end
        if observeMap(Map.view(self.map)) then self:render() end
        if drag then
            -- A same-owner node Down can retire an abandoned background drag.
            -- Background has no node selection to steal; its delayed Up cannot
            -- release this node slot. Node-to-node ownership stays exclusive.
            if drag.touch == nil or drag.touch ~= touch(event) or drag.slot ~= nil or slot == nil then return end
            cancelDrag()
        end
        cancelSelection()
        self.dragged = false
        local y = pointY(event)
        local wasAnimating = scrollAnimation ~= nil
        scrollAnimation = nil
        -- Position is optional for a tap. Ownership must still work on hosts
        -- that supply Down/Up but omit drag events or pointer coordinates.
        drag = {touch=touch(event), startY=y, y=y,
            selection=not wasAnimating and selectionFor(slot,event) or nil, slot=slot}
        if wasAnimating then self:render() end
    end
    local function move(event, slot)
        if not self.visible then cancelDrag() return end
        if not drag or touch(event) ~= drag.touch or slot ~= drag.slot then return end
        local y = pointY(event)
        if not y or not drag.startY then return end
        if not drag.moving and math.abs(y - drag.startY) < Layout.dragThreshold then return end
        drag.moving, self.dragged = true, true
        -- UI y grows upward; content follows the finger, so scroll moves the other way.
        local delta = y - drag.y
        drag.y = y
        -- Rendering may observe a replaced/advanced map and cancel this drag.
        self:setScroll(self.scroll - delta)
    end
    local function release(event, slot)
        if not drag or touch(event) ~= drag.touch or slot ~= drag.slot then return end
        move(event, slot)
        if drag and not drag.moving and validSelection(drag.selection, slot) then
            released = drag.selection
        end
        drag = nil
    end
    local function cancelPointer(event, slot, terminal)
        if released and touch(event) == released.touch and slot == released.slot then released = nil end
        if drag and touch(event) == drag.touch and slot == drag.slot then
            drag.selection = nil
            if terminal then cancelDrag() end
        end
    end
    local function draggable(control, slot)
        if not pointerInput then return end
        control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorDown, function(event) press(event, slot) end)
        if cursor.CursorDrag then control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorDrag, function(event) move(event, slot) end) end
        control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorUp, function(event) release(event, slot) end)
        if cursor.CursorExit then control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorExit, function(event) cancelPointer(event, slot) end) end
        if cursor.CursorEndDrag then control:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorEndDrag, function(event) cancelPointer(event, slot, true) end) end
    end
    draggable(at("dragArea"))
    for i = 1, Layout.maxNodes do local slot = i bind("node" .. slot, function(event)
        if scrollAnimation then return false,"map_scrolling" end
        if pointerInput and (pointerObserved or touch(event) ~= nil) then
            -- Up grants only its original map/node one Click. A foreign callback
            -- cannot consume that grant or borrow a newer active gesture.
            local selection = released
            if drag or not selection or touch(event) ~= nil and touch(event) ~= selection.touch then
                return false, "stale_gesture"
            end
            if selection.slot ~= slot then return false, "stale_gesture" end
            released = nil
            if not validSelection(selection, slot) then return false, "stale_gesture" end
            return self:choose(selection.nodeId)
        end
        -- Click-only/accessibility hosts retain the existing intentional click path.
        if self.dragged then self.dragged = false return false, "dragged" end
        if self.slots[slot] then return self:choose(self.slots[slot]) end
        return false, "node_outside_viewport"
    end) draggable(child(at("node" .. slot), "hit"), slot) end
    local function step(name,delta)
        if not buttonEnabled(name) then return false,self.visible and "scroll_boundary" or "map_hidden" end
        -- Queue same-direction steps; an opposite click must reverse what is
        -- actually displayed, even when many earlier clicks queued a far target.
        local target = self.scroll
        if scrollAnimation and (scrollAnimation.target - self.scroll) * delta > 0 then
            target = scrollAnimation.target
        end
        return animateScrollTo(target + delta)
    end
    bind("previous", function() return step("previous",-Layout.scrollStep) end)
    bind("next", function() return step("next",Layout.scrollStep) end)
    bind("focus", function() if self.visible then return self:focusCurrent(true) end return false,"map_hidden" end)
    -- Reuse existing faces and documented events; no extra controls or timers.
    for _, key in ipairs({"previous","next","focus"}) do
        local name, hit = key, child(at(key),"hit")
        local function listen(event,callback) if event then hit:AddCursorEventListener(event,callback) end end
        local function clear(event,terminal)
            if buttonPress and buttonPress.name == name and (terminal or touch(event) == buttonPress.touch) then buttonPress = nil end
            if buttonHover == name then buttonHover = nil end
            paintButton(name)
        end
        listen(cursor and cursor.CursorEnter,function(event)
            if buttonEnabled(name) and touch(event) == nil then buttonHover = name paintButton(name) end
        end)
        listen(cursor and cursor.CursorDown,function(event)
            if buttonEnabled(name) then buttonPress = {name=name,touch=touch(event)} paintButton(name) end
        end)
        listen(cursor and cursor.CursorUp,clear)
        listen(cursor and cursor.CursorExit,function(event) clear(event,true) end)
        listen(cursor and cursor.CursorEndDrag,function(event) clear(event,true) end)
    end
    self:resize(Theme.canvas.base[1], Theme.canvas.base[2])
    if map then self:focusCurrent() else root:SetVisible(false) end
    return self
end
return M

-- STS319009 Strawberry/Pear/Mango/Waffle.onEquip and AbstractCreature health.
-- Called only on the private Run acquisition transaction. No random actions.
local Health=require('abyss_potion_health')
local Events=require('abyss_events')
local M={}
local increases={strawberry=7,pear=10,mango=14,lees_waffle=7}
local function integer(n)return type(n)=='number'and n%1==0 and n>=0 and n<=2147483647 end
local function relics(run)
 local result={}
 for _,id in ipairs(run.relics or {})do
  result[#result+1]=id=='Mark of the Bloom'and'mark_of_bloom'or id=='Magic Flower'and'magic_flower'or id
 end
 return result
end
local function heal(run,actor,battle,requested,onHpChanged)
 -- AbstractCreature.heal refuses a dying actor; it is not a revival source.
 if actor.isDying or actor.hp<=0 then return end
 local amount=Health.modifyHealing(requested,relics(run),battle~=nil)
 local before=actor.hp
 actor.hp=math.min(actor.maxHp,actor.hp+0.0+amount)
 if battle then
  Events.emit(battle,'heal',{target=actor.id,amount=actor.hp-before})
  onHpChanged(battle,actor,before)
 end
end
function M.equip(run,id,onHpChanged)
 local amount=assert(increases[id],'unsupported maximum-health relic')
 assert(run.phase~='combat'or type(run.combat)=='table'and type(run.combat.player)=='table','missing active health owner')
 local battle=run.phase=='combat'and run.combat or nil
 assert(not battle or not battle.originalV4,'source maximum-health context unavailable')
 local actor=battle and battle.player or run
 assert(type(actor)=='table'and integer(actor.maxHp)and actor.maxHp>=1
  and integer(actor.hp)and actor.hp<=actor.maxHp,'invalid relic health')
 -- Preserve the existing finite runtime capacity rather than partially granting
 -- ownership and wrapping a signed integer. This is a safety refusal, not a
 -- claim that the source Java overflow path is meaningful ordinary gameplay.
 assert(actor.maxHp+0.0+amount<=2147483647,'maximum health capacity')
 actor.maxHp=actor.maxHp+0.0+amount
 -- Source increaseMaxHp invokes ordinary heal(amount,true) even when Waffle
 -- passes showEffect=false. Waffle then invokes heal of the NEW maximum.
 heal(run,actor,battle,amount,onHpChanged)
 if id=='lees_waffle'then heal(run,actor,battle,actor.maxHp,onHpChanged)end
 if battle then run.hp,run.maxHp=actor.hp,actor.maxHp end
end
return M

local Theme = require("abyss_theme")

local CardDisplay = require('abyss_card_display')
local EndingUI=require('abyss_node_ui_ending')
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local C = Theme.color
local kinds = { camp = "营地", shop = "商店", event = "未知事件", treasure = "宝箱",ending_proceed='真结局' }

local OPTIONS = #layout.event.options.rows
local function snapshotDeck(deck)
