-- Initialization responsibility for the same-run API.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local EventRandom = require("abyss_sts_random")
local Unknown = require("abyss_unknown")
local EventPool = require("abyss_event_pool")
local RunSeed = require("abyss_run_seed")
local EncounterQueue = require("abyss_encounter_queue")
local CardRandom = require("abyss_card_random")
local RelicPool = require('abyss_relic_pool')

local M = {}

function M.install(Run, shared)
    local preparedCharacters=shared.preparedCharacters
    local preparedOriginalRoles=shared.preparedOriginalRoles
    local function prepareProfile(data, options)
        local profile,ownsData
        if options ~= nil then
            assert(type(options)=='table','invalid character options')
            assert(options.campaign==nil or type(options.campaign)=='boolean','invalid campaign option')
            assert(options.campaignProfile==nil or options.campaign==true
                and (options.campaignProfile=='competition-two-act' or options.campaignProfile=='full-source'),
                'invalid campaign profile')
            assert(not options.campaign or options.experimental==true,
                'campaign requires explicit experimental mode')
            assert(require('abyss_run_admission').accepts(data,options),'competition_character_unavailable')
            if require('abyss_original_v4_profiles').is(options.character) then
                data,profile=require('abyss_original_v4_profiles').prepare(data,options.character)
                ownsData=true
            else
                assert(options.experimental == true,
                    "non-default characters require explicit experimental mode")
                if options.character~=nil then
                    data,profile=require('abyss_run_card_catalog').prepareSelected(data,options.character)
                    ownsData=true
                end
            end
        end
        return data, profile, ownsData
    end

    local function prepareCatalog(sourceData, data, profile, ownsData, options)
        local ownsCatalog
        local legacyPrepared=not profile and (not options or options.character==nil) and
            (preparedCharacters[data.experimentalCharacter] and data.characterId==data.experimentalCharacter
            or preparedOriginalRoles[data.originalV4Role] and type(data.originalV4Rules)=='table')
        if not legacyPrepared and not (profile and profile.originalV4)then
            data=require('abyss_run_card_catalog').prepare(sourceData,data,profile and profile.id,ownsData)
            ownsData,ownsCatalog=true,true
        end
        return data, ownsData, ownsCatalog, legacyPrepared
    end

    local function finishCatalog(run, ownsCatalog)
        local sources=run.data.cards.sourcePools
        sources.cardSourceMetadata=sources.cardSourceMetadata or {}
        if ownsCatalog then
            require('abyss_run_card_catalog').finishMetadata(run.data)
        else
            for _,card in ipairs(run.data.cards.cards)do
                if not sources.cardSourceMetadata[card.id] then
                    sources.cardSourceMetadata[card.id]={sourceId=card.sourceId or card.sts_name or card.id,
                        rarity=card.rarity,type=card.type,healing=card.healing==true}
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function initializeRelicPool(run, data, profile, legacyPrepared, runData, eventSeed)
        if data.relicSource then
            -- RelicLibrary.populateRelicPool appends the chosen class library to
            -- shared relics before the same five shuffles. Original V4 has no
            -- declared STS class mapping and retains its existing source contract.
            local class=profile and not profile.originalV4 and profile.id or legacyPrepared and data.characterId
            if class and class~='ironclad' and preparedCharacters[class]then
                local classCatalogs=assert(runData.classRelicSources,'missing class relic catalogs')
                runData.relicSource=assert(classCatalogs[class],'missing class relic source')
            end
            run.relicPool=RelicPool.new(eventSeed,runData.relicSource)
        end
    end

    function Run.new(data, seed, options)
        local sourceData=data
        local profile,ownsData,ownsCatalog
        data,profile,ownsData=prepareProfile(data,options)
        -- Historical Profile.prepare(data,id) -> Run.new(prepared,seed) accepts
        -- an already filtered/adapted component, without inferring a Run profile.
        local legacyPrepared
        data, ownsData, ownsCatalog, legacyPrepared = prepareCatalog(sourceData, data, profile, ownsData, options)
        data=require('abyss_colorless_cards').withCards(data,ownsCatalog)
        local eventSeed = RunSeed.normalize(seed)
        local cardOwner = CardRandom.new(eventSeed)
        -- Profile factories already detached the whole input graph. Their private
        -- result can be adopted; caller-owned/default bundles still need a copy.
        local runData=ownsData and data or Combat.copy(data)
        if legacyPrepared then
            -- These new internal markers are not legacy rules or ownership proof.
            -- Clear only the detached graph, preserving the old combat defaults.
            runData.runCardCatalog,runData.runCardCharacter=nil,nil
        end
        require('abyss_class_potions').register(runData)
        local run = { version = data.rules.version, data = runData, seed = RunSeed.legacy(eventSeed),runSeed=eventSeed,
            eventSeed = eventSeed, eventRng = EventRandom.fromSeed(eventSeed), miscRng = EventRandom.fromSeed(eventSeed),
            treasureRng = EventRandom.fromSeed(eventSeed),
            cardRng = cardOwner.cardRng,cardRarityOffset=cardOwner.cardRarityOffset,
            encounters=EncounterQueue.new(eventSeed),roomGeneration=0,
            -- Launch supports the exact source !isBossSeen(GUARDIAN) branch. It
            -- duplicates Guardian and spends no monsterRng; no all-unlocked claim.
            bossInitialization={profile='guardian-unseen',bossList={'The Guardian','The Guardian'}},
            unknown = { chances = Unknown.newPc(), pools = EventPool.new(data.rules.events.poolMode or 'restricted-six') },
            phase = "map", floor = 1, hp = data.rules.player.maxHp, maxHp = data.rules.player.maxHp,
            elapsedSeconds = 0, victories = 0,
            gold = data.rules.player.startingGold, deck = {}, nextDeckUid = 1,
            relics = Combat.copy(data.rules.player.startingRelics), potions = {} }
        finishCatalog(run, ownsCatalog)
        if profile then run.character, run.characterProfile = profile.id, Combat.copy(profile) end
        if profile and profile.originalV4 then run.originalCommands={}end
        if options and options.campaign then
            run.campaign,run.act,run.keys=true,1,{ruby=false,emerald=false,sapphire=false}
            run.campaignProfile=options.campaignProfile or 'full-source'
            run.unknown.pools=EventPool.new('full')
        end
        for _, id in ipairs(data.cards.starter_deck.cards) do
            run.deck[#run.deck + 1] = { uid = run.nextDeckUid, cardId = id, upgraded = false }
            run.nextDeckUid = run.nextDeckUid + 1
        end
        initializeRelicPool(run, data, profile, legacyPrepared, runData, eventSeed)
        return run
    end


end

return M

 event.stage,event.body='intro','Sensory Stone之中封存着一段记忆。'
end
function M.options(_,event)
 if event.stage=='intro'then return {row('continue','继续','查看记忆的代价。')}end
 if event.stage=='choice'then return {
  row('one','记忆1','获得1组无色卡牌奖励，不失去生命。'),
  row('two','记忆2','获得2组无色卡牌奖励，然后失去5点生命（HP_LOSS）。'),
  row('three','记忆3','获得3组无色卡牌奖励，然后失去10点生命（HP_LOSS）。')}
 end
 if event.stage=='result'then return {row('leave','离开','返回路线，放弃尚未领取的奖励。')}end
 local out={}
 if event.stage=='rewards'then
  for _,group in ipairs(event.rewards)do if not group.claimed then
   out[#out+1]=row('open_'..group.id,'无色奖励 '..group.id,'从本组选择一张牌；跳过后仍可重新查看。')
  end end
  out[#out+1]=row('proceed','结束奖励','返回事件，尚未领取的奖励将被放弃。')
 elseif event.stage=='cards'then
  local group=event.rewards[event.selectedReward]
  for i,c in ipairs(group.cards)do out[#out+1]=row('take_'..group.id..'_'..i,'领取卡牌','永久加入牌组。',c)end
  out[#out+1]=row('skip_'..group.id,'跳过本组','返回奖励列表，不改变本组候选。')
 end
 return out
end
local function remember(run,event,num)
 local ok,why=dependencies(run);if not ok then return false,why end
 local memories={1,2,3,4};R.shuffle(run.miscRng,memories)
 local groups,nextRng,offset=rewards(run,num);if not groups then return false,nextRng end
 event.memory,event.rewards,event.choiceCount=memories[1],groups,num
 event.stage,event.rewardScreenOpen='rewards',true
 event.body='记忆 '..event.memory..' · 请选择任意一组无色奖励。'
 run.cardRng,run.cardRarityOffset=nextRng,offset
 event.hpLoss=(num-1)*5
 if event.hpLoss>0 then
  local accepted,reason=Run.eventDamage(run,event.hpLoss);if not accepted then return false,reason end
 end
 return true,'pending'
end
local function chooseReward(_,event,choice)
 local index=tonumber(choice:match('^open_(%d+)$'))
 if index then
  local group=event.rewards[index];if not group or group.claimed then return false,'invalid_event_choice'end
  event.selectedReward,event.stage=index,'cards';return true,'pending'
 end
 if choice~='proceed'then return false,'invalid_event_choice'end
 event.stage,event.rewardScreenOpen,event.selectedReward='result',false,nil
 event.body='记忆渐渐散去。你可以继续前行。';return true,'pending'
end
local function chooseCard(run,event,choice)
 local group=event.rewards[event.selectedReward]
 if choice=='skip_'..group.id then event.stage,event.selectedReward='rewards',nil;return true,'pending'end
 local id,index=choice:match('^take_(%d+)_(%d+)$');id,index=tonumber(id),tonumber(index)
 if id~=group.id or not index or not group.cards[index]or group.claimed then return false,'invalid_event_choice'end
 local ready,why=dependencies(run);if not ready then return false,why end
 local card=group.cards[index];local d=definition(run,card.cardId)
 if not d or d.sourceId~=card.sourceCardId or d.rarity~=card.rarity then return false,'stale_event_card'end
 local expected={upgraded=false};RelicHooks.onPreviewObtainCard(run,expected,d)
 if card.upgraded~=expected.upgraded or card.upgrades~=expected.upgrades then return false,'stale_event_card'end
 local ok,uid=Run.obtainCard(run,card.cardId,{upgraded=card.upgraded,upgrades=card.upgrades})
 if not ok then return false,uid end
 group.claimed,group.obtainedUid,group.selectedIndex=true,uid,index
 event.stage,event.selectedReward='rewards',nil;return true,'pending'
end
function M.choose(run,flow,choice,uid)
 local event=flow.event
 if run.act~=3 or uid~=nil or type(choice)~='string'then return false,'invalid_event_choice'end
 if event.stage=='intro'and choice=='continue'then event.stage='choice';return true,'pending'end
 if event.stage=='choice'and counts[choice]then return remember(run,event,counts[choice])end
 if event.stage=='rewards'then return chooseReward(run,event,choice)end
 if event.stage=='cards'then return chooseCard(run,event,choice)end
 if event.stage=='result'and choice=='leave'then return true,'complete'end
 return false,'invalid_event_choice'
end
return M

local fortifyBlock,piercerStrength,bashLoss=30,2,-1
local function move(id,kind,effects)return{id=id,kind=kind,effects=effects or {}}end

 {id='spire_shield',sourceId='SpireShield',name='尖塔之盾',tier='elite',hp=110,
  sourcePosition={x=-1000,y=15},spireSide='left',ai={kind='spire_pair',policy='shield'},intents={
   move('bash','attack',{{op='damage',value=12}}),move('fortify','defend'),
   move('smash','attack',{{op='damage',value=34}})}},
 {id='spire_spear',sourceId='SpireSpear',name='尖塔之矛',tier='elite',hp=160,
  sourcePosition={x=70,y=10},spireSide='right',ai={kind='spire_pair',policy='spear'},intents={
   move('burn_strike','attack',{{op='damage',value=5,times=2},{op='makeTempCardInDiscard',card='burn',value=2}}),
   move('piercer','buff'),move('skewer','attack',{{op='damage',value=10,times=3}})}}}
M.statuses={
 {id='surrounded',sourceId='Surrounded',name='被包围',kind='buff',stack='none',decay='none',
  description='转向指定目标；身后的敌人造成50%额外攻击伤害。'},
 {id='back_attack',sourceId='BackAttack',name='背刺',kind='buff',stack='none',decay='none',

 for _,entry in ipairs(M.enemies)do
  assert(not catalog.enemies[entry.id],'duplicate Spire pair enemy');catalog.enemies[entry.id]=copy(entry)
 end
 for _,entry in ipairs(M.statuses)do
  assert(not catalog.statuses[entry.id],'duplicate Spire pair Power');catalog.statuses[entry.id]=copy(entry)
 end
end
function M.owns(enemy)return enemy~=nil and enemy.ai~=nil and enemy.ai.kind=='spire_pair'end
function M.resolve(source,tier)
 if source~='Shield and Spear'then return nil,'act_content_unavailable'end
 if tier~='elite'then return nil,'encounter_tier_mismatch'end
 return{id='ending_spire_pair',tier=tier,source=source,enemies={'spire_shield','spire_spear'}}
end

 for i,intent in ipairs(enemy.intents)do if intent.id==id then enemy.intentIndex=i;enemy.spireSmashBlock=nil;return end end

end

 assert(M.owns(enemy),'Spire pair AI owner required')
 random(state,100) -- AbstractMonster.rollMove consumes num even though ignored.
 local phase,id=enemy.spireMoveCount%3
 if enemy.ai.policy=='shield'then
  if phase==0 then id=Random.boolean(state,random)and 'fortify'or 'bash'
  elseif phase==1 then id=enemy.spireLast=='bash'and 'fortify'or 'bash'
  else id='smash'end
 else

  if phase==0 then id=enemy.spireLast=='burn_strike'and 'piercer'or 'burn_strike'
  elseif phase==1 then id='skewer'

 enemy.spireMoveCount,enemy.spireLast=0,nil;M.advance(state,enemy,random)

    if (enemy.statuses.back_attack or 0)==0 then api.applyPower(state,enemy,'back_attack',1,nil)end
   elseif (enemy.statuses.back_attack or 0)~=0 then api.removePower(state,enemy,'back_attack')end

 end

 return math.floor(f32(f32(normalOutput)*1.5))
end
function M.intentDamage(state,enemy,preFinal,finalReceive)
 local value=preFinal
 if M.backAttack(state,enemy)then
  value=f32(f32(value)*1.5);value=value<0 and math.ceil(value)or math.floor(value)
 end
 return math.max(0,math.floor(finalReceive(value)))
end
local function append(actions,kind,enemy,target,fields)
 local action={kind=kind,sourceId=enemy.id,targetId=target and target.id or nil}
 for key,value in pairs(fields or {})do action[key]=value end
 actions[#actions+1]=action
end
local function attacks(actions,state,enemy,base,times,snapshotDamage)
 local output=M.actualDamage(state,enemy,snapshotDamage(state,enemy,base))
 for _=1,times do append(actions,'damage',enemy,state.player,{value=base,normalAmount=output})end
 return output
end
function M.previewEffects(state,enemy,intent,snapshotDamage)
 local effects=Copy(intent.effects)
 if intent.id=='fortify'then
  effects[#effects+1]={op='block',target='all_allies',fixed=true,value=fortifyBlock}
 elseif intent.id=='piercer'then
  effects[#effects+1]={op='enemyStrengthAll',value=piercerStrength}
 elseif intent.id=='bash'then
  effects[#effects+1]={op='spireBashDebuff',value=bashLoss,focusPossible=state.orbs~=nil and state.orbs.slots>0}
 elseif intent.id=='smash'then
  local output=enemy.spireSmashBlock
  if output==nil then output=M.actualDamage(state,enemy,snapshotDamage(state,enemy,intent.effects[1].value))end
  effects[#effects+1]={op='block',fixed=true,value=output}
 end
 return effects
end
function M.takeTurn(state,enemy,random,snapshotDamage)
 assert(M.owns(enemy),'Spire pair action owner required')
 local intent=assert(enemy.intents[enemy.intentIndex],'missing Spire pair intent').id
 local actions={}
 if intent=='bash'then
  attacks(actions,state,enemy,12,1,snapshotDamage)
  local focus=state.orbs and state.orbs.slots>0 and Random.boolean(state,random)
  append(actions,'power',enemy,state.player,{status=focus and 'focus'or 'strength',value=bashLoss})
 elseif intent=='fortify'or intent=='piercer'then
  for _,target in ipairs(state.enemies)do
   append(actions,intent=='fortify'and 'block'or 'power',enemy,target,
    intent=='fortify'and {value=fortifyBlock}or {status='strength',value=piercerStrength})
  end
 elseif intent=='smash'then
  local output=attacks(actions,state,enemy,34,1,snapshotDamage)
  enemy.spireSmashBlock=output
  append(actions,'block',enemy,enemy,{value=output})
 elseif intent=='burn_strike'then
  attacks(actions,state,enemy,5,2,snapshotDamage)
  append(actions,'discard',enemy,state.player,{card='burn',value=2})
 elseif intent=='skewer'then attacks(actions,state,enemy,10,3,snapshotDamage)
 else error('unknown Spire pair action: '..tostring(intent))end
 append(actions,'roll',enemy,nil,{intentId=intent});return actions
end
function M.died(state,enemy,enqueue)
 if not M.owns(enemy)or enemy.hp>0 or enemy.spireDeathQueued then return false end
 enemy.spireDeathQueued=true
 for _,survivor in ipairs(state.enemies)do
  if survivor.hp>0 and not survivor.isDying and not survivor.escaped then
   if (state.player.statuses.surrounded or 0)>0 then
    assert(state.spirePair and M.owns(survivor),'Spire pair death requires its encounter owner')
    state.spirePair.facingLeft=survivor.spireSide=='left'
    enqueue({op='removeStatus',targetId=state.player.id,status='surrounded'})
   end
   if (survivor.statuses.back_attack or 0)>0 then
    enqueue({op='removeStatus',targetId=survivor.id,status='back_attack'})
   end
  end
 end
 return true
end
return M

local function drag(e, touch, release, x, y)
    e('card1','down',touch)
    e('card1','drag',touch,x or 0,y or 0)
    e('dragLayer',release or 'up',touch,x or 0,y or 0)
end
local function late(e, touch, x, y)
    e('card1','up',touch,x,y)
    e('card1','endDrag',touch,x,y)
    e('card1','click',touch,x,y)
    e('card1','click',touch,x,y)
end

local NativeContract = dofile('tests/lua/support/native_ui_contract.lua')
package.path = "src/lua/?.lua;build/lua/?.lua;" .. package.path
local UI = require("abyss_battle_ui")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Data = require("abyss_data")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Presentation = require("abyss_presentation")
local Layout = require("abyss_ui_layout")
local L = Theme.layout
-- These are input points on the current visible native actors, not expected
-- damage values. Every numerical preview oracle below remains unchanged.
local function enemyPoint(panel,index)
    local box=panel:GetChild('enemy'..index);assert(box.visible,'input actor is hidden')
    return box.x,box.y
end
-- Dynamic card numbers and status details on the full generated native tree.
-- The oracle for every preview is the core's own resolution of the same play.
local function control(definition)
    local c = { name = definition.name, visible = definition.visible ~= false, children = {}, text = "",
        sizeDeltaX = definition.size[1], sizeDeltaY = definition.size[2], interactable = true,
        x = definition.position and definition.position[1] or 0, y = definition.position and definition.position[2] or 0 }
    for _, entry in ipairs(definition.children or {}) do c.children[entry.name] = control(entry) end
    function c:GetChild(key) return assert(self.children[key], "unknown control " .. self.name .. "/" .. key) end
    function c:SetVisible(value) assert(type(value) == "boolean") self.visible = value end
    function c:AddCursorEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
        self.listeners = self.listeners or {}
        self.listeners[event] = fn
        if event == "click" then self.click = fn end
    end
    function c:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y) self.x, self.y = x, y end
    function c:SetSizeDelta(x, y) NativeContract.sizeDelta(x,y); self.sizeDeltaX, self.sizeDeltaY = x, y end
    function c:SetLocalScale(x, y) self.localScaleX, self.localScaleY = x, y end
    function c:SetImage(...)
        assert(select("#", ...) == 2, "SetImage expects exactly source and id")
        local source, id = ...
        assert(source == "static" and type(id) == "number") self.imageId = id
    end
    function c:SetAsLastSibling() self.raised = true end
    return c
end
local function setup(deck, enemies, drag)
    local root = control({name="root", size={1280,720}, children=Layout})
    local panel = root:GetChild("stage"):GetChild("battlePanel")
    local ui = UI.new(panel, Data, Presentation, "click", {
        imageSource="static", color=function(r,g,b,a) return {r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a} end,
        cursorEvents=drag and {CursorDown="down",CursorDrag="drag",CursorUp="up",CursorEndDrag="endDrag"} or nil
    }, {embedded=true})
    ui.run = Run.new(Data, 1)
    assert(Run.startCombat(ui.run, "cultist_solo"))
    ui.run.combat = Combat.new(Data, {deck=deck, enemies=enemies})
    ui:resize(1280, 720) ui:render()
    -- Native listener on a control path such as {"enemy1","statusRow","hit"}.
    local function event(path, kind, x, y, touch, optional)
        local box = panel
        for _, name in ipairs(type(path) == "table" and path or {path}) do box = box:GetChild(name) end
        local hit = box.listeners and box or box:GetChild("hit")
        local callback = hit.listeners and hit.listeners[kind]
        if optional and not callback then return end
        assert(callback, "missing native listener " .. kind)
        callback({touchId=touch or 7, GetUIPos=function() return 640 + (x or 0), 360 + (y or 0) end})
    end
    -- One physical tap: Down/Up where the control listens for them, then Click.
    local function tap(path, touch)
        if drag then event(path, "down", 0, 0, touch) event(path, "up", 0, 0, touch, true) end
        event(path, "click", 0, 0, touch)
    end
    return ui, panel, event, tap
end
local function drain(ui)
    for _ = 1, 600 do if not ui.busy then return end ui:update(0.05) end
    assert(not ui.busy, "feedback must finish")
end
local function eq(a, b, message) assert(a == b, (message or "") .. ": " .. tostring(a) .. " ~= " .. tostring(b)) end
local function inline(panel, slot) return panel:GetChild("card" .. (slot or 1)):GetChild("label").text end
-- Existing numerical oracles compare the sentence's values, independently of
-- native colour syntax. New presentation assertions below inspect the raw text.
local function label(panel, slot) return (inline(panel,slot):gsub('<color=#[%x]+>',''):gsub('</color>',''):gsub('↑',''):gsub('↓','')) end
local function battle(deck, enemies)
    local s = Combat.new(Data, {deck=deck, enemies=enemies})
    for _, enemy in ipairs(s.enemies) do enemy.hp, enemy.maxHp = 200, 200 end
    return s
end
-- HP each enemy loses when the core actually plays hand[1] on a copy of the state.
local function resolve(s, target)
    local copy = Combat.copy(s)
    for _, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do enemy.ai = nil end -- reactions are not under test
    local before = {}
    for i, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do before[i] = enemy.hp end
    assert(Combat.play(copy, copy.hand[1].uid, target))
    local lost = {}
    for i, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do lost[i] = before[i] - enemy.hp end
    return lost, copy
end
local count = 0
local function test(name, fn) fn(); count = count + 1; print("ok card preview " .. count .. " - " .. name) end

test("single-target damage follows Strength and Weak, and each target's own Vulnerable", function()
    local s = battle({"strike"}, {"jaw_worm", "cultist"})
    local neutral = Combat.cardPreview(s, s.hand[1])[1]
    eq(neutral.low, 6) eq(neutral.high, 6) eq(neutral.op, "damage")
    Combat.addStatus(s.player, "strength", 4) Combat.addStatus(s.player, "weak", 1)
    Combat.addStatus(s.enemies[2], "vulnerable", 2)
    -- (6+4)*0.75 = 7.5 -> 7; against Vulnerable 7.5*1.5 = 11.25 -> 11.
    local unaimed = Combat.cardPreview(s, s.hand[1])[1]
    eq(unaimed.low, 7) eq(unaimed.high, 7)
    for target = 1, 2 do
        local aimed = Combat.cardPreview(s, s.hand[1], target)[1]
        local lost = resolve(s, target)
        eq(aimed.low, aimed.high) eq(aimed.low, lost[target], "target " .. target)

    end
    -- A dead aim returns to player-only modifiers, never another enemy's powers.
    s.enemies[2].hp = 0

local function chips(box)
    local row, result = box:GetChild("statusRow"), {}
    for i = 1, L.statusIcon.perRow * L.statusIcon.rows do

        if count.visible then result[#result + 1] = {icon = icon.visible and icon.imageId or nil, count = count.text,
            colour = icon.imageColor, edge = row:GetChild('backplates'):GetChild('edge'..i).imageColor, x = icon.x, y = icon.y} end
    end
    return result
end
local function info(panel, allPages)
    local box, rows = panel:GetChild("statusInfo"), {}
    for i = 1, L.statusInfo.rows do
        if box:GetChild("name" .. i).visible then
            local name = box:GetChild("name" .. i)
            -- Approved Details A also shows the unexecuted intent section. This
            -- numerical status oracle reads every buff/debuff row, not intent rows.
            local header, distance
            for section = 1, L.statusInfo.sections do
                local label = box:GetChild("section" .. section)
                local gap = label.y - name.y
                if label.visible and gap >= 0 and (not distance or gap < distance) then
                    header, distance = label.text, gap
                end
            end
            if header ~= "意图 · 尚未执行" then
                local note = box:GetChild("note" .. i)
                rows[#rows + 1] = {name = name.text, text = box:GetChild("text" .. i).text,
                    tag = box:GetChild("tag" .. i).text, note = note.visible and note.text or nil}
            end
        end
    end
    if allPages and box.visible then
        local pages = tonumber(box:GetChild("more").text:match("^第 %d+/(%d+) 页")) or 1
        for page = 2, pages do
            box:GetChild("page").click()
            local open, current = info(panel)
            assert(open and box:GetChild("more").text:find("第 " .. page .. "/" .. pages .. " 页", 1, true))
            for _, row in ipairs(current) do rows[#rows + 1] = row end
        end
    end
    return box.visible, rows, box
end

local NativeContract = dofile('tests/lua/support/native_ui_contract.lua')
package.path = "src/lua/?.lua;build/lua/?.lua;" .. package.path
local UI = require("abyss_battle_ui")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Data = require("abyss_data")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Presentation = require("abyss_presentation")
local Layout = require("abyss_ui_layout")
local L = Theme.layout
-- These are input points on the current visible native actors, not expected
-- damage values. Every numerical preview oracle below remains unchanged.
local function enemyPoint(panel,index)
    local box=panel:GetChild('enemy'..index);assert(box.visible,'input actor is hidden')
    return box.x,box.y
end
-- Dynamic card numbers and status details on the full generated native tree.
-- The oracle for every preview is the core's own resolution of the same play.
local function control(definition)
    local c = { name = definition.name, visible = definition.visible ~= false, children = {}, text = "",
        sizeDeltaX = definition.size[1], sizeDeltaY = definition.size[2], interactable = true,
        x = definition.position and definition.position[1] or 0, y = definition.position and definition.position[2] or 0 }
    for _, entry in ipairs(definition.children or {}) do c.children[entry.name] = control(entry) end
    function c:GetChild(key) return assert(self.children[key], "unknown control " .. self.name .. "/" .. key) end
    function c:SetVisible(value) assert(type(value) == "boolean") self.visible = value end
    function c:AddCursorEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
        self.listeners = self.listeners or {}
        self.listeners[event] = fn
        if event == "click" then self.click = fn end
    end
    function c:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y) self.x, self.y = x, y end
    function c:SetSizeDelta(x, y) NativeContract.sizeDelta(x,y); self.sizeDeltaX, self.sizeDeltaY = x, y end
    function c:SetLocalScale(x, y) self.localScaleX, self.localScaleY = x, y end
    function c:SetImage(...)
        assert(select("#", ...) == 2, "SetImage expects exactly source and id")
        local source, id = ...
        assert(source == "static" and type(id) == "number") self.imageId = id
    end
    function c:SetAsLastSibling() self.raised = true end
    return c
end
local function setup(deck, enemies, drag)
    local root = control({name="root", size={1280,720}, children=Layout})
    local panel = root:GetChild("stage"):GetChild("battlePanel")
    local ui = UI.new(panel, Data, Presentation, "click", {
        imageSource="static", color=function(r,g,b,a) return {r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a} end,
        cursorEvents=drag and {CursorDown="down",CursorDrag="drag",CursorUp="up",CursorEndDrag="endDrag"} or nil
    }, {embedded=true})
    ui.run = Run.new(Data, 1)
    assert(Run.startCombat(ui.run, "cultist_solo"))
    ui.run.combat = Combat.new(Data, {deck=deck, enemies=enemies})
    ui:resize(1280, 720) ui:render()
    -- Native listener on a control path such as {"enemy1","statusRow","hit"}.
    local function event(path, kind, x, y, touch, optional)
        local box = panel
        for _, name in ipairs(type(path) == "table" and path or {path}) do box = box:GetChild(name) end
        local hit = box.listeners and box or box:GetChild("hit")
        local callback = hit.listeners and hit.listeners[kind]
        if optional and not callback then return end
        assert(callback, "missing native listener " .. kind)
        callback({touchId=touch or 7, GetUIPos=function() return 640 + (x or 0), 360 + (y or 0) end})
    end
    -- One physical tap: Down/Up where the control listens for them, then Click.
    local function tap(path, touch)
        if drag then event(path, "down", 0, 0, touch) event(path, "up", 0, 0, touch, true) end
        event(path, "click", 0, 0, touch)
    end
    return ui, panel, event, tap
end
local function drain(ui)
    for _ = 1, 600 do if not ui.busy then return end ui:update(0.05) end
    assert(not ui.busy, "feedback must finish")
end
local function eq(a, b, message) assert(a == b, (message or "") .. ": " .. tostring(a) .. " ~= " .. tostring(b)) end
local function inline(panel, slot) return panel:GetChild("card" .. (slot or 1)):GetChild("label").text end
-- Existing numerical oracles compare the sentence's values, independently of
-- native colour syntax. New presentation assertions below inspect the raw text.
local function label(panel, slot) return (inline(panel,slot):gsub('<color=#[%x]+>',''):gsub('</color>',''):gsub('↑',''):gsub('↓','')) end
local function battle(deck, enemies)
    local s = Combat.new(Data, {deck=deck, enemies=enemies})
    for _, enemy in ipairs(s.enemies) do enemy.hp, enemy.maxHp = 200, 200 end
    return s
end
-- HP each enemy loses when the core actually plays hand[1] on a copy of the state.
local function resolve(s, target)
    local copy = Combat.copy(s)
    for _, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do enemy.ai = nil end -- reactions are not under test
    local before = {}
    for i, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do before[i] = enemy.hp end
    assert(Combat.play(copy, copy.hand[1].uid, target))
    local lost = {}
    for i, enemy in ipairs(copy.enemies) do lost[i] = before[i] - enemy.hp end
    return lost, copy
end

local function chips(box)
    local row, result = box:GetChild("statusRow"), {}
    for i = 1, L.statusIcon.perRow * L.statusIcon.rows do
        local icon, count = row:GetChild("icon" .. i), row:GetChild("count" .. i)
        if count.visible then result[#result + 1] = {icon = icon.visible and icon.imageId or nil, count = count.text,
            colour = icon.imageColor, edge = row:GetChild('backplates'):GetChild('edge'..i).imageColor, x = icon.x, y = icon.y} end
    end
    return result
end
local function info(panel, allPages)
    local box, rows = panel:GetChild("statusInfo"), {}
    for i = 1, L.statusInfo.rows do
        if box:GetChild("name" .. i).visible then
            local name = box:GetChild("name" .. i)
            -- Approved Details A also shows the unexecuted intent section. This
            -- numerical status oracle reads every buff/debuff row, not intent rows.
            local header, distance
            for section = 1, L.statusInfo.sections do
                local label = box:GetChild("section" .. section)
                local gap = label.y - name.y
                if label.visible and gap >= 0 and (not distance or gap < distance) then
                    header, distance = label.text, gap
                end
            end
            if header ~= "意图 · 尚未执行" then
                local note = box:GetChild("note" .. i)
                rows[#rows + 1] = {name = name.text, text = box:GetChild("text" .. i).text,
                    tag = box:GetChild("tag" .. i).text, note = note.visible and note.text or nil}
            end
        end
    end
    if allPages and box.visible then
        local pages = tonumber(box:GetChild("more").text:match("^第 %d+/(%d+) 页")) or 1
        for page = 2, pages do
            box:GetChild("page").click()
            local open, current = info(panel)
            assert(open and box:GetChild("more").text:find("第 " .. page .. "/" .. pages .. " 页", 1, true))
            for _, row in ipairs(current) do rows[#rows + 1] = row end
        end
    end
    return box.visible, rows, box
end

    setFocus=function(value)

        focus=value

    local c=root:GetChild(panel)
    for name in path:gmatch('[^/]+')do c=assert(c:GetChild(name),path)end
    return c:GetChild('hit') or c

    for _=1,400 do if not ui.battleUI.busy then break end;ui:update(.05)end
    ui:update(.01)

-- Run the actual native entry and real Host/Nodes/Run with capability-guarded
-- engine doubles. Only combat completion and prior Boss progress are staged;
-- no keys or historical wins are granted. This is not a natural playthrough.
local F=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua')
local Map,Run=require('abyss_map'),require('abyss_run')
local function fixture(experimental,bgm)
    local canvas=F.control({children=F.Layout})
    local host,signals
    local historyCalls=0
    signals={}
    local new=F.GameUI.new
    F.GameUI.new=function(...)
        local args={...}
        local function unavailableHistory()historyCalls=historyCalls+1;error('competition must not consult saved history')end
        args[5].readNeowHistory,args[5].readEndingHistory,args[5].writeEndingHistory=unavailableHistory,unavailableHistory,unavailableHistory
        host=new(table.unpack(args))
        host.historyCalls=function()return historyCalls end
        return host
    end
    script={object=canvas,EnableUpdate=function(self,value)self.updating=value end,
        GetParam=function(_,name)
            if name=='nativeBgmEnabled' then return bgm end
            assert(name=='experimentalCharacters','unexpected native parameter '..name)
            return experimental
        end}
    Enum={CursorEventType={CursorClick='click'},ImageSource={StaticReference='static'}}
    Color=setmetatable({FromRGB=function()end},{__call=function(_,r,g,b,a)return{r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a}end})
    game={GetUICanvasSize=function()return 1280,720 end,
        ServerSignal=function(name)return{SendSignal=function()signals[#signals+1]=name end}end}
    local ok,why=pcall(function()dofile('src/lua/abyss_ui.lua');OnStart();OnStart()end)
    F.GameUI.new=new
    assert(ok,why);assert(host and script.updating,'formal startup failed')
    -- Seed2 exposes an implemented Sozu in the second Boss chest. Other source
    -- rolls still include unimplemented relics (TASK-14.1); no pool/probability change.
    host.seed='2'
    host.root=canvas:GetChild('stage')
    return host,host.root,signals
end
local function start(host,root,button,element)
    F.click(root,'menuPanel','start')
    assert(host.characterOpen and not host.run)
    F.click(root,'characterPanel',button)
    if element then F.click(root,'characterPanel','elements/element'..element)end
    assert(not host.run,'selection must not create a Run')
    F.click(root,'characterPanel','confirm')
    for _=1,8 do OnUpdate(.25)end
    assert(host.mode=='map' and host.map.floor==0)
    -- The real entry has no history provider. Never synthesize qualification
    -- or mistake a seeded controlled route for a persisted natural victory.
    local history=host.run.endingHistory
    assert(history.known==false and history.unlocked==false and history.source=='competition-disabled')
    assert(history.readStatus=='disabled' and history.persistence=='disabled')
    assert(host.run.campaignProfile=='competition-two-act' and host.run.neowStatus=='disabled')
    assert(not host.map.emeraldSelection and host.historyCalls()==0)
    assert(next(history.wins)==nil and host.run.endingUnlocked==false)
    for _,key in ipairs({'ruby','emerald','sapphire'})do assert(host.run.keys[key]==false)end
end
local function fight(host,root,floor)
    local nextNode=Map.available(host.map)[1]
    assert(nextNode.floor==floor and host.mapUI:choose(nextNode.id))
    assert(host.mode=='battle' and host.run.phase=='combat')
    -- Controlled final-damage boundary; encounter construction and rewards stay real.
    for _,enemy in ipairs(host.run.combat.enemies)do enemy.hp=0 end
    assert(Run.finishCombat(host.run));host:refresh()
    assert(host.run.phase=='reward' and host.run.rewards.cards)
    F.click(root,'battlePanel','continue')
    assert(host.mode=='map' and host.run.nodeFlow.complete)
end
local function bossComplete(host,bossFloor)
    local map,run=host.map,host.run
    -- Skip the intervening played rooms, retaining the actual generated map,
    -- legal path and chapter owners. Do not fabricate a chest or ending reward.
    while Map.available(map)[1].floor<bossFloor do
        assert(Map.choose(map,Map.available(map)[1].id))
    end
    run.floor,run.phase=map.floor,'map'
    run.nodeFlow={id=map.currentNodeId,floor=map.floor,type='combat',complete=true,result='victory',
        mapSeed=map.seed,mapSignature=map.sourceSignature}
    host:refresh()
    fight(host,host.root,bossFloor)
end
local function chest(host,bossFloor,nextAct)
    local run,map=host.run,host.map
    bossComplete(host,bossFloor)
    assert(host.mapUI:choose(Map.available(map)[1].id))
    assert(host.nodeUI:press('treasureView/chest'))
    host.nodeUI:update(2)
    assert(host.nodeUI:press('back'))
    assert(run.phase=='act_transition',
        'FORMAL_CAMPAIGN_STOPPED floor='..run.floor..' phase='..run.phase..'; Boss chest must continue the campaign')
    assert(host.mode=='node' and run.act==nextAct-1)
    local uid,gold=run.deck[1].uid,run.gold
    assert(host.nodeUI:press('confirm'))
    assert(host.run==run and host.map==map and run.act==nextAct and host.mode=='map')
    assert(run.deck[1].uid==uid and run.gold==gold)
end

-- Run the actual native entry and real Host/Nodes/Run with capability-guarded
-- engine doubles. Only combat completion and prior Boss progress are staged;
-- no keys or historical wins are granted. This is not a natural playthrough.
local F=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua')
local Map,Run=require('abyss_map'),require('abyss_run')
local function fixture(experimental,bgm,characterProfile)
    local canvas=F.control({children=F.Layout})
    local host,signals
    local historyCalls=0
    signals={}
    local new=F.GameUI.new
    F.GameUI.new=function(...)
        local args={...}
        assert(args[5].characterProfile=='competition-candidate')
        if characterProfile then args[5].characterProfile=characterProfile end -- explicit development-only coverage below
        local function unavailableHistory()historyCalls=historyCalls+1;error('competition must not consult saved history')end
        args[5].readNeowHistory,args[5].readEndingHistory,args[5].writeEndingHistory=unavailableHistory,unavailableHistory,unavailableHistory
        host=new(table.unpack(args))
        host.historyCalls=function()return historyCalls end
        return host
    end
    script={object=canvas,EnableUpdate=function(self,value)self.updating=value end,
        GetParam=function(_,name)
            if name=='nativeBgmEnabled' then return bgm end
            assert(name=='experimentalCharacters','unexpected native parameter '..name)
            return experimental
        end}
    Enum={CursorEventType={CursorClick='click'},ImageSource={StaticReference='static'}}
    Color=setmetatable({FromRGB=function()end},{__call=function(_,r,g,b,a)return{r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a}end})
    game={GetUICanvasSize=function()return 1280,720 end,IsTestPlay=function()return true end,
        ServerSignal=function(name)return{SendSignal=function()signals[#signals+1]=name end}end}
    local ok,why=pcall(function()dofile('src/lua/abyss_ui.lua');OnStart();OnStart()end)
    F.GameUI.new=new
    assert(ok,why);assert(host and script.updating,'formal startup failed')
    if not characterProfile then
        assert(host.characterSelection:allows('ironclad') and not host.characterSelection:allows('raiden'),
            'actual Alpha candidate exposes only this release\'s Geo traveler')
    end
    -- Seed2 exposes an implemented Sozu in the second Boss chest. Other source
    -- rolls still include unimplemented relics (TASK-14.1); no pool/probability change.
    host.seed='2'
    host.root=canvas:GetChild('stage')
    return host,host.root,signals
end
local function opening(host,root,bossCount)
    local run=host.run
    assert(run and run.campaignProfile=='competition-two-act' and host.map.floor==0)
    if host.prologue:covering() then
        assert(not host.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
        assert(host.prologue:skip());OnUpdate(1);OnUpdate(1)
    end
    assert(not host.prologue:covering() and host.mode=='node' and not host.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
    local event=run.nodeFlow.event
    assert(event.id=='neow' and event.stage=='neow_intro' and event.neowBossCount==bossCount)
    assert(run.neowHistorySource==(bossCount==0 and 'fresh-start' or 'session-completed-run'))
    local baseMaxHp=run.maxHp
    assert(F.click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1'))
    event=run.nodeFlow.event
    assert(event.stage=='neow_blessing' and #event.rewards==(bossCount==0 and 2 or 4))
    -- Both source variants give category1 as the second offer. The fresh
    -- opening must choose its real +HP mini reward; a later session-qualified
    -- four-offer opening uses the real second offer, never fabricated history.
    if bossCount==0 then
        assert(event.rewards[2].type=='TEN_PERCENT_HP_BONUS' and event.rewards[2].drawback=='NONE')
    else assert(event.rewards[2].drawback=='NONE')end
    local rewardType,hpBonus=event.rewards[2].type,event.hpBonus
    assert(F.click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2'))
    event=run.nodeFlow.event
    if rewardType=='THREE_SMALL_POTIONS'then
        assert(event.stage=='neow_potions' and #event.potionOffers==3)
        assert(F.click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option4')) -- source skip/continue, no bottle injection
        event=run.nodeFlow.event
    end
    assert(event.stage=='neow_result')
    if rewardType=='TEN_PERCENT_HP_BONUS'then assert(run.maxHp==baseMaxHp+hpBonus)end
    assert(F.click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1'))
    assert(host.run==run and host.mode=='map' and host.map.floor==0 and run.neowStatus=='complete')
    assert(host.mapUI.navigationEnabled and host.historyCalls()==0)
    return baseMaxHp
end
local function start(host,root,button,element)
    F.click(root,'menuPanel','start')
    assert(host.characterOpen and not host.run)
    F.click(root,'characterPanel',button)
    if element then F.click(root,'characterPanel','elements/element'..element)end
    assert(not host.run,'selection must not create a Run')
    F.click(root,'characterPanel','confirm')
    assert(host.prologue:covering(),'first native confirmation must start the approved opening')
    local baseMaxHp=opening(host,root,0)
    -- The real entry has no history provider. Never synthesize qualification
    -- or mistake a seeded controlled route for a persisted natural victory.
    local history=host.run.endingHistory
    assert(history.known==false and history.unlocked==false and history.source=='competition-disabled')
    assert(history.readStatus=='disabled' and history.persistence=='disabled')
    assert(host.run.campaignProfile=='competition-two-act' and host.run.neowStatus=='complete')
    assert(not host.map.emeraldSelection and host.historyCalls()==0)
    assert(next(history.wins)==nil and host.run.endingUnlocked==false)
    for _,key in ipairs({'ruby','emerald','sapphire'})do assert(host.run.keys[key]==false)end
    return baseMaxHp
end
local function fight(host,root,floor)
    local nextNode=Map.available(host.map)[1]
    assert(nextNode.floor==floor and host.mapUI:choose(nextNode.id))
    assert(host.mode=='battle' and host.run.phase=='combat')
    -- Controlled final-damage boundary; encounter construction and rewards stay real.
    for _,enemy in ipairs(host.run.combat.enemies)do enemy.hp=0 end
    assert(Run.finishCombat(host.run));host:refresh()
    assert(host.run.phase=='reward' and host.run.rewards.cards)
    F.click(root,'battlePanel','continue')
    assert(host.mode=='map' and host.run.nodeFlow.complete)
end
local function bossComplete(host,bossFloor)
    local map,run=host.map,host.run
    -- Skip the intervening played rooms, retaining the actual generated map,
    -- legal path and chapter owners. Do not fabricate a chest or ending reward.
    while Map.available(map)[1].floor<bossFloor do
        assert(Map.choose(map,Map.available(map)[1].id))
    end
    run.floor,run.phase=map.floor,'map'
    run.nodeFlow={id=map.currentNodeId,floor=map.floor,type='combat',complete=true,result='victory',
        mapSeed=map.seed,mapSignature=map.sourceSignature}
    host:refresh()
    fight(host,host.root,bossFloor)
end
local function chest(host,bossFloor,nextAct)

    assert(run.phase=='act_transition',
        'FORMAL_CAMPAIGN_STOPPED floor='..run.floor..' phase='..run.phase..'; Boss chest must continue the campaign')
    assert(host.mode=='node' and run.act==nextAct-1)
    local uid,gold=run.deck[1].uid,run.gold
    assert(host.nodeUI:press('confirm'))
    assert(host.run==run and host.map==map and run.act==nextAct and host.mode=='map')
    assert(run.deck[1].uid==uid and run.gold==gold)
end

local testStart=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua').start

local function leavePotionRewards(ui, root)
    if ui.run.phase=='reward' and ui.run.rewards.manualContinue then
        if ui.run.rewards.goldClaimed == false then click(root,'battlePanel','goldReward') end
        click(root,'battlePanel','continue')
    end
end
local function completeRestartOpening(ui,root,previous)
    assert(ui.mode=='node' and ui.run.nodeFlow.event.id=='neow' and ui.run.nodeFlow~=previous.nodeFlow)
    assert(ui.run.neowHistorySource=='session-completed-run' and ui.map.floor==0)
    local hp,maxHp,gold,deck,relics,potions=ui.run.hp,ui.run.maxHp,ui.run.gold,#ui.run.deck,#ui.run.relics,#ui.run.potions
    assert(hp==ui.run.data.rules.player.maxHp and maxHp==hp)
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    local event=ui.run.nodeFlow.event
    if previous.floor<16 then
        assert(#event.rewards==2 and event.rewards[2].type=='TEN_PERCENT_HP_BONUS')
        local bonus=event.hpBonus
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2')
        assert(ui.run.hp==hp+bonus and ui.run.maxHp==maxHp+bonus)
    else
        -- The unchanged next seed2 offers three potions as its second blessing.
        -- Decline all three through the source reward UI; never erase the node.
        assert(#event.rewards==4 and event.rewards[2].type=='THREE_SMALL_POTIONS')
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2')
        assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.event.stage=='neow_potions' and #ui.run.nodeFlow.event.potionOffers==3)
        for _,offer in ipairs(ui.run.nodeFlow.event.potionOffers)do assert(not offer.claimed)end
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option4')
        assert(ui.run.hp==hp and ui.run.maxHp==maxHp)
    end
    assert(ui.run.gold==gold and #ui.run.deck==deck and #ui.run.relics==relics and #ui.run.potions==potions)
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    assert(ui.mode=='map' and ui.run.nodeFlow.complete and ui.run.neowStatus=='complete')
end

    -- Keep the real rules, commands and UI. Four HP isolates routing from

    local data = Combat.copy(Data)

    local seen,seenEvents = {},{}
    for floor = 1, data.rules.map.floors do
        local node
        for _,available in ipairs(Nodes.available(ui.run,ui.map))do if available.id==route[floor]then node=available;break end end
        assert(node and node.floor == floor)
        local slot
        for i, id in pairs(ui.mapUI.slots) do if id == node.id then slot = i break end end
        assert(slot, "next layer missing from focused map page")
        click(root, "mapPanel", "node" .. slot)
        if not ui.run.nodeFlow or ui.run.nodeFlow.id~=node.id then
            local _,why=Nodes.enter(ui.run,ui.map,node.id)
            error('entry failed on floor '..floor..' mode '..ui.mode..' reason '..tostring(why))
        end
        node.type=ui.run.nodeFlow.type -- ? retains its map symbol but routes by actual room.
        if ui.run.nodeFlow.event then seenEvents[ui.run.nodeFlow.event.id]=true end
        print('UNKNOWN_ROOM_ROUTE '..floor..' '..node.id..' '..node.type..' '..(ui.run.nodeFlow.event and ui.run.nodeFlow.event.id or '-'))
        seen[node.type] = true
        if node.type == "boss" then
            local notice = root:GetChild("battlePanel"):GetChild("notice")
            assert(notice.text == "石门缓缓开启。昔日的封印守卫仍在履行职责，只是漆黑的力量已令它分不清敌友。")
            preview("boss", notice.text)
            notice.text = "操作提示优先"

        end
        if ui.mode == "battle" then
            win(ui, root)
            click(root, "battlePanel", "cardReward");click(root, "battlePanel", "skip")
            leavePotionRewards(ui, root)
        elseif node.type == "shop" then
            if ui.nodeUI.actions["shopView/card1"].enabled then
                local before = ui.run.gold
                click(root, "nodePanel", "shopView/card1")
                assert(ui.run.gold < before)
            end
            click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
            -- The merchant's farewell holds the shop panel until the player continues.
            assert(ui.mode == "node" and ui.run.phase == "map" and not ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
            assert(root:GetChild("nodePanel"):GetChild("merchant").visible)
            click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
        else

            if node.type == "event" then
                local leaveSlot
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local option = root:GetChild("nodePanel"):GetChild("eventView"):GetChild("option" .. i)
                    if option.visible and option:GetChild("title").text == "［离开］" then leaveSlot = i end
                end

            elseif node.type == "treasure" then
                assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.chest and not ui.run.nodeFlow.chest.opened)
                click(root, "nodePanel", "treasureView/chest")
                assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.chest.opened)
                ui.nodeUI:update(2)
                -- Source chests expose independent items. Keep this same real
                -- route and every combat; never reroll an unavailable identity.
                while ui.run.phase == 'node' and #ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items > 0 do
                    local choice
                    for index,item in ipairs(ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items)do

                    end

                        local beforeGold,beforeRelics=ui.run.gold,#ui.run.relics

    assert(ui.mode == "map" and ui.map.floor == 0 and #ui.run.deck == 10)
end)

local testStart=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua').start

local function leavePotionRewards(ui, root)
    if ui.run.phase=='reward' and ui.run.rewards.manualContinue then
        if ui.run.rewards.goldClaimed == false then click(root,'battlePanel','goldReward') end
        click(root,'battlePanel','continue')

end
local function completeRestartOpening(ui,root,previous)
    assert(ui.mode=='node' and ui.run.nodeFlow.event.id=='neow' and ui.run.nodeFlow~=previous.nodeFlow)
    assert(ui.run.neowHistorySource=='session-completed-run' and ui.map.floor==0)
    local hp,maxHp,gold,deck,relics,potions=ui.run.hp,ui.run.maxHp,ui.run.gold,#ui.run.deck,#ui.run.relics,#ui.run.potions
    assert(hp==ui.run.data.rules.player.maxHp and maxHp==hp)
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    local event=ui.run.nodeFlow.event
    if previous.floor<16 then
        assert(#event.rewards==2 and event.rewards[2].type=='TEN_PERCENT_HP_BONUS')
        local bonus=event.hpBonus
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2')
        assert(ui.run.hp==hp+bonus and ui.run.maxHp==maxHp+bonus)
    else
        -- The unchanged next seed2 offers three potions as its second blessing.
        -- Decline all three through the source reward UI; never erase the node.
        assert(#event.rewards==4 and event.rewards[2].type=='THREE_SMALL_POTIONS')
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2')
        assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.event.stage=='neow_potions' and #ui.run.nodeFlow.event.potionOffers==3)
        for _,offer in ipairs(ui.run.nodeFlow.event.potionOffers)do assert(not offer.claimed)end
        click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option4')
        assert(ui.run.hp==hp and ui.run.maxHp==maxHp)
    end
    assert(ui.run.gold==gold and #ui.run.deck==deck and #ui.run.relics==relics and #ui.run.potions==potions)
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    assert(ui.mode=='map' and ui.run.nodeFlow.complete and ui.run.neowStatus=='complete')
end

            click(root, "battlePanel", "cardReward");click(root, "battlePanel", "skip")
            leavePotionRewards(ui, root)
        elseif node.type == "shop" then
            if ui.nodeUI.actions["shopView/card1"].enabled then
                local before = ui.run.gold
                click(root, "nodePanel", "shopView/card1")
                assert(ui.run.gold < before)
            end
            click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
            -- The merchant's farewell holds the shop panel until the player continues.
            assert(ui.mode == "node" and ui.run.phase == "map" and not ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
            assert(root:GetChild("nodePanel"):GetChild("merchant").visible)
            click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
        else
            assert(ui.mode == "node")
            if node.type == "event" then
                local leaveSlot
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local option = root:GetChild("nodePanel"):GetChild("eventView"):GetChild("option" .. i)
                    if option.visible and option:GetChild("title").text == "［离开］" then leaveSlot = i end
                end
                assert(leaveSlot); click(root, "nodePanel", "eventView/option" .. leaveSlot)
            elseif node.type == "treasure" then
                assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.chest and not ui.run.nodeFlow.chest.opened)
                click(root, "nodePanel", "treasureView/chest")
                assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.chest.opened)
                ui.nodeUI:update(2)
                -- Source chests expose independent items. Keep this same real
                -- route and every combat; never reroll an unavailable identity.
                while ui.run.phase == 'node' and #ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items > 0 do
                    local choice
                    for index,item in ipairs(ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items)do
                        if item.kind~='relic' or item.available==true then choice=index;break end
                    end
                    if not choice then
                        for _,item in ipairs(ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items)do assert(item.kind=='relic' and item.available==false)end
                        local beforeGold,beforeRelics=ui.run.gold,#ui.run.relics
                        click(root,'nodePanel','back')
                        assert(ui.run.gold==beforeGold and #ui.run.relics==beforeRelics,
                            'leaving an unavailable source identity cannot grant a substitute')
                        break
                    end
                    assert(ui.nodeUI.actions['treasureView/rewardItem'..choice].enabled)
                    local pending=#ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items
                    click(root,'nodePanel','treasureView/rewardItem'..choice)
                    assert(#ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.items<pending,'each claim consumes only a real pending item')
                end
            elseif ui.nodeUI.actions["campView/rest"].enabled then click(root, "nodePanel", "campView/rest")
            else
                click(root, "nodePanel", "campView/forge"); click(root, "nodePanel", "pickerView/forgeGrid/card1")
                click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
            end
            if node.type == "camp" or node.type == "event" then
                if node.type=="camp" then ui.nodeUI:update(2) end
                -- The result stays on the node panel until the player continues.
                assert(ui.mode == "node" and ui.run.phase == "map" and not ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
                click(root, "nodePanel", "confirm")
            end
        end
        assert(ui.map.floor == floor and ui.run.nodeFlow.complete)
        assert(ui.mode == (floor == data.rules.map.floors and "victory" or "map"))
    end
    -- Optional shop/event/elite rooms are no longer artificially forced on every route.
    for _, kind in ipairs({"combat", "treasure", "camp", "boss"}) do assert(seen[kind], "missing mandatory panel " .. kind) end
    local eventCount=0;for _ in pairs(seenEvents) do eventCount=eventCount+1 end
    assert(eventCount>=2,'same real map route must reach multiple different events')
    assert(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("title").text == "深渊已被封印")
    assert(statValue(root, "floor") == data.rules.map.floors .. " / " .. data.rules.map.floors)
    assert(resultText(root, "subtitle") == "随着守卫倒下，岩元素的光芒重新沿着石纹蔓延。裂隙逐渐闭合，遗迹恢复了往日的寂静。荧收起剑，继续自己的旅途。")
    preview("victory", resultText(root, "subtitle"))
    local previous=ui.run
    testStartButton(root)
    assert(ui.mode=='node' and ui.map.floor==0 and #ui.run.deck==10)
    completeRestartOpening(ui,root,previous)
    assert(ui.mode == "map" and ui.map.floor == 0 and #ui.run.deck == 10)
end)

local function same(a, b, path)
    path = path or "state"
    assert(type(a) == type(b), path .. " type differs")
    if type(a) ~= "table" then assert(a == b, path .. " value differs") return end
    for key, value in pairs(b) do same(a[key], value, path .. "." .. tostring(key)) end
    for key in pairs(a) do assert(b[key] ~= nil, path .. " unexpected field " .. tostring(key)) end

local function hit(root, path)

local count = 0
local function test(name, fn) fn(); count=count+1; print("ok Boss treasure UI "..count.." - "..name) end
local function get(root, path)
    for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do root = assert(root:GetChild(part), path) end
    return root
end
local function fire(hit, kind, id) return assert(hit.listeners[kind], "missing "..kind)({touchId=id}) end
local function tap(hit, id) fire(hit,"down",id); fire(hit,"up",id); return fire(hit,"click",id) end
local function beforeBoss(settle)
    local ui, root = F.fixture(nil, settle, nil, cursor)
    assert(testStart(ui))
    -- Routing fixture: advance map navigation to the real Boss encounter. This
    -- neither changes enemy definitions nor claims a complete normal playthrough.
    for _ = 1, F.Data.rules.map.bossFloor - 1 do assert(Map.choose(ui.map, Map.available(ui.map)[1].id)) end
    assert(F.Nodes.enter(ui.run, ui.map, Map.available(ui.map)[1].id))
    ui:refresh()
    -- Isolate the victory/reward signal from combat balance and animation.
    for _, enemy in ipairs(ui.run.combat.enemies) do enemy.hp = 0 end
    assert(Run.finishCombat(ui.run))
    ui:refresh()
    return ui, root
end
local function enterTreasure(settle, prepare, sourceOffer)
    local ui, root = beforeBoss(settle)
    assert(Run.claimCardReward(ui.run,0)); dofile('tests/lua/support/finish_combat_rewards.lua')(ui.run); ui:refresh()
    assert(ui.mode=="map" and ui.run.nodeFlow.result=="boss_victory")
    -- Gesture/claim components explicitly stage the complete 22-ID source
    -- queue; this is not natural probability evidence. Real offers are below.
    if not sourceOffer then Source.supportedChoices(ui.run)end
    if prepare then prepare(ui.run) end
    assert(ui.mapUI:choose(F.Nodes.available(ui.run,ui.map)[1].id))
    assert(ui.map.floor==17 and ui.mode=="node" and ui.run.nodeFlow.roomKind=="boss_treasure")
    assert(ui.nodeUI:press("treasureView/chest"))
    ui.nodeUI:update(2) -- wait for the real opening/reveal timeline
    return ui, root
end

test("Boss card reward and unopened treasure cannot submit victory",function()
    local calls=0
    local ui,root=beforeBoss(function() calls=calls+1 end)
    assert(ui.mode=="battle" and ui.run.phase=="reward" and not ui:settle())
    assert(Run.claimCardReward(ui.run,0)); dofile('tests/lua/support/finish_combat_rewards.lua')(ui.run); ui:refresh()
    assert(ui.mode=="map" and not ui:settle() and calls==0)
    assert(ui.mapUI:choose(F.Nodes.available(ui.run,ui.map)[1].id))
    assert(ui.mode=="node" and not ui:settle())
    assert(not get(root,"nodePanel/treasureView/take").visible)
    assert(get(root,"nodePanel/title").text=="第 17 层 · 首领宝箱")
end)

    local ui,root=enterTreasure()
    local choices=ui.run.nodeFlow.reward.relics
    assert(#choices==3)

end)

test("exit cancellation preserves the candidate but expires a held claim gesture",function()
    local ui,root=enterTreasure()
    local hit=get(root,"nodePanel/treasureView/rewardItem2/hit")
    fire(hit,"down",11); fire(hit,"up",11)

package.path="src/lua/?.lua;build/lua/?.lua;tests/lua/?.lua;"..package.path
local F=require("support.game_ui_fixture")
local X=require("support.experimental_ui_fixture")
local GameUI=require("abyss_game_ui")
local Run=require("abyss_run")
local Combat=require("abyss_combat")
local Seed=require("abyss_new_run_seed")
local n=0
local function eq(a,b) assert(a==b,tostring(a).." ~= "..tostring(b)) end
local function test(name,fn) fn();n=n+1;print("ok game_ui_classes_failure "..n.." - "..name) end
local function hit(root,path)
    local c=root
    for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do c=assert(c:GetChild(part),part) end
    return c.listeners and c.listeners.click and c or assert(c:GetChild("hit"),path)
end
local function click(root,path) return assert(hit(root,path).click,path)() end
local function canvas(withClasses)
    local c=F.control({children=F.Layout})
    local root=F.Viewport.apply(c,1280,720)
    if not withClasses then
        root.children.characterPanel=nil;root.children.choicePanel=nil
    end
    return c,root
end
local function startup(hostFlag,layoutFlag,profile)
    local c,root=canvas(layoutFlag)
    local updates,signals,lines=nil,0,{}
    script={object=c,EnableUpdate=function(_,value)updates=value end,
        GetParam=function(_,name)
            if name=="nativeBgmEnabled" then return false end
            if name=="experimentalCharacters" and hostFlag~=nil then return hostFlag end
            error("undeclared script parameter "..name)
        end}
    Color=function(r,g,b,a)return{r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a}end
    Enum={CursorEventType={CursorClick="click"},ImageSource={StaticReference="static"}}
    game={GetUICanvasSize=function()return 1280,720 end,IsTestPlay=function()return true end,
        ServerSignal=function()return{SendSignal=function()signals=signals+1 end}end}
    local actualNew,actualPrint,actualSeed=GameUI.new,print,Seed.next
    local ui
    GameUI.new=function(...)
        local args={...}
        eq(args[5].campaignProfile,'competition-two-act') -- real native entry stays bounded
        if profile then
            eq(profile,'full-source') -- explicit legacy-class test host only
            args[5].campaignProfile=profile
        end
        ui=actualNew(table.unpack(args));return ui
    end
    print=function(...)
        local values={};for i=1,select("#",...) do values[i]=tostring(select(i,...)) end
        lines[#lines+1]=table.concat(values," ");actualPrint(...)
    end
    Seed.next=function()return 1 end
    local ok,why=pcall(function()dofile("src/lua/abyss_ui.lua");OnStart()end)
    GameUI.new,print=actualNew,actualPrint
    assert(ok,why)
    return ui,root,function()return updates,signals end,lines,function()Seed.next=actualSeed end
end
local function diagnostic(root,phase)
    local menu=root:GetChild("menuPanel")
    eq(menu.visible,true);eq(menu.raised,true);eq(menu:GetChild("start").visible,false)
    eq(menu:GetChild("settle").visible,false)
    local summary=menu:GetChild("summary")
    eq(summary.visible,true);assert(summary.text:find("测试诊断 · "..phase,1,true),summary.text)
    for _,name in ipairs({"battlePanel","mapPanel","nodePanel","deckPanel","deckEntry","potionPanel","potionEntry",
        "characterPanel","choicePanel","prologuePanel","exitPanel","exitEntry","combatRewards"}) do
        local panel=root:GetChild(name)
        if panel then eq(panel.visible,false) end
    end
    return summary.text
end
local function failUpdate()
    game.GetUICanvasSize=function()error("injected update viewport failure")end
    OnUpdate(0.05)
end
local function drain(ui)
    for _=1,400 do if not ui.battleUI.busy then return end;ui:update(0.05) end
    error("feedback did not finish")
end
local function battle(ui,root,finishFeedback,competition)
    local character,card=competition and 'ironclad' or 'watcher',competition and 'warcry' or 'third_eye'
    assert(ui:start());assert(ui:selectCharacter('traveler'));assert(ui:selectElement(character));assert(ui:confirmCharacter())
    eq(ui.run.campaignProfile,competition and 'competition-two-act' or 'full-source')
    if ui.prologue then ui.prologue:cancel() end
    ui:refresh()
    -- Exact unit entry deck; no natural acquisition, HP, energy or enemy overrides.
    ui.run.deck={}
    for i=1,12 do ui.run.deck[i]={uid=i,cardId=card,upgraded=true} end
    ui.run.nextDeckUid=13
    assert(Run.obtainPotion(ui.run,"block_potion"))
    assert(Run.startCombat(ui.run,"cultist_solo"));ui:refresh()
    local slot
    for i,c in ipairs(ui.run.combat.hand) do if c.cardId==card then slot=i;break end end
    assert(slot);click(root,"battlePanel/card"..slot);click(root,"battlePanel/playArea")
    eq(ui.battleUI.busy,true)
    if competition then assert(ui.run.combat.pendingHandChoice)else assert(ui.run.combat.pendingScry)end
    if finishFeedback then drain(ui);eq(ui.choiceUI.visible,true) end
    return ui.run.combat
end
local function noRevival(ui,root,expectedRun,message)
    eq(ui:start("silent"),false);eq(ui:openExit(),false);eq(ui:openDeck(),false);eq(ui:openPotions(),false)
    eq(ui:confirmExit(),false);eq(ui:settle(),false);eq(ui:refresh(),false);eq(ui:update(0.05),false)
    eq(ui.run,expectedRun);eq(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("summary").text,message)
    OnStart();OnUpdate(0.05)
    eq(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("summary").text,message)
end
test("undeclared host flag keeps the unified production selection available",function()
    local ui,root,state,lines,restore=startup(nil,true)
    assert(ui);eq(state(),true);eq(root:GetChild("characterPanel").visible,false);eq(root:GetChild("choicePanel").visible,false)
    assert(F.start(ui));eq(ui.run.characterProfile,nil);eq(ui.run.maxHp,80);eq(#ui.run.deck,10)
    assert(table.concat(lines,"\n"):find("ABYSS_UI ready",1,true));restore()
end)
test("missing formal layout produces startup diagnostic and never reports ready",function()
    local ui,root,state,lines,restore=startup(true,false)
    eq(ui,nil);eq(state(),false);diagnostic(root,"startup")
    local output=table.concat(lines,"\n")
    assert(output:find("missing game panel characterPanel",1,true));assert(not output:find("ABYSS_UI ready",1,true))
    restore()
end)
test("update failure closes class overlay, disables old class and exit callbacks and keeps diagnostic visible",function()
    local ui,root,state,_,restore=startup(true,true,'full-source')
    assert(ui:start());eq(root:GetChild("characterPanel").visible,true)
    local oldChoice=hit(root,"characterPanel/character2").click
    local oldExit=hit(root,"exitEntry/open").click
    failUpdate();eq(state(),false);eq(ui.disabled,true)
    local message=diagnostic(root,"update")
    eq(oldChoice(),false);eq(oldExit(),false);eq(ui.run,nil)
    noRevival(ui,root,nil,message);eq(select(2,state()),0);restore()
end)
test("update failure closes mandatory choice and all old inputs preserve the pending combat",function()
    local ui,root,state,_,restore=startup(true,true,'full-source')
    local s=battle(ui,root,true);assert(click(root,"choicePanel/card1"))
    local p=s.pendingScry;local run=ui.run
    local oldConfirm=hit(root,"choicePanel/confirm").click
    local oldEndTurn=hit(root,"battlePanel/endTurn").listeners.click
    local hp,energy,turn,hand,draw,discard=s.player.hp,s.energy,s.turn,#s.hand,#s.draw,#s.discard

    eq(oldConfirm(),false);eq(ui.choiceUI:confirm(),false);oldEndTurn()
    eq(ui.battleUI:usePotion(1),false)
    eq(s.pendingScry,p);eq(s.player.hp,hp);eq(s.energy,energy);eq(s.turn,turn)
    eq(#s.hand,hand);eq(#s.draw,draw);eq(#s.discard,discard);eq(Run.potionCount(run),1)
    noRevival(ui,root,run,message);eq(select(2,state()),0);restore()
end)
test("update failure during feedback cancels presentation without replaying committed card effects",function()
    local ui,root,state,_,restore=startup(true,true,'full-source')
    local s=battle(ui,root,false);local p=s.pendingScry
    local block,energy,hand,draw=s.player.block,s.energy,#s.hand,#s.draw

    eq(ui:update(1),false);eq(s.player.block,block);eq(s.pendingScry,p);restore()

    local ui,root,state,_,restore=startup(true,true,'full-source')

    failUpdate();eq(state(),false);local message=diagnostic(root,"update")
    eq(oldConfirm(),false);eq(select(2,state()),0);noRevival(ui,root,ui.run,message);restore()

test("competition Geo update failure preserves mandatory choice, resources and disabled old inputs",function()
    local ui,root,state,_,restore=startup(true,true)
    local s=battle(ui,root,true,true);assert(click(root,"choicePanel/card1"))
    eq(ui.run.characterProfile,nil);eq(ui.run.maxHp,80)

    failUpdate();eq(state(),false);eq(ui.disabled,true);local message=diagnostic(root,"update")
    eq(oldConfirm(),false);eq(ui.choiceUI:confirm(),false);oldEndTurn()
    eq(ui.battleUI:usePotion(1),false)
    eq(s.pendingHandChoice,p);eq(s.player.hp,hp);eq(s.energy,energy);eq(s.turn,turn)

local F = dofile("tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua")
local Nodes, Theme, preview, click, fixture = F.Nodes, F.Theme, F.preview, F.click, F.fixture
local Prologue = require("abyss_prologue")
local Narrative = require("abyss_narrative")
local P = Theme.layout.prologue
local count = 0
local function test(name, fn) fn(); count = count + 1; print("ok prologue " .. count .. " - " .. name) end
local function panel(root) return root:GetChild("prologuePanel") end
local function part(root, name) return panel(root):GetChild(name) end
local function tap(root) return part(root, "advance").click() end
local function run(ui, seconds, step)
    step = step or 0.05
    for _ = 1, math.ceil(seconds / step) do ui:update(step) end
end
local function opened(cursorEvents, sound)
    local ui, root = fixture(nil, nil, nil, cursorEvents, true, sound)
    assert(F.start(ui))
    return ui, root
end

test("intro splits into sentences without changing one character of the approved copy", function()
    local beats = Prologue.beats(Narrative.flow.intro.full)
    assert(#beats == 3 and #P.cameras == 3)
    assert(table.concat(beats) == Narrative.flow.intro.full)
    assert(beats[1] == "岩层深处传来了异常的共鸣。")
    assert(beats[2] == "古老的封印正在崩解……")
    assert(beats[3] == "旅行者，深入遗迹，阻止深渊的侵蚀。")
    for i, beat in ipairs(beats) do preview("intro" .. i, beat) end
    assert(table.concat(Prologue.chars("岩脉A……")) == "岩脉A……" and #Prologue.chars("岩脉A……") == 5)
end)

test("the title screen shows the game name once; start opens the cinematic over a hidden map", function()
    local ui, root = fixture(nil, nil, nil, nil, true)
    assert(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("title").text == "杀戮原塔2")
    assert(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("tagline").text == Narrative.title)
    assert(not panel(root).visible)
    assert(F.start(ui))
    assert(ui.prologue:covering() and panel(root).visible and ui.run ~= nil)
    assert(not root:GetChild("menuPanel").visible and not root:GetChild("mapPanel").visible)
    assert(not root:GetChild("deckEntry").visible and root:GetChild("exitEntry").visible)
    assert(part(root, "chapter").text == "序 · " .. Narrative.title)
    -- Typed from empty, starting black; the run clock does not run during the story.
    assert(part(root, "line").text == "" and part(root, "fade").visible)
    run(ui, 0.4)
    local partial = part(root, "line").text
    assert(#partial > 0 and #partial < #"岩层深处传来了异常的共鸣。")
    assert(ui.run.elapsedSeconds == 0)
    assert(not ui:openDeck(), "deck stays closed during the cinematic")
end)

test("a tap first completes the sentence, then advances; a too-early tap does nothing", function()
    local ui, root = opened()
    assert(not tap(root), "the press that opened the cinematic cannot skip its first line")
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.05)
    assert(tap(root) and part(root, "line").text == "岩层深处传来了异常的共鸣。")
    assert(part(root, "hint").visible and part(root, "hint").text == "点击继续")
    assert(tap(root) and ui.prologue.beat.index == 2 and part(root, "line").text == "")
    assert(not tap(root), "the same burst of taps cannot also skip the new line")
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.05)
    assert(tap(root) and part(root, "line").text == "古老的封印正在崩解……")
    assert(tap(root) and ui.prologue.beat.index == 3 and part(root, "hero").visible)
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.05)
    assert(tap(root) and part(root, "hint").text == "点击进入遗迹")
    assert(tap(root) and ui.prologue.phase == "outro" and ui.prologue:covering())
    assert(not tap(root) and not part(root, "skip"):GetChild("hit").click(), "the fade out ignores input")
end)

test("unattended playback moves through the story and waits on the last line", function()
    local ui, root = opened()
    run(ui, 30)
    assert(ui.prologue.phase == "beats" and ui.prologue.beat.index == 3)
    assert(part(root, "line").text == "旅行者，深入遗迹，阻止深渊的侵蚀。" and ui.prologue:covering())
end)

test("the last fade uncovers an inert map, then hands over cleanly with no overlay left", function()
    local ui, root = opened()
    run(ui, 30) -- reach the last sentence, where the traveller's mark is on screen
    assert(part(root, "hero").visible)
    assert(part(root, "skip"):GetChild("hit").click() and ui.prologue.phase == "outro")
    assert(not part(root, "skip"):GetChild("hit").click(), "skip is not repeatable")
    run(ui, P.fadeOut + 0.05)
    assert(ui.prologue.phase == "reveal" and ui.mode == "map")
    assert(root:GetChild("mapPanel").visible and panel(root).visible and part(root, "fade").visible)
    assert(not part(root, "line").visible and not part(root, "vista").visible and not part(root, "skip").visible)
    assert(not ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled and not root:GetChild("deckEntry").visible)
    run(ui, P.reveal / 2)
    assert(not part(root, "hero").visible and not part(root, "hint").visible and not part(root, "flash").visible,
        "no cinematic layer reappears over the uncovering map")
    run(ui, P.reveal / 2 + 0.05)
    assert(not ui.prologue.playing and not panel(root).visible)
    assert(ui.mode == "map" and ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled and root:GetChild("deckEntry").visible)
    assert(#Nodes.available(ui.run, ui.map) == 2)
    click(root, "mapPanel", "node1")
    assert(ui.mode == "battle", "the map takes input once the cinematic is gone")
    ui:update(1)
    assert(ui.run.elapsedSeconds > 0, "the run clock starts with play")
end)

test("the exit dialog pauses the cinematic and owns input; leaving cancels it", function()
    local ui, root = opened(nil)
    run(ui, 0.6)
    local beat = ui.prologue.beat
    local shown = beat.shown
    assert(ui:openExit())
    assert(ui.exitOpen and root:GetChild("exitPanel").visible)
    run(ui, 2)
    assert(ui.prologue.beat.shown == shown, "paused while the dialog is open")
    assert(not ui.prologue:advance() and not ui.prologue:skip())
    assert(ui:closeExit())
    run(ui, 0.2)
    assert(ui.prologue.beat.shown > shown and ui.prologue:covering())
    -- Confirming the exit settles the run; the cinematic must not stay on top.
    local settled
    local ui2, root2 = fixture(nil, function(victory) settled = victory return true end, nil, nil, true)
    assert(F.start(ui2))
    assert(ui2:openExit())
    click(root2, "exitPanel", "confirm")
    assert(settled == false and ui2.settlementRequested)
    assert(not ui2.prologue.playing and not panel(root2).visible)
end)

test("restarting after a result resolves its Neow blessing before the map; the story plays once per session", function()
    local ui, root = opened()
    assert(part(root, "skip"):GetChild("hit").click())
    run(ui, P.fadeOut + P.reveal + 0.2)
    ui.run.phase = "defeat" ui:refresh()
    assert(ui.mode == "defeat" and root:GetChild("menuPanel").visible)
    assert(root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("title").text ~= "杀戮原塔2", "results name the outcome, not the game")
    assert(F.start(ui))
    assert(ui.mode=='node' and not panel(root).visible and not root:GetChild('mapPanel').visible)
    assert(#Nodes.available(ui.run,ui.map)==0)
    assert(ui.run.nodeFlow.event.id=='neow' and ui.run.neowHistorySource=='session-completed-run')
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option2')
    click(root,'nodePanel','eventView/option1')
    assert(ui.mode == "map" and not panel(root).visible and ui.mapUI.navigationEnabled)
end)

test("with pointer events a tap must be pressed inside the cinematic", function()
    local events = { CursorClick = "click", CursorDown = "down", CursorUp = "up", CursorExit = "exit", CursorEndDrag = "endDrag" }
    local ui, root = fixture(nil, nil, nil, events, true)
    root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("start"):GetChild("hit").listeners.down({})
    root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("start"):GetChild("hit").listeners.up({})
    root:GetChild("menuPanel"):GetChild("start"):GetChild("hit").click({})
    assert(F.confirmStart(ui))
    assert(ui.prologue:covering())
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.1)
    local advance = part(root, "advance")
    assert(not advance.click({}), "a click without its own press is a leftover")
    advance.listeners.down({}) advance.listeners.exit({})
    assert(not advance.click({}), "an interrupted touch is ignored")
    advance.listeners.down({})
    assert(advance.click({}) and part(root, "line").text == "岩层深处传来了异常的共鸣。")
end)

test("each sentence requests its own sound cue from the theme", function()
    local cues = {}
    local ui, root = opened(nil, function(cue) cues[#cues + 1] = cue end)
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.05) tap(root) tap(root)
    run(ui, P.minBeat + 0.05) tap(root) tap(root)
    assert(cues[1] == "prologue_rumble" and cues[2] == "prologue_crack" and cues[3] == "prologue_rise")
    for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do assert(Theme.sound[cue], cue) end
end)

test("hosts can opt out and start on the map directly", function()
    local ui, root = fixture()
    assert(F.start(ui))
    assert(ui.mode == "map" and not panel(root).visible and ui.prologue == nil)
end)
