        if relic.trigger == "combat_start" and relic.id ~= "anchor" then run.relics[#run.relics + 1] = relic.id end
    end
    run.potions = { "strength_potion", "regen_potion" }

    local first = Routes.at(map,route[1])

    equal(run.gold,1000)
    assert(Run.claimGoldReward(run))
    local hp, gold = run.hp, run.gold
    equal(gold, 1000 + quotedGold)
    assert(not Run.claimGoldReward(run));equal(run.gold,gold)
    local rewardId = Run.rewardOptions(run)[1]
    assert(Run.claimCardReward(run, 1)); assert(Run.leaveCombatRewards(run)); assert(Nodes.completeCombat(run, map))
    equal(#run.deck, 11); equal(run.deck[11].uid, 11); equal(run.nextDeckUid, 12)
    local acquired, visitedEvent, boughtCard, spent, nextBattleType = false, false, false, 0, nil
    local acquiredId,boughtCardId
    while true do
        local node = Routes.at(map,route[#map.path+1])
        assert(Nodes.enter(run, map, node.id))
        if run.phase == "combat" then nextBattleType = node.type break
        elseif node.type == "treasure" then
            local Treasure,Pool,Random=require('abyss_treasure'),require('abyss_relic_pool'),require('abyss_sts_random')
            local beforeOpen=Combat.copy(run)
            local expected=assert(Treasure.open(run,run.nodeFlow.chest,run.nodeFlow.reward))
            same(run,beforeOpen)
            assert(Nodes.openTreasure(run))
            same(run.nodeFlow.reward.items,expected.reward.items)
            same(Pool.snapshot(run.relicPool),Pool.snapshot(expected.relicPool))
            same(Random.snapshot(run.treasureRng),Random.snapshot(expected.treasureRng))
            same(Random.snapshot(run.cardRng),Random.snapshot(expected.cardRng))
            local originalItems=Combat.copy(run.nodeFlow.reward.items)
            local lastSlot,missing=0,false
            for _,item in ipairs(originalItems)do
                lastSlot=math.max(lastSlot,item.slot)
                if item.kind=='relic'then
                    local definition=require('abyss_relic_rewards').definition(run,item.sourceId)
                    equal(item.available,definition~=nil)
                    equal(item.id,definition and definition.id or item.sourceId)
                    if not definition then
                        missing=true
                        local before,flow,reward=Combat.copy(run),run.nodeFlow,run.nodeFlow.reward
                        local token=assert(Nodes.treasureRewardSource(run,item.slot))
                        local ok,reason=Nodes.claimTreasureReward(run,token)
                        assert(not ok and reason=='relic_content_unavailable')
                        same(run,before);equal(run.nodeFlow,flow);equal(run.nodeFlow.reward,reward)
                    end
                elseif item.kind=='gold'then
                    local token=assert(Nodes.treasureRewardSource(run,item.slot))
                    assert(Nodes.claimTreasureReward(run,token));gold=gold+item.amount
                end
            end
            assert(not missing,'seed70 now resolves its exact source relic without rerolling')
            equal(#originalItems,1);equal(originalItems[1].sourceId,'Pear')
            equal(originalItems[1].id,'pear');equal(originalItems[1].available,true)
            local pool,rng=Pool.snapshot(run.relicPool),{treasure=Random.snapshot(run.treasureRng),card=Random.snapshot(run.cardRng)}
            local items=run.nodeFlow.reward.items
            local originalRemaining=Combat.copy(items)
            local component={kind='relic',slot=lastSlot+1,id='anchor',sourceId='Anchor',available=true,origin='fixture'}
            items[#items+1]=component
            for i,item in ipairs(originalRemaining)do same(items[i],item)end
            same(Pool.snapshot(run.relicPool),pool)
            same({treasure=Random.snapshot(run.treasureRng),card=Random.snapshot(run.cardRng)},rng)
            local realToken=assert(Nodes.treasureRewardSource(run,originalItems[1].slot))
            equal(realToken.sourceId,'Pear')
            local maximum,beforeHp,beforeGold=run.maxHp,run.hp,run.gold
            assert(Nodes.claimTreasureReward(run,realToken))
            equal(run.maxHp,maximum+10);equal(run.hp,math.min(maximum+10,beforeHp+10));equal(run.gold,beforeGold)
            hp=math.min(maximum+10,beforeHp+10)
            local pears=0;for _,id in ipairs(run.relics)do if id=='pear'then pears=pears+1 end end;equal(pears,1)
            same(Pool.snapshot(run.relicPool),pool)
            same({treasure=Random.snapshot(run.treasureRng),card=Random.snapshot(run.cardRng)},rng)
            local beforeRepeat,flow,reward=Combat.copy(run),run.nodeFlow,run.nodeFlow.reward
            local repeated,repeatReason=Nodes.claimTreasureReward(run,realToken)
            equal(repeated,false);equal(repeatReason,'treasure_reward_unavailable')
            same(run,beforeRepeat);equal(run.nodeFlow,flow);equal(run.nodeFlow.reward,reward)
            local token=assert(Nodes.treasureRewardSource(run,component.slot))
            assert(Nodes.claimTreasureReward(run,token));acquiredId=component.id;acquired=true
            same(Pool.snapshot(run.relicPool),pool)
            same({treasure=Random.snapshot(run.treasureRng),card=Random.snapshot(run.cardRng)},rng)
            if run.phase=='node'then assert(Nodes.leaveTreasure(run))end
        elseif node.type == "event" then
            visitedEvent = true
            assert(Nodes.chooseEvent(run, "leave"))
        elseif node.type == "shop" then
            local view = Nodes.view(run, map).node
            for _, offer in ipairs(view.cards) do
                if not offer.unavailable and not boughtCard then
                    assert(Nodes.buyCard(run, offer.id)); spent = spent + offer.price; boughtCard = true; boughtCardId=offer.id
                end

            for _,card in ipairs(run.deck)do if not card.upgraded then uid=card.uid;break end end
            assert(uid and Nodes.upgrade(run,uid));equal(run.hp,before)
        else error("unexpected fixture node " .. node.type) end
    end
    assert(acquired and visitedEvent and boughtCard)
    equal(run.combat.player.hp, hp); equal(run.hp, hp); equal(run.gold, gold - spent)
    same(run.potions, { [2] = "regen_potion" })

    assert(Run.claimCardReward(run, 0)); assert(Run.leaveCombatRewards(run)); assert(Nodes.completeCombat(run, map))
    same(run.potions, {}); equal(run.nextDeckUid, 13)
end)

local Data=require('abyss_original_v4_data')
local Display=require('abyss_card_display')
local Original=require('abyss_original_v4_display')
local condition={eye='雷眼有效',musou='梦想一心有效',not_musou='梦想一心失效',
 resolve0='愿力为0',resolve2='愿力≥2',resolve3='愿力≥3',resolve4='愿力≥4'}
local function includes(text,part)assert(text:find(part,1,true),'missing sourced action '..part..' in '..text)end
local function semantic(e,text)
 local n=tostring(e.n)
 if e.op=='when'then
  includes(text,'若'..assert(condition[e.condition])..'：')
  for _,child in ipairs(e.effects)do semantic(child,text)end
 elseif e.op=='damage' or e.op=='damage_spent'then
  includes(text,(e.target=='all' and '全体受' or '目标受')..n)
  if e.op=='damage_spent' and e.coefficient~=0 then includes(text,'+'..e.coefficient..'×所耗愿力')end
  if (e.hits or 1)>1 then includes(text,'×'..e.hits..'伤害')end
 elseif e.op=='block'then includes(text,'获得'..n..'格挡')
 elseif e.op=='draw'then includes(text,'抽'..n..'张牌')
 elseif e.op=='spend'then includes(text,e.n=='all' and '耗尽' or '耗'..n..'愿力')
 elseif e.op=='eye' or e.op=='musou'then
  includes(text,e.op=='eye' and '雷眼' or '梦想一心');includes(text,n..'次');includes(text,'2结束阶段')
  if e.n~=3 then includes(text,'至少'..n..'次（≤3）')end
 elseif e.op=='eye_pulse'then includes(text,'使用雷眼1次，对目标造成2衍生伤害')
 elseif e.op=='resolve'then includes(text,'愿力+'..n)
 elseif e.op=='next_energy'then includes(text,'下回合能量+'..n)
 elseif e.op=='next_draw'then includes(text,'下回合多抽'..n..'张')
 elseif e.op=='next_block'then includes(text,'下回合格挡+'..n)
 elseif e.op=='cleanse'then includes(text,'清除自身虚弱与脆弱')
 elseif e.op=='bonus'then includes(text,'本回合下张普攻伤害牌首击+'..n)
 elseif e.op=='soften'then includes(text,'本回合削势+'..n..'（上限6），减下次敌方攻击总伤害')
 elseif e.op=='counter'then includes(text,'本回合反击取大至'..n..'（上限8），下次敌方攻击后存活则反击一次')
 else error('unaudited Raiden source operation '..e.op)end
end
local total=0
for _,raw in ipairs(Data.cards)do if raw.role=='RD' then
  for _,up in ipairs({false,true})do
    local definition={originalV4=raw}
    local instance={upgraded=up}
    local text=Display.permanentText({},definition,instance)
    local plain=text:gsub('<[^>]+>','')
    local version=raw[up and 'upgrade' or 'base']
    for _,effect in ipairs(version.effects)do semantic(effect,plain)end
    for _,id in ipairs(raw.requirements)do includes(plain,'需'..assert(condition[id]))end
    if version.exhaust then includes(plain,'消耗')end
    assert(not text:find('长按查看全文',1,true),raw.id..': card hides its actual effects')
    assert(not text:find('附条件效果',1,true),raw.id..': missing exact condition and result')
    local live=Display.combatText({},definition,instance,{})
    assert(live==text,raw.id..': unavailable preview must preserve the complete action text')
    local control={}
    assert(Display.writeBody(control,text),raw.id..(up and '+' or '')..': complete card text does not fit')
    assert(control.fontSize>=14,raw.id..': card text became unreadable')
    assert(control.text==text,raw.id..': renderer truncated the complete text')
    total=total+1
  end
end end
assert(total==150)

-- The explanatory projection is kept complete for development and keyword help.
has(Original.describe(card('RD2-061')),'每牌最多一次，不追击新建自身的命中，不递归')

local function same(a,b,seen)
 if a==b then return end;assert(type(a)==type(b),'preview changed rule value type')
 if type(a)~='table'then assert(a==b,'preview changed rule value');return end
 seen=seen or {};if seen[a]then assert(seen[a]==b);return end;seen[a]=b

  local c=p:GetChild(name)or p:GetChild('potionHelp'):GetChild(name)
  local hit=c.listeners and c or c:GetChild('hit');local fn=hit.listeners and hit.listeners[kind]

  emit(control,'down',touch,c.x,c.y);local x,y=target(slot or 2);emit(control,'drag',touch,x,y)

local NativeContract = dofile('tests/lua/support/native_ui_contract.lua')
return function(first,last,seedFirst,seedLast)
first,last=assert(first),assert(last)
seedFirst,seedLast=seedFirst or 1,seedLast or 6
assert(type(seedFirst)=='number'and type(seedLast)=='number'and seedFirst%1==0 and seedLast%1==0 and seedFirst>=1 and seedLast<=6 and seedFirst<=seedLast,'invalid UI playback seed slice')
local registered=0
package.path = "src/lua/?.lua;build/lua/?.lua;" .. package.path
local UI = require("abyss_battle_ui")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Data = require("abyss_data")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Presentation = require("abyss_presentation")

-- Compose the controller with the actual generated native tree, not a permissive mock.
-- These methods capture no node state. Keep them as own fields so overrides
-- and pairs/rawget see the same control shape without per-node closures.
local Control = {}
function Control:GetChild(key) return assert(self.children[key], "unknown control " .. self.name .. "/" .. key) end
function Control:SetVisible(value) assert(type(value) == "boolean") self.visible = value end
function Control:AddCursorEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
    self.listeners = self.listeners or {}
    self.listeners[event] = fn
    if event == "click" then self.click = fn end
end
function Control:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y) self.x, self.y = x, y end
function Control:SetSizeDelta(x, y) NativeContract.sizeDelta(x,y); self.sizeDeltaX, self.sizeDeltaY = x, y end
function Control:SetLocalScale(x, y) self.localScaleX, self.localScaleY = x, y end
function Control:SetImage(...)
    assert(select("#", ...) == 2, "SetImage expects exactly source and id")
    local source, id = ...
    assert(source == "static" and type(id) == "number") self.imageId = id
end
function Control:SetAsLastSibling() self.raised = true end

local function control(definition)
    local c = { name = definition.name, visible = definition.visible ~= false, children = {}, text = "",
        sizeDeltaX = definition.size[1], sizeDeltaY = definition.size[2], interactable = true,
        x = definition.position and definition.position[1] or 0, y = definition.position and definition.position[2] or 0 }
    for _, entry in ipairs(definition.children or {}) do c.children[entry.name] = control(entry) end
    c.GetChild = Control.GetChild
    c.SetVisible = Control.SetVisible
    c.AddCursorEventListener = Control.AddCursorEventListener
    c.SetAnchoredPosition = Control.SetAnchoredPosition
    c.SetSizeDelta = Control.SetSizeDelta
    c.SetLocalScale = Control.SetLocalScale
    c.SetImage = Control.SetImage
    c.SetAsLastSibling = Control.SetAsLastSibling
    return NativeContract.control(c,definition)
end
local function setup(options)
    local root = control({name="root", size={1280,720}, children=assert(ABYSS_TEST_LAYOUT).controls})
    local stage = root:GetChild("stage")
    if options and options.embedded then root = stage end
    local ui = UI.new(root, Data, Presentation, "click", {imageSource="static", color=function(r,g,b,a) return {r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a} end,
        cursorEvents=options and options.dragEvents and {CursorDown="down",CursorDrag="drag",CursorUp="up",CursorEndDrag="endDrag"} or nil}, options)
    local function click(name)
        local box = stage:GetChild(name)
        if box.click then if box.interactable then box.click() end else box:GetChild("hit").click() end
        if not (options and options.manualPlayback) and ui.feedback and ui.feedback.busy then
            for _ = 1, 400 do if not ui.busy then break end ui:update(0.05) end
            assert(not ui.busy, "presentation must release input")
        end
    end
    local function play(slot, target)
        click("card" .. slot)
        local instance = ui.run.phase == "combat" and ui.run.combat.hand[slot]
        if instance and ui.selected == instance.uid then
            local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(ui.run.combat, instance.uid, nil)
            click(reason == "invalid_target" and "enemy" .. (target or 1) or "playArea")
        end
    end
    return ui, stage, click, play, root
end
-- Source Main adds an explicit confirmation after opening a physical bottle.
-- Existing rules/ownership cases still execute real controls, not direct commands.
local function usePotion(ui,stage,click,slot)
    click("potion"..slot)
    if not ui.potionMenu then return end
    local use=stage.children.potionHelp.children.potionPopup.children.use
    if use.interactable then use.click() end
    for _=1,400 do if not ui.busy then break end;ui:update(0.05)end
    assert(not ui.busy,"explicit potion confirmation must release playback")
end
-- Read a unit's statuses the way a player does: open its detail panel, then close it.
local function details(stage, box)
    box.children.statusRow.children.hit.click()
    local info, lines = stage.children.statusInfo, {}
    assert(info.visible)
    for i = 1, Theme.layout.statusInfo.rows do
        if info.children["name" .. i].visible then lines[#lines + 1] = info.children["name" .. i].text end
    end
    info.children.hit.click()
    assert(not info.visible)
    return table.concat(lines, " | ")
end
-- Read the approved independent card, including every page, then close on blank space.
local function inspectDetails(ui, stage)
    local panel, text = stage.children.statusInfo, {}
    assert(panel.visible and ui.info, "ordinary unit inspection must use the detail card")
    for page = 1, ui.info.pages do
        for i = 1, Theme.layout.statusInfo.rows do
            for _, field in ipairs({"name", "text", "tag", "note"}) do
                local part = panel.children[field .. i]
                if part.visible then text[#text + 1] = part.text end
            end
        end
        if page < ui.info.pages then panel.children.page.click() end
    end
    panel.children.hit.click()
    assert(not panel.visible and not ui.info, "blank space closes the detail card")
    return table.concat(text, " | ")
end

local function test(name, fn)
    registered=registered+1
    if registered<first or registered>last then return end
    fn() count=count+1 print("ok UI " .. registered .. " - " .. name)
end

local function drain(ui, inspect)
    local previous
    for _ = 1, 2000 do
        if not ui.busy then return end
        local entry = ui.feedback.current
        if entry ~= previous then if inspect then inspect(entry) end previous = entry end
        ui:update(inspect and 0.02 or 0.2)
    end
    error("queue did not release input")
end

test("animated block badges keep HP and neighbouring columns clear for player, one to five enemies and boss", function()
    for count = 1, 6 do
        local enemies = {}
        for i = 1, math.min(count, 5) do enemies[i] = "cultist" end
        if count == 6 then enemies = {"guardian"} end
        -- Both standalone click-only fallback and embedded/drag-capable hosts use this feedback path.
        local ui, stage, click, battle = feedbackBattle({"defend"}, enemies,
            {embedded=count % 2 == 0, dragEvents=count % 2 == 0})
        ui:resize(count % 2 == 0 and 1920 or 1280, count % 2 == 0 and 1080 or 720)
        for _, enemy in ipairs(battle.enemies) do
            enemy.block, enemy.ai, enemy.intentIndex = 7, nil, 1
            enemy.intents = {{kind="defend", effects={{op="block",value=5}}}}
        end
        ui:render()
        local popped = {}
        local function bounds(box)
            local c = box.children
            local barLeft = c.hpBorder.x - c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaX / 2
            local left = barLeft
            if c.block.visible then
                for _, name in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
                    local part = c[name]
                    local half = part.sizeDeltaX * (part.localScaleX or 1) / 2
                    local above = part.y - part.sizeDeltaY * (part.localScaleY or 1) / 2
                        >= c.hpBorder.y + c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaY / 2
                    assert(part.x + half <= barLeft + 0.000001 or above, box.name .. "/" .. name .. " animated over HP")
                    left = math.min(left, part.x - half)
                    assert(part.localScaleY == c.blockIcon.localScaleY, "chip parts animate together")
                end
                if (c.blockIcon.localScaleY or 1) > 1 then popped[box.name] = true end
                local displayed = ui.displayBattle or battle
                local actor = box.name == "hero" and displayed.player or displayed.enemies[tonumber(box.name:match("%d+"))]
                assert(c.block.text == string.format("%.0f", actor.block), "animation preserves exact Block digits")
            end
            return box.x + left, box.x + c.hpBorder.x + c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaX / 2
        end
        local function inspect()
            bounds(stage.children.hero)
            local previousRight = {}
            for i = 1, #battle.enemies do
                local box=stage.children['enemy'..i]
                local left, right = bounds(box)
                assert(left >= -600 and right <= 600, "animated guard/HP outside safe area")
                assert(left > (previousRight[box.y] or 0), "animated chip crosses neighbouring HP")
                previousRight[box.y] = right
            end
        end
        local function playback()
            for _ = 1, 800 do
                ui:update(0.02) inspect()
                if not ui.busy and next(ui.feedback.effects) == nil then return end
            end
            error("block playback did not finish")
        end
        click("card1") click("playArea") playback()
        assert(popped.hero, "actual Defend must retain vertical badge feedback")
        click("endTurn") playback()
        for i = 1, #battle.enemies do
            local box = stage.children["enemy" .. i]
            assert(popped[box.name], "each enemy must play actual block feedback")
            for _, name in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
                assert(box.children[name].localScaleX == 1 and box.children[name].localScaleY == 1, "badge resets after playback")
            end
        end
    end
end)

test("playback preserves every rule field and RNG against direct commands and cannot replay consumed events", function()
    for seed = seedFirst, seedLast do
        local ui, stage, click = setup({manualPlayback=true})
        ui.seed = seed click("start")
        local direct = Combat.copy(ui.run)
        local ignored = {events=true, data=true, catalog=true, statusDefinitions=true}
        local function same(a,b,path)
            if type(a) ~= "table" then assert(a == b, path) return end
            assert(type(b) == "table",path)
            for k,v in pairs(a) do if not ignored[k] then same(v,b[k],path .. "." .. tostring(k)) end end
            for k in pairs(b) do if not ignored[k] then assert(a[k] ~= nil,path .. "." .. tostring(k)) end end
        end
        same(ui.run.data,direct.data,"immutable data")
        same(ui.run.combat.catalog,direct.combat.catalog,"immutable catalog")
        for _ = 1, 20 do
            if ui.run.phase ~= "combat" then break end
            local battle, slot = ui.run.combat
            for i, card in ipairs(battle.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(battle,card.uid,1) then slot = i break end end
            if slot then
                local uid = battle.hand[slot].uid
                assert(Run.play(direct,uid,1))
                click("card" .. slot)
                local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(battle, uid, nil)
                click(reason == "invalid_target" and "enemy1" or "playArea")
            else assert(Run.endTurn(direct)) click("endTurn") end
            same(ui.run,direct,"committed")
            drain(ui) same(ui.run,direct,"after playback")
            assert(#battle.events == 0, "consumed frames must not accumulate")
            for _ = 1, 4 do ui:update(0.2) end
            same(ui.run,direct,"idle")
        end
        print("UI_PLAYBACK_SEED " .. seed)
    end
end)

local function dragBattle(deck, enemies)
    local ui, stage, click = setup({manualPlayback=true, dragEvents=true})
    click("start")
    ui.run.combat = Combat.new(Data,{deck=deck or {"defend","defend"},enemies=enemies or {"cultist"}})
    ui:resize(1280,720) ui:render()
    local function event(control, kind, x, y, touch)
        local hit = stage.children[control]
        if hit.children.hit then hit = hit.children.hit end
        local callback = hit.listeners and hit.listeners[kind]
        assert(callback, "native " .. kind .. " listener missing on " .. control)
        local k = math.min(ui.canvasWidth/1280,ui.canvasHeight/720)
        callback({touchId=touch or 0,GetUIPos=function() return ui.canvasWidth/2+x*k,ui.canvasHeight/2+y*k end})
    end
    local function grab(slot, touch)
        local box = stage.children["card" .. slot]

local registered=0

local UI = require("abyss_battle_ui")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Data = require("abyss_data")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Presentation = require("abyss_presentation")

-- Compose the controller with the actual generated native tree, not a permissive mock.
-- These methods capture no node state. Keep them as own fields so overrides
-- and pairs/rawget see the same control shape without per-node closures.
local Control = {}
function Control:GetChild(key) return assert(self.children[key], "unknown control " .. self.name .. "/" .. key) end
function Control:SetVisible(value) assert(type(value) == "boolean") self.visible = value end
function Control:AddCursorEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
    self.listeners = self.listeners or {}
    self.listeners[event] = fn
    if event == "click" then self.click = fn end
end
function Control:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y) self.x, self.y = x, y end
function Control:SetSizeDelta(x, y) NativeContract.sizeDelta(x,y); self.sizeDeltaX, self.sizeDeltaY = x, y end
function Control:SetLocalScale(x, y) self.localScaleX, self.localScaleY = x, y end
function Control:SetImage(...)
    assert(select("#", ...) == 2, "SetImage expects exactly source and id")
    local source, id = ...
    assert(source == "static" and type(id) == "number") self.imageId = id
end
function Control:SetAsLastSibling() self.raised = true end

local function control(definition)
    local c = { name = definition.name, visible = definition.visible ~= false, children = {}, text = "",
        sizeDeltaX = definition.size[1], sizeDeltaY = definition.size[2], interactable = true,
        x = definition.position and definition.position[1] or 0, y = definition.position and definition.position[2] or 0 }
    for _, entry in ipairs(definition.children or {}) do c.children[entry.name] = control(entry) end
    c.GetChild = Control.GetChild
    c.SetVisible = Control.SetVisible
    c.AddCursorEventListener = Control.AddCursorEventListener
    c.SetAnchoredPosition = Control.SetAnchoredPosition
    c.SetSizeDelta = Control.SetSizeDelta
    c.SetLocalScale = Control.SetLocalScale
    c.SetImage = Control.SetImage
    c.SetAsLastSibling = Control.SetAsLastSibling
    return NativeContract.control(c,definition)
end
local function setup(options)
    local root = control({name="root", size={1280,720}, children=assert(ABYSS_TEST_LAYOUT).controls})
    local stage = root:GetChild("stage")
    if options and options.embedded then root = stage end
    local ui = UI.new(root, Data, Presentation, "click", {imageSource="static", color=function(r,g,b,a) return {r=r,g=g,b=b,a=a} end,
        cursorEvents=options and options.dragEvents and {CursorDown="down",CursorDrag="drag",CursorUp="up",CursorEndDrag="endDrag"} or nil}, options)
    local function click(name)
        local box = stage:GetChild(name)
        if box.click then if box.interactable then box.click() end else box:GetChild("hit").click() end
        if not (options and options.manualPlayback) and ui.feedback and ui.feedback.busy then
            for _ = 1, 400 do if not ui.busy then break end ui:update(0.05) end
            assert(not ui.busy, "presentation must release input")
        end
    end
    local function play(slot, target)
        click("card" .. slot)
        local instance = ui.run.phase == "combat" and ui.run.combat.hand[slot]
        if instance and ui.selected == instance.uid then
            local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(ui.run.combat, instance.uid, nil)
            click(reason == "invalid_target" and "enemy" .. (target or 1) or "playArea")
        end
    end
    return ui, stage, click, play, root
end

-- Read a unit's statuses the way a player does: open its detail panel, then close it.
local function details(stage, box)
    box.children.statusRow.children.hit.click()
    local info, lines = stage.children.statusInfo, {}
    assert(info.visible)
    for i = 1, Theme.layout.statusInfo.rows do
        if info.children["name" .. i].visible then lines[#lines + 1] = info.children["name" .. i].text end
    end
    info.children.hit.click()
    assert(not info.visible)
    return table.concat(lines, " | ")

-- Read the approved independent card, including every page, then close on blank space.
local function inspectDetails(ui, stage)
    local panel, text = stage.children.statusInfo, {}
    assert(panel.visible and ui.info, "ordinary unit inspection must use the detail card")
    for page = 1, ui.info.pages do
        for i = 1, Theme.layout.statusInfo.rows do
            for _, field in ipairs({"name", "text", "tag", "note"}) do
                local part = panel.children[field .. i]
                if part.visible then text[#text + 1] = part.text end
            end
        end
        if page < ui.info.pages then panel.children.page.click() end
    end
    panel.children.hit.click()
    assert(not panel.visible and not ui.info, "blank space closes the detail card")
    return table.concat(text, " | ")
end

        local barLeft = c.hpBorder.x - c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaX / 2
        assert(c.blockIcon.visible and c.blockEdge.visible and c.block.visible)

local function drain(ui, inspect)
    local previous
    for _ = 1, 2000 do
        if not ui.busy then return end
        local entry = ui.feedback.current
        if entry ~= previous then if inspect then inspect(entry) end previous = entry end
        ui:update(inspect and 0.02 or 0.2)
    end
    error("queue did not release input")
end

test("animated block badges keep HP and neighbouring columns clear for player, one to five enemies and boss", function()
    for count = 1, 6 do
        local enemies = {}
        for i = 1, math.min(count, 5) do enemies[i] = "cultist" end
        if count == 6 then enemies = {"guardian"} end
        -- Both standalone click-only fallback and embedded/drag-capable hosts use this feedback path.
        local ui, stage, click, battle = feedbackBattle({"defend"}, enemies,
            {embedded=count % 2 == 0, dragEvents=count % 2 == 0})

            enemy.block, enemy.ai, enemy.intentIndex = 7, nil, 1
            enemy.intents = {{kind="defend", effects={{op="block",value=5}}}}
        end
        ui:render()
        local popped = {}
        local function bounds(box)
            local c = box.children
            local barLeft = c.hpBorder.x - c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaX / 2
            local left = barLeft
            if c.block.visible then
                for _, name in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
                    local part = c[name]
                    local half = part.sizeDeltaX * (part.localScaleX or 1) / 2
                    local above = part.y - part.sizeDeltaY * (part.localScaleY or 1) / 2
                        >= c.hpBorder.y + c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaY / 2
                    assert(part.x + half <= barLeft + 0.000001 or above, box.name .. "/" .. name .. " animated over HP")
                    left = math.min(left, part.x - half)
                    assert(part.localScaleY == c.blockIcon.localScaleY, "chip parts animate together")
                end
                if (c.blockIcon.localScaleY or 1) > 1 then popped[box.name] = true end
                local displayed = ui.displayBattle or battle
                local actor = box.name == "hero" and displayed.player or displayed.enemies[tonumber(box.name:match("%d+"))]
                assert(c.block.text == string.format("%.0f", actor.block), "animation preserves exact Block digits")
            end
            return box.x + left, box.x + c.hpBorder.x + c.hpBorder.sizeDeltaX / 2
        end
        local function inspect()
            bounds(stage.children.hero)
            local previousRight = {}
            for i = 1, #battle.enemies do
                local box=stage.children['enemy'..i]
                local left, right = bounds(box)
                assert(left >= -600 and right <= 600, "animated guard/HP outside safe area")
                assert(left > (previousRight[box.y] or 0), "animated chip crosses neighbouring HP")
                previousRight[box.y] = right
            end
        end
        local function playback()
            for _ = 1, 800 do
                ui:update(0.02) inspect()
                if not ui.busy and next(ui.feedback.effects) == nil then return end
            end
            error("block playback did not finish")
        end
        click("card1") click("playArea") playback()
        assert(popped.hero, "actual Defend must retain vertical badge feedback")
        click("endTurn") playback()
        for i = 1, #battle.enemies do
            local box = stage.children["enemy" .. i]
            assert(popped[box.name], "each enemy must play actual block feedback")
            for _, name in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
                assert(box.children[name].localScaleX == 1 and box.children[name].localScaleY == 1, "badge resets after playback")
            end
        end
    end
end)

test("playback preserves every rule field and RNG against direct commands and cannot replay consumed events", function()
    for seed = seedFirst, seedLast do
        local ui, stage, click = setup({manualPlayback=true})
        ui.seed = seed click("start")
        local direct = Combat.copy(ui.run)
        local ignored = {events=true, data=true, catalog=true, statusDefinitions=true}
        local function same(a,b,path)
            if type(a) ~= "table" then assert(a == b, path) return end
            assert(type(b) == "table",path)
            for k,v in pairs(a) do if not ignored[k] then same(v,b[k],path .. "." .. tostring(k)) end end
            for k in pairs(b) do if not ignored[k] then assert(a[k] ~= nil,path .. "." .. tostring(k)) end end
        end
        same(ui.run.data,direct.data,"immutable data")
        same(ui.run.combat.catalog,direct.combat.catalog,"immutable catalog")
        for _ = 1, 20 do
            if ui.run.phase ~= "combat" then break end
            local battle, slot = ui.run.combat
            for i, card in ipairs(battle.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(battle,card.uid,1) then slot = i break end end
            if slot then
                local uid = battle.hand[slot].uid
                assert(Run.play(direct,uid,1))
                click("card" .. slot)
                local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(battle, uid, nil)
                click(reason == "invalid_target" and "enemy1" or "playArea")
            else assert(Run.endTurn(direct)) click("endTurn") end
            same(ui.run,direct,"committed")
            drain(ui) same(ui.run,direct,"after playback")
            assert(#battle.events == 0, "consumed frames must not accumulate")
            for _ = 1, 4 do ui:update(0.2) end
            same(ui.run,direct,"idle")
        end
        print("UI_PLAYBACK_SEED " .. seed)
    end
end)

local function dragBattle(deck, enemies)

    ui:resize(1280,720) ui:render()
    local function event(control, kind, x, y, touch)
        local hit = stage.children[control]
        if hit.children.hit then hit = hit.children.hit end
        local callback = hit.listeners and hit.listeners[kind]
        assert(callback, "native " .. kind .. " listener missing on " .. control)
        local k = math.min(ui.canvasWidth/1280,ui.canvasHeight/720)
        callback({touchId=touch or 0,GetUIPos=function() return ui.canvasWidth/2+x*k,ui.canvasHeight/2+y*k end})
    end
    local function grab(slot, touch)
        local box = stage.children["card" .. slot]
        event("card" .. slot,"down",box.x,box.y,touch)
    end
    return ui,stage,click,event,grab,ui.run.combat
end

local NativeContract = dofile('tests/lua/support/native_ui_contract.lua')
local GameUI = require("abyss_game_ui")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Nodes = require("abyss_nodes")
local Data = require("abyss_data")
local Presentation = require("abyss_presentation")
local Layout = require("abyss_ui_layout")
local Templates = require("abyss_ui_templates")

local function preview(name, text)
    print("LORE_PREVIEW\t" .. name .. "\t" .. text:gsub("\n", "\\n"))
end
-- These methods capture no node state. Keep them as own fields so overrides
-- and pairs/rawget see the same control shape without per-node closures.
local Control = {}
-- The engine owns activation. Expose only the documented read-only hierarchy
-- result on controls; tests change private engine state, not native properties.
local engineActive = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
local function activeInHierarchy(control)
    while control do
        if engineActive[control] == false then return false end
        control = control.parent
    end
    return true
end
local function setEngineActive(control,value)
    assert(type(value)=='boolean'); engineActive[control]=value
end
local function nativeField(control,key)
    assert(key~='interactable' or rawget(control,'kind')~='cursorArea',
        'Native CursorArea has no interactable field; use raycastTarget')
end
local controlMethods = {
    __index = function(control,key)
        nativeField(control,key)
        if key=='activeInHierarchy' then return activeInHierarchy(control) end
        return Control[key]
    end,
    __newindex = function(control,key,value)
        nativeField(control,key)
        assert(key~='activeInHierarchy','Native activeInHierarchy is read-only')
        rawset(control,key,value)
    end,
}
function Control:GetChild(name) return self.children[name] end
function Control:SetVisible(value) assert(type(value) == "boolean"); self.visible = value end
function Control:SetSizeDelta(width, height) NativeContract.sizeDelta(width,height); self.size = {width, height}; self.sizeDeltaX, self.sizeDeltaY = width, height end
function Control:SetLocalScale(x, y, z) self.scale = {x, y, z}; self.localScaleX, self.localScaleY = x, y end
function Control:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y) self.x, self.y = x, y end
function Control:SetImage(...)
    assert(select("#", ...) == 2, "SetImage expects exactly source and id")
    local source, id = ...
    assert(source == "static" and type(id) == "number"); self.imageId = id
end
function Control:SetAsLastSibling() self.raised = true end
function Control:AddCursorEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
    assert(self.kind~='container','Native containers do not support AddCursorEventListener; use a cursorArea')
    self.listeners = self.listeners or {}
    assert(not self.listeners[event], "duplicate cursor listener: " .. tostring(event))
    self.listeners[event] = fn
    if event == "click" then self.click = fn end
end
function Control:AddKeyEventListener(event, fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
    self.keyListeners = self.keyListeners or {}
    assert(not self.keyListeners[event], 'duplicate key listener')
    self.keyListeners[event] = fn
end
function Control:AddNavigationEventListener(event,fn) NativeContract.listener(event,fn);
    self.navigationListeners=self.navigationListeners or {}
    assert(not self.navigationListeners[event],'duplicate navigation listener')
